༄༅/bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos sde stod cha gter gzhung skor bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos sde stod cha gter gzhung skor bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /sha 'ug stag sgor gter byon yang phur rmad/ /gwa'u dmar nag chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub skor yin la/ de la'ang zhi drag gnyis kyi nang tshan drag po'i chos sde ste/ bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma zhes snga ma hā gu rus bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu yang dag bde gshegs snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad nas grub pa thob la nye ba'i skabs klu gyong po dang gnod sbyin rgod ma kha bar snang glog ma sprin sogs kyi nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre thams cad bskul zhing lha 'dre mi gsum gyis khengs log bar chad chen po byung ba'i skabs bal po ji la ji sa dang bal mo ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du slob dpon pra bha hastī'i drung du bar chad sel ba'i chos shig zhu bar btang ba bzhin zhus pas phur pa bid+yot+ta ma 'bum sde las phur pa mi khur gsum tsam dang khyad par du phur pa spa ma gong khug ma zhes bya ba 'di nyid btang bas zhal phyes pa tsam gyis bdud las rgyal nas bar chad thams cad rang sar zhi zhing phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa dang slad kyi phyi ma'i bstan 'gro la dmigs nas yang dag ni tshong pa dang 'dra ste byin rlabs che/ phur pa ni skyel ma dang 'dra ste phrin las myur zhes gsungs shing yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs mdzad par grags kyang sa steng du thon pa'i yang phur sbrags ma ches nyung bar snang ngo*/ des na ma hā gu ru rang nyid kyi thugs dam lhag pa'i lha mchog yang phur gwa'u dmar nag ces bya ba lam gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med cing zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la gnyis/

rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor ro/ dang po gter gzhung skor la/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i sgos sgrub/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: me bskul gnam lcags thog mda'/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: smyo bcos 'byung po mtha' gtad/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bdud rtsi bum pa'i za yig man ngag bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: sngags zhwa'i rgyan bkod pha rol rgol 'joms/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bdud rtsi bum pa'i bu yig gsal sgron/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: me dbal dbyug to'i bskyed rim/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bu yig rdzas kyi man ngag bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bu yig gud du sbas pa/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gza' bcos bdud rtsi bum pa'i dpe'u ris/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: khyi dug bcos pa'i zab rgya gzer thig bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dri bsung zhing khams kun khyab dkon mchog mchod sprin/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: srung bzlog bsad pa'i dpe'u ris/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig rtsal skud/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i 'brug sgra/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dkar gtor 'dod yon kun khyab/ bla med yang dag ye shes snying po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ stobs ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: stobs ldan phur pa nag po'i hūm̐ sgrub/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: srung zlog gur gyi drwa mig /bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las:

dpa' bo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las byang phrin las rgyun khyer/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: mdun bskyed pho brang gi cha bkod/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bskang ba bdud dpung zil gnon/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dbang phyug las bskul rdo rje'i spu gri/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: phur srung bcu drug gi gtor bskul dug mda' spu gri/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gter srung btsan rgod kyi gsol kha/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dmag bskul mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bsad las spu gri'i 'khor lo/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: rtsang bskul shan pa dmag 'gyed/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: mdos rgyan dar tshon sna lnga/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: yang bzlog thog mda' dgu skor/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bzlog pa dug mda' reg chod/ bzlog pa bsdus pa/ bsad las bsdus pa/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: g.yul bzlog dregs dpung gnam lcags thog mda'/ zhi drag bskul pa/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gser skyems gling bzhi'i dmag bskul/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: btsan rgod kyi zor chen spu gri ngar ma/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: za lam srin mo'i las zor bzlog pa mdos lam dmar po/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las zor dgra snying dmar 'byin/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dgongs gsol khro rgyal rngam sgra/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnam lcags rab 'bar/ mi mngon chos dbyings/ bsnyen pa'i bzlas dmigs o rgyan 'gro 'dul gyis mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi lag mchod seṅges mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren rgyas pa/ phyag bzlog yang dag zhal rgyun/ gtor zlog grangs gsog gsang chen khro rol/

bzlog grangs gsog thabs bsdus pa sgo chen sprul sku'i gsung*/ khyung tho/ gtor gzhong rab gnas/ yon mchod bde legs/ sngags pa rgyal dbyangs/ tshe 'gugs/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ 'don cha'i zin bris dbang po'i lde mig bhi dza ha// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba rdo rje rab 'bar bzhugs so: mkha' 'gro singha la yi skad du: ka ra bid+yā dha hi: bod skad du: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lo rgyus zhes bya ba rin chen phreng ba ste: 'di la don gsum mo: 'dir rgyud ces bya ba ni: rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse'o: 'di'i lo rgyus bya ba ni sngon byung gi rgyud dang 'gres so: 'di yi khungs bshad pa ni: chos kyi bab tshul lo: dper na lo rgyus chos kyi bab tshul gyi dbang du song na: bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag bya ba ste: bla med ces pa ni: theg pa thams cad kyi gong ma yin pas bla med do: yang phur ces pa yang dag pa'i lta ba ma nor zhing khong du chud pa'i rdzong chen te: nyi ma'i snying po ltar grags shing rang bzhin gyi don thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba'o: phur pa bya ba ni: yang dag ye shes rol pa'i sgrub khog gis bar chod bsal phyir phur pa sku gsum skye med kī la yar grags pa'o: gwa'u dmar nag ces pa ni: rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa yin pas thabs shes tsam du mtshon pa'o: sbas pa'i yul sha 'ug stag sgo dgos pa ni: sha 'ug stag sgor ma ning gter kha sbas: zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan no: ma ning zhes pa ni: yang dag rdzogs pa chen po: phur pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal: phur skyong dgra bgegs tshar gcod de: lha gcig la don gsum tshang pa ma ning gi mtshan nyid do: khyad par bla med yang dag gi chos 'di bod du ji ltar dar na: sku rgyal bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas gri gum btsan po'i bar du: srid pa g.yung drung gi bon dar:

lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes srong btsan sgam po'i dus su chos kyi srol btod: jo shāka spyan drangs: khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la rje btsun chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal bsam yas su spyan drangs te chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa mang du bskor zhing : mthar rje 'bangs nyer lnga la sogs smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas zab mo gter gyi bka' gtad: de yang rdo rje phur pa'i bla brgyud ltar na: brgyud pa gsum ste: rgya gar yul nas dga' rab rdo rje nas pra bha hastī dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas la brgyud te ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad: bal yul nas bal po ji la ji sa dang shākya dā+e ma: ku la ku sa zhes kyang yod mchan gnyis kyis brgyud pa bal po ba su dha ra la bka' gtad: bsam yas su rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge: gru gu e bag sha: ru gyong dar ma ra tsa: gnubs nam mkha'i snying po rnams nas khri srong lde'u btsan la lung phog: de rnams gsang sngags ban phur bya ba yin: man ngag bon phur bya ba bai ro tsa nas bsgyur zhing bka' gtad pa ni: li shi stag ring : tsha mi g.yung drung : stong mgyogs mthu chen: gshin bon dran pa: mi lus bsam lhag: stag la me 'bar: rta bon byon khrid: mthar bon grub skyel: 'phrul bon a snang ste: bon khro bo gsang phur gyi rgyud do: phur pa'i rgyud la sa ya gcig dang 'bum tsho gsum yod: de yi nang nas byin rlabs che ba yang gsang phur gcig ma yin: brgyud pa nye lam du 'khod pa bal po ba su dha ra yin: thugs kyi bu bzhi yi nang nas che ba yin: de ltar gyur pa las yang phur 'di nyid sngon slob dpon chen po pra bha hastī la zhus pa dang : phyi mor slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la yang phur sbrags ma bya ba'i gdams pa yod pa bod nas rgya gar du len du phyin pa'i rgyud bcas phyogs gcig tu dril ba ste: yang phur gwa'u dmar nag tu grags pa'o:

sa ma ya: e ma dbyings yangs pa chen po skye med kī la sgrogs pa'i zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ru dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas yang dag bzhugs so: gnas de dang nye ba ru: lha yi dbang po rin chen 'phrul snang bya ba'i dad dpon chen po zhig bzhugs pa la: lha min rgyal po tri sha ta bya ba'i gdug rtsub che ba zhig yod: des lha yi dbang po la dmag drangs te the tshom pa'i tshe lha'i dbang pos: dpal gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed la gsol ba btab pas: mdun gyi nam mkha' nas lag na rdo rjes lung bstan te: lha yi dbang po shin tu drag po mi bya'o: byang shar mtshams kyi kha che he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du: mchod rten shrī prañdza bya ba'i mgul du bdud bzhi g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba'i yang phur sbrags ma'i gdams pa yod de: de dag 'byin pas lha min g.yul pham par 'gyur ro: zhes bka' stsal to: rin chen 'phrul snang de ltar 'byin pas mchod rten de'i bum pa'i nang du: gnam lcags las grub pa'i gter sgrom sdig pa ra tsa mgo dgu'i rnam pa can zhig yod pa gdan drangs: de yi nang nas yang phur bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i drag sngags chig brgyud yod pa de bklags pas lha ma yin gyi dmag rnams rab tu pham par gyur: de'i rgyud dang gdams pa rnams rlung gi gsal byed kyi sgrom bur bcug nas lha'i yul du sbas so: lha bu de tshe 'phos nas 'dzam gling du slob dpon pra bha hastī bya ba bla med kyi don la mkhas par gyur: de yang pra bha hastī bya ba lta ba dri med 'od zer du grags pa de nyid: yul bid+yot+ta ma la zhes pa'i rig pa ye shes klong la rang bzhin du khyab pa'i gnas su byon: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos dang mjal rdzogs pa chen po'i nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud rnams gsan: mchog gi rig 'dzin brnyes: 'og min du byon: dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po mjal:

a ti mtha' bral gyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur: me ri 'bar bar byon rdo rje sems dpa' mjal: phyi rgyud rdo rje yang rtse'i rgyud rnams rdzogs par mdzad: ma la yar byon dga' rab rdo rje mjal: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i phyi rgyud gsan: bid+yot+ta ma la ru mchog dang thun mong thams cad skad cig rdzogs par gyur: de yi tshe phyi pa mu stegs dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa gnyis 'khrug pa'i tshe: mu stegs nag po 'phur shes bya ba'am zhang zhung rlung 'khor bya ba ru yod pa kho khros te: nam mkha' nas thog char phab: de yi tshe pra bha hastī rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te mu stegs kyi sde thams cad pham par brlags nas: khyad par gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor bcas dngos su byon te slob dpon dang dbyer med du gyur: de yi tshe kī li kī la ya gnam lcags kyi phur bu sor brgyad pa zhig mkha' nas byung ste mdun du babs nas: slob dpon gyis rtsol med kyi phyag gis 'dzin nas gsor thabs kyis gdeng bas mu stegs kyi dmag rnams dran med du 'gyel bar gyur: stong pa'i rang sgra las: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sgras bskul te yang phur gnam lcags thog mda' ru grags so: gnam lcags thog mda'i rgyud de nyid la phur pa spa ma gong khug ces bya ste: spa ma ni mu stegs pa'i yul de yi ming ngo : gong khug bya ba ni gzhan phal mo che la ma spel zhing dar tshon sna lngas dril te gong ba'i nang du 'chang bas gong khug bya'o: gdams pa de dang 'brel ba'i rgyud rnams phyi mor rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas la mkha' 'gros lung bstan pas bid+yot+ta ma la ru byon: lung las: rnal 'byor pra bha hastī spyan sngar byon: yo ga rnam gsum chos kyi sbyangs pa mdzad: yo ga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis zhal gzigs so:

gu ru shākya seṅge mtshan du gsol: zhes pa ltar: dus de yi tshe rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud thams cad rdzogs par thugs nyams kyis bzhes: phyi mo'i dus su bal yul yang le shod du phebs skabs: bal po thams cad kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis cho 'phrul bstan: lo gsum du bkra mi shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs byung : de yi tshe bal po'i rgyal pos ji la ji sa dang : bal mo ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du gser bre bdun dang bcas nas brdzangs: rgya gar gser brag bya skyib tu slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka ra'i spyan sngar bslebs: sngar bzhin gyi lo rgyus zhus pas hūm̐ ka ra'i phur pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub skor shog dril gcig la tshang ba gzhan mi khur tsam bcas bskur: slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag tu phul bas dgongs pa shin tu dgyes: yang le shod du sgrub pa mdzad pas zhag bdun gyis yi dam zhal gzigs: de yi tshe sku lus la phur pa rnam gsum gyi go cha bzhes bdud dang dam sri thams cad dam la btags: khyad par klu gyong po sna: bar snang glog ma sprin gnod sbyin rgod ma kha bcas mtha' ru spyugs: lung las stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub gnas mchog tu: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur bus bsgral: gu ru rdo rje gro lod zhes su grags: zhes so: de yi tshe bal yul thams cad bkra shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs pa byung : khyad par btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs shing dpal bsam yas su gsang sngags rdo rje phur pas sa 'dul mdzad pas bsam yas grub: de yi tshe yang phur yid bzhin nor bu ba'am: phur pa yon tan phun tshogs su grags pa'o: de lta bu'i rgyud yang phur bid+yot+ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud la: ye shes snying po phur pa pha yi rgyud: dam pa gsang chen phur pa ma yi rgyud: kī la ya bcu gnyis phur pa sras kyi gnyis ka'i rgyud: rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud:

sangs rgyas rtse mo'i rgyud: rnal 'byor rtse mo'i rgyud: yan lag gi rgyud la: bzlog phur bcu gnyis kyi rgyud: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgyud: srung ma bcu gnyis kyi rgyud do: rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga la: snying po'i rgyud gsum: yan lag gi rgyud bcu: lo ma'i rgyud bzhi: me tog gi rgyud bcu: 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi: ma tshang kha bskang ba'i rgyud do: rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga la: dang po ye shes 'khor lo sku yi rgyud: pad+ma gsang ba gsung gi rgyud: rnam dag rdo rje thugs kyi rgyud do: rin chen 'bar ba yon tan gyi rgyud: ral gri 'bar ba phrin las kyi rgyud: snying po'i rgyud gsum la: mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud: sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rgyud: rin chen phung po'i rgyud: yan lag gi rgyud bcu ni: hūm̐ ka ra ser ba dbab pa'i rgyud: rnam par rgyal ba dbang bskur ba'i rgyud do: dbyug pa sngon po sbyin sreg gi rgyud: gshin rje gshed po las la bzung ba'i rgyud: mi g.yo mgon po bzlog pa'i rgyab rten gyi rgyud do: rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul ba'i rgyud: 'dod pa'i rgyal po pho mo 'gugs pa'i rgyud: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnod byed mtshams gcod rgyud: khams gsum rnam rgyal las drug 'chang ba'i rgyud: stobs po che ser ba gcod pa'i rgyud do: lo ma'i rgyud bzhi ni: rnal 'byor bla med rgyud: bla na med pa'i rgyud: bla ma bla ma'i rgyud: 'jig rten snang 'byed kyi rgyud do: me tog gi rgyud bcu ni: 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud: 'jig rten rab snang gi rgyud: rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud: rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud: gsang ba bsreg len gyi rgyud: ye shes rtse mo'i rgyud: mya ngan 'das pa phyi ma'i rgyud: sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rgyud: rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud: dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i rgyud do: 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi ni: sbas pa ma mo drug brtsegs kyi rgyud:

bswe rgyud dmar po'i rgyud: shwa na dmar nag gi rgyud: rtsa ba 'bum pa'i rgyud do: ma tshang ba kha bskang ba'i rgyud lnga ni: gsang ba gter gyi rgyud: gab pa gter gyi rgyud: lta ba gter gyi rgyud: phrin las gter gyi rgyud: man ngag gter gyi rgyud rnams so: kī la rnam gsum gyi rgyud la: kī la ya dgongs pa'i rgyud: phyi ma rdzogs pa'i rgyud: phyi ma yi phrin las kyi rgyud do: de lta bu rtsa ba'i rgyud dang : sngon byung gi rgyud bcas dpal bsam yas su rgya bod dang mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas gdan drangs pa bcas gab pa mngon phyung gi rgyud do: de yi nang nas lhag tu khyad par 'phags pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gong khug mar grags pa ste 'di nyid rgyud pa nye zhing byin rlabs 'brel ba'i khungs bstan pa ste: jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas: e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': gdams pa sgrub thabs rin chen gter du sbas: rje yi bka' bzhin bdag gis glur blangs pa: ma ning gter bcu sbas pa'i gnas su 'os: bal bod mon kha phur pa bsten pa'i gnas: yang phur gcig dril gdams ngag zab mo'i chos: ma 'ongs 'di 'byin rjes 'brangs grogs lnga 'byung : sa rtags mtha' bzhi'i so kha mngon du mtshungs: dus rtags ru bzhi chu ltar khol bar byed: 'dul zhing 'gro don rong chen bzhi la 'byung : bka' yi chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lngar spel: gnubs ston mthu chen yid la de ltar bcag: zhal gdams thams cad mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhir ltos: man ngag phal cher lung byang gong ma yin:

gdams ngag them med rgyud byang so sor yod: yang mtha'i don du rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum 'byung : rgyas par lta ba klong yangs nam mkha'i mdzod: 'bring po don rdzogs bye brag lde mig gnad: gcig sgril yang phur sbrags ma 'di kho na: de phyir kho mo bdag gis legs par gdams: sa ma ya: zhes mtsho rgyal zhus len gdams pa ste: yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi lo rgyus rdo rje phur pa'i rnam dbye: bka' 'grel ba'i lo rgyus bcas de'i rigs su 'khod pa'o: rgyas pa'i gzhung ni spyi chings nam mkha' mdzod du nges so: de ltar go rim jo mo mkhar chen bza'i bzhed pa grogs lnga la gdams pa'i shog dril ma gu ta'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo ka ma la ni dhi pa ri ti pas me sprel lor mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa sbas yul pad+ma rong gi brag dmar pad+ma shel phug tu me rta lor zhal bshus so// /

༄༅/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba rngam klong rab tu 'bar ba bzhugs so: bla med yang snying 'dus pa dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ rgyal dbang thugs rje rgya mtsho'i zlos gar las: rnam 'dren khyab bdag 'gro ba'i bla ma nyid: lugs gnyis skye dgu'i mgon mchog rgya gar pa: mkhas mchog bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan pad 'byung ngas: ka dag nam mkha'i rgyud sde'i gting chen nas: zab yangs klong dgu rdo rje'i brda tshig bstan: dbyangs can bzhad pa'i dpal mos rab tu zungs: kun 'byung drwa ba 'phrul chen brda ru gzug: gnyug ma'i bzhin bzang thon rtse'i sbubs su sbos: mdog dmar me 'od gdong der gnyer gyis gtad: ma 'ongs gnubs lo gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i: rnam 'phrul rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgyal: rtags ldan dngos ming nges der sprod cig rgya: khyon bzang 'od stong 'khyil 'os sha 'ug thaṃḥ sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: rdo rje'i phreng dbang chen mo bskur ba ni: thog mar bkra shis byin chags dben pa'i gnas: yid 'thad rten 'brel ldan pa'i sa de ru: dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin spyi mtshungs lag len gdab: mchod rdzas zur bkod lta bur rgyas par bkram: phyi nang rgyan dang dbang chen tshang bar bya: las byang la sogs gzhung bsrangs grub pa'i rjes: snod ldan slob ma grangs tshan gang rung la: phyi yi bgegs bskrad khrus stsal me chu bya: de nas gos dkar gyon zhing rgyan bzang 'dogs: dge tshogs legs 'dun rgyas par byas nas su: thog mar dkyil 'khor shar phyogs sgo drung nas: thal sbyar phyag dang bcas te 'di skad zhu: hoḥ ye shes sgo ba dgongs su gsol: bla med yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir: rnam dag smon lam sgo phyes 'tshal: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams 'bar ba drag po'i rigs: pho brang chen po'i sgo skyong ste:

skal ldan srung zhing bdud rigs gzhom: de bas dam tshig bsnol nus sam: slob mas: hoḥ nged rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: yang dag dkyil 'khor gnyan dag la: dad mos gdung zhing 'dun lags pas: 'jug pa'i brda sgo legs phyes 'tshal: de nas rol mo bya zhing bgegs mtshams gcod pa'i ging dkar nag gis rdo thun thogs te: rngam stabs ha ha dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te 'byung po bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa khyed cag skal ldan na: bsgrub la mi dbang gnod byed bgegs: mthar zhing mtshams bcad phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ ging ka ra ging ka ra gnod byed thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ ces thun brdeg cing bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mtshams bcad: de ni dkyil 'khor gnyan por zhugs pa rnams la 'tshe ba'i bgegs bcom zhing rgyud dag pa'i dgos ched yod: dai nas dam tshig ston pa'i phyir yol ba'i phyi nas 'di skad zhu: hoḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bla med yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan bdag cag 'jug smin phyir: gtso bos deng 'dir bka' gnang stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di nyid ngo mtshar gsang ba'i mchog: yang phur sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te: shin tu bka' gnyan dam lci bas: yang dag mos rnams lag tu bstan: slob mas: hoḥ rmad byung dag pa rab 'byams la: bdag cag don ldan cis mi dad: nges don bsgom phyir srog ltar bzung : mi 'da' dam tshig ldan lags so: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag tu rdo rje thogs la: yol ba rnams thugs kyi sgor mos te dbye ba ni: hūm̐: pho brang chen po ye shes dbyings: yang dag rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid: de ring khyed rnams 'jug pa'i phyir: rten 'brel brda yi sgo phye'o: oṃ dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces pas yol ba phan tshun gyi bar sgo dbye:

de nas ye shes lnga'i dar thag ring po'i sne mo slob ma rnams kyis zin te: slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i lam la 'khrid cing : hūm̐: nga ni yang dag slob dpon nyid: deng phyin skal ldan khyed rnams kyang : rig pa rdo rje'i lam bstan phyir: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung nang du shog: oṃ badz+ra dharma dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la dha ra hūm̐: zhes pas nang du khrid nas gral la 'khod: sngon 'gro rten 'brel brtag phyir 'jug pa'i dam chu sbyin: hūm̐: 'di ni rten 'brel ye shes chu: dam tshig can gyis ci ltar gnas: rgyun bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs rnyed: nyams dang ma bsrung dug chur 'gyur: oṃ na ra ya i dan+te sa ma ya: zhes pas sbyin: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis gang mang byin rlabs bya: pho yi lag g.yas mo yi g.yon du 'dogs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dpung par btags pa ni: hūm̐: snying po brtan par 'gyur ba dang : dkyil 'khor 'jug la bgegs bral phyir: gsang ba sngags kyi rgya chings gdab: gnas par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ oṃ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ye swā hā: zhes rdo rje rgya gram bstan: de nas ku sha gtad pa ni: hūm̐: sngon byon rig 'dzin 'phags pa yis: rtswa mchog la ni gdan byas shing : rten 'brel rmi lam brtag pa bzhin: khyod kyang legs pa'i brda de zungs: oṃ badz+ra dharma dzñā na ā li kā li swā hā: de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: maṇ+ḍal lam dkyil 'khor rigs lnga tshang ba zhig gi steng du so shing 'phang ba ni: skyer pa'i shing la mgo bo me tog rtsa ba phur bu bgyis pa smon lam dang bcas nas dor te: hūm̐: bdag lus phung po rnam dag ljongs: drwa bas brgyan par me tog shing : dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul dmigs nas: dor nas rten 'brel gang 'grub ston: oṃ mu la iṣ+ṭa puṣ+pe ye swā hā:

zhes bden tshig dang bcas pas dor bas: me tog dkyil la phyogs na rten 'brel ldan: mgo mjug ldog na skong bshags la 'bad pa dgos: de nas sngon 'gro sgrib sbyong 'bog pa ni: hoḥ bdag nyid sgyu lus snang stong spyi bo'i steng : rig pa skye med dung mdog rdo rje sems: thams cad phyag rgya bsnol zhing snyems ma 'khyud: skyil krung thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: sngags phreng 'khor zhing 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdud rtsis lus khengs bag chags g.ya' bral bsgom: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: hoḥ bdag lus phung po phyi snod ri rab gling : nang bcud dbang po dge rtsa ci bsags tshogs: blos blangs rtse gcig yid kyis 'bul lags na: bdag gzhan tshogs bsags 'bras bu don ldan shog: oṃ i pa gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: de nas sdom pa len pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nus zhe sdang gcod: ma spangs dam srung me long ngang : rin chen nor bus dga' chen ston: ma spangs dam srung mnyam nyid ngang : pad+ma las 'dzin rab tu spyod: ma spangs dam srung sor rtog ngang : rgya gram phyag rgyas mi btang bzung : ma spangs dam srung bya grub ngang : las rab dbang chen sdom bzung ngo : oṃ dharma sa ma ya sha ra ṇa tsit+ta hūm̐: de nas mig dar g.yogs la gral du 'khod: dngos gzhi dbang gzhung la 'jug pa ni: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje'i chu: mos 'thung dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'grub: nyams na na raka chen por ltung : bsrungs pas dngos grub kun thob gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes dam chu 'thung zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dang : yang gsang bla med lha tshogs la: bdag lus dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal 'bul: dngos grub snying po'i don chen stsol: oṃ i pa gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: kyaiḥ khyed rnams skal ldan las 'phro can:

deng 'dir bla med dkyil 'khor bstan: zab pa'i man ngag 'di 'dra dkon: yang dag ngo mtshar che 'di zungs: oṃ dharma gu h+ya badz+ra tsakra satwaṃ: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma la ni sangs rgyas lta: man ngag ye shes lnga ru myong : spyod 'gros sna tshogs chos su mos: dam tshig snying ltar brtse lags so: bla mas: hoḥ ngo mtshar don ldan dal 'byor gyi: las can rigs kyi skal ldan sras: de ring dkyil 'khor bka' rtags 'bog: zab pa'i dbang mchog stsal bgyid do: de nas slob ma bde chen gyi lam la 'khrid pa ni: hoḥ ma rig tshogs gzhom ye shes spyan: theg chen sa mkhan sman pa'i rgyal: khyed nyid zang thal slob dpon te: bdag gi rab rib mun sel stsol: slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la: hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ngang : mi g.yo ting 'dzin zer chen gyi: rig pa'i gnas lugs thur ma yis: ma rig ka dag dbyings su bsal: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: slob mas: kyaiḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor rlabs po che: ngo mtshar yang dag che 'di nyid: sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong bas: don ston ngo sprod gsung du gsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di don gshis lugs ma rtogs na: ngo sprad brtse ba'i yid kyis zungs: 'di ni klong dgu gcig tu 'dus: rang byung pho brang chain por shar: oṃ swa bhā badz+ra dharma hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bshad bya ba ni: hoḥ bla med yang gsang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di: mdor bsdus te ngo sprad pa ni: thog mar pho brang 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin du chags pa ni: rang lus gdod nas ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i brda: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan tog mtshan nyid rdzogs pa ni: chos sku brdal khyab lhun grub yin pa'i brda: phyi nang sgrib med du gsal zhing bkrag mdangs ldan pa ni: longs sku zang thal 'gags med yin pa'i brda: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar nyi zla'i gdan rnams rim par brtsegs pa ni:

srid pa rdo rje gzhon nu yon tan du mas brgyan cing gdod nas brtan pa'i brda: de dbus hūm̐ yig gnas 'gyur te yang dag he ru ka mthing nag tu bzhugs pa ni: chos sku sgyu ma lta bu'i rang rtsal ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzhugs pa ni: byang sems snying rje bskyed pa'i dpa' bo thig le de rang rtsal ḍāk+ki'i rtsa yi sbubs su rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni: longs sku sna tshogs thabs kyis cho 'phrul so sor ston te 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: rdo rje sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis spras te zhabs bco brgyad dor stabs su bzhugs pa ni: sprul sku'i thugs rje nus pa'i gzi byin phyogs ris bral zhing bgrod 'gyu med par sa lam rdzogs pa'i brda: thugs kar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo'i cha lugs dang ldan pa ni: ting 'dzin mi g.yo rdo rje'i ngo bo 'bad stsol bral la yon tan kun rdzogs yin pa'i brda: thugs kar sems dpa' gsum dang ldan pa ni: sku gsum sku lnga rang rtsal nyid las grub pa'i brda: dbu dgu ni theg pa rim pa dgu: phyag bco brgyad grol lam bco brgyad: zhabs brgyad ni yul dang yul can rnam par dag pa: yum dang sbyor ba ni bskyed rdzogs lung bzhi sde snod spyi yi theg pa zung 'jug yin pa'i brda: 'khor du sprul pa'i khro bo phra thabs yang sprul sna tshogs kyis bskor ba ni: chos thams cad mtshan nyid med kyang snang tshul ngo bo grangs las 'das pa'i byed las ston pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha 'dzum pa ni thugs rje'i mdangs: khro bo'i lha gtum pa ni snying rje'i gar: rgyas pa'i lha sgeg pa ni rol pa'i gyad: dbang gi lha chags pa ni bde stong gi shugs: ma nges pa'i lha ci rigs su 'dod pa ni: so so'i 'khrul 'khor te ci yang bsgyur ba'o: de yi phyi rol dkyil 'khor la che ba dgu yi rgyan dang ldan pa ni:

brgyud pa mtho la chos dar rgya che zhing nyi zla dang nam mkha' ltar khyab pa'i brda: gser g.yu la sogs rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni: phyi 'byung rten 'brel legs tshogs du mas brgyan cing dgos 'dod mchog gi dngos grub zad pa med par nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du stsol ba'i brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bag dro zhing gzi 'od mdangs dang ldan pa ni: thugs ye shes kyi dgongs pa 'gro la gzigs shing nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i brda'o: hoḥ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen mo yang gsang bla na med pa'i ngo sprod dgos rigs rtsa tho 'dus tshig gis brgyan nas bstan pa yin te: deng phyin chad bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi don ting 'dzin rnam gsum thob pa yin pas: bka' gtad lung dang ldan par byas so: zhes pas gus 'dud dang ldan te maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo: de nas dkyil 'khor lha la me tog dor ba ni: mtheb srin gyi bar du thogs te 'phang : kyaiḥ bdag gis tshe rabs 'di bar du: sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi: lhag pa'i yi dam lha de dang : rang rang smon lam ldan par sprod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes me tog dor bas gang du babs pa'i gsang mtshan ming btags so: de nas spyi bor cod pan brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dbang rtags phyir: sna lnga'i cod pan spyi bor brgyan: deng nas lha dang skal ba mnyam: rtag tu yi dam 'di zungs shig: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ku mu ṭa dha ra satwaṃ: hoḥ khyod ma 'ongs pa ru sangs rgyas rdo rje'i 'od zer zhes kun tu snang ba ru sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: zhes ming nas smros pa'i tshe len thob cig: de nas phur pa gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rang bzhin las: phrin las kun 'grub gsang phur spro: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'chang zhing dam tshig srog ltar srungs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya kī la ya hūm̐: de nas ma dag pa'i rgyud sbyang zhing dag pa ye shes su ston pa ni:

bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor du ston par bya'o: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: e chos dbyings lhun grub kyi pho brang chen po: de'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag dmar pad nyi ro yi gdan la: hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pas bcom ldan 'das dpal chen yang dag he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag dbu nyer gcig: phyag zhe gnyis su zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas dang ldan pa zhabs bco brgyad dor stabs kyis sa bcu gnon pa: de yi pang du yum dbyings phyug kro ti shwa rī dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad ma rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin nas 'khril cing yab yum gyi sku las bskal pa'i me ri 'bar ba: gtso bo'i thugs kar 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag: dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: g.yas dgu rdo rje gri gug ral gri dbyug to dgra satwa tho ba beng dang gsal shing 'dzin pa'o: g.yon dgu me dpung bhan+dha lcags sgrog zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ sog le 'dzin pa'o: phyag gi mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril zhing dur khrod chas brgyad zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs can: yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs zhal gsum phyag drug ma ste: g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen ral gri: g.yon gsum tshe bum bhan+dha dung dmar bsnams nas yab la 'khril ba: yab kyi thugs kar gsal byed rdo rje: de'i thugs kar yang dag rdo rje sems dpa' yi ge gsum du gsal ba'o: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhir khro chen bzhi: steng 'og phyogs bcur khro bo yab yum bcu: mtshams su phur 'debs nyi shu: phyi rol dbang phyug nyer brgyad: ging chen pho mo bco brgyad sgo srung skyong ma la sogs pa: zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor snang srid thams cad rdul ltar 'khrigs nas 'ja' 'od me dpung gi mdangs dang ldan te byon pas:
skal ldan gyi slob ma khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza dzaḥ ā be sha ya a a tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā:

spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa phur bu bsgrub pa la: ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha: mi 'gyur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ā be sha ya su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: slob mas: hūm̐: chos sku bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med longs sku gdan la bzhugs: oṃ: gnyis med sprul skur phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ zung 'jug bla med mchod pa 'bul: hoḥ bdag gis tshe rabs sdig sgrib bshags: trāṃ: dbang bskur chos 'khor bskor du gsol: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod dang bcas te bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes bum pa ru: snang stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsung gi dbang bskur ba ni: bhan+dha thogs la ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes bhan+dha ru: gsal stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni: gnam lcags kyi mchod rten thogs la: hūm̐: mchod rten chos dbyings ye shes ngang : ka dag gsal stong zang thal nyid: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: gtor ma thogs la ngo sprad pa ni: hūm̐: gtor ma mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : bcud ni bde stong bla med rdzas: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod cing rdo rje rgya gram thogs la: hūm̐: bya grub bla med gsang ba nyid: sna tshogs phrin las phyag mtshan 'di: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas bskyed rim lha yi dbang bskur ba ni: yang dag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen yang dag he ru kaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog rdzogs: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ti shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gsal byed g.yas kyi phyag mtshan zhi ba bzhi bcu thogs la: hūm̐: dbyings rig ka dag ngo bo nyid: rab 'byams zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: dpal chen phyag gi dkyil 'khor te: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan 'bar ba lnga bcu thogs la: hūm̐: zang thal longs sku cho 'phrul nyid: khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: dpal chen phyag gi dkyil 'khor te: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas zhi ba'i rgyan thogs te: hūm̐: prog zhu dar dpyangs cod pan dang : stod g.yogs dang ni rin chen rgyan: ga shal rus rgyan ang rag sogs: zhi ba'i chas kyi dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra rat+na ar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas drag po'i chas kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: dbu rgyan thal tshom khrag zhag thig: zhing glang seng lpags mgo phreng dang : sbrul chun stag sham rus pa'i rgyan: drag po'i chas kyi dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor:

skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan g.yas pa thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje gri gug ral gri dang : dbyug to dgra satwa gnam lcags tho: beng dang lcags kyi gsal shing bcas: g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: oṃ ka ra dha ha na ā yur dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: me dpung bhan+dha lcags kyu dang : lcags sgrog tsit+ta zhags pa nag: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gi sog le bcas: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: oṃ ka ra ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum gyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje bhan+dha bco brgyad dang : rdo rje rin chen ral gri rno: tshe bum bhan+dha dung dmar bcas: khro mo'i phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra ka ra dha ha na ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'di'i mtshams su bka' brgyad dbang ngam gang rung nas dur khrod chas brgyad dbang rgyas par bskur: de nas gsal byed rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba gsal byed pa: mi g.yo rdo rje rgyal po che: rdo rje bla med he ru kaḥ sbyor yum dang bcas dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra rid+dhi dh+riṣ+ṭa pradzñā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yang dag rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje dgyes pa dga' ba che: dang po kun kyang rdo rje'i gzhi: rdo rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ sam+bha badz+ra dzñā na hūm̐ bh+yoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yab yum gyi phyag mtshan thams cad thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje be con 'khor lo dang : bhan+dha par bu dung chen dmar: gri thod la sogs phyag mtshan bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ka ra dha ha na ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas srog yig thogs la: hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo skye med sgra:

rang byung snying po dbyings las shar: dran rig 'od gsal 'dus ma byas: srog yig snying pos dbang bskur ro: oṃ tsit+ta li ṣi ti hri dha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas kī la rigs bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra: las bzhi rtsal las shar ba'i sku: khrag 'thung yab yum kī la bzhi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra karma kī la ya tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khro bo bcu thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: stobs bcu rol rtsal 'gyed pa yi: khro bcu yab yum phra thabs bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ kro ta kro ti tsa tur dā sha hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: rang bzhin gnas yul skyong mdzad ma: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā iṣ+ṭa shwa rī ma kau rī aṣ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo skyong ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: phrin las bzhi yi las byed ma: rngam pa'i sgo skyong chen mo bzhi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan nyer bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las kyi mtha' skyong shan pa'i gzugs: phur 'debs 'bar ba nyer bzhi yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dbang ye shes bzhi sbyor bskur ba ni: thog mar snang stong me long thogs la: hūm̐: ma ni skye med kun gzhi klong : bu ni gsal ba'i rig pa nyid: zung 'jug snang stong 'ja' lus ngang : gzhon nu bum sku'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ rū pa swa bhā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas snang srid thams cad gdod nas gzugs snang lha yi rang bzhin yin pas bskyed rim sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor du bya'o:

zhes maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas sngags dbang bskur ba ni: pad+ma'i phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes chen po'i rlung sgra las: shes rab 'gyu 'ong 'khril shing can: gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dga' bzhi mo: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na pra mo ti maṇ+ḍa dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ des gsang dbang bde ba chen po thob: 'bras bu sngags 'byung 'jug rdo rje'i rang sgra ngo 'phrod nas grags stong drug cu gsung gi rnal 'byor bya'o: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: ma bcos gnyug ma ka dag nyid: gsal stong 'gags med mtha' dbus bral: ye stong nyag gcig zang thal ngang : rig pa bde chen dbang bskur ro: oṃ bhi dho su khaṃ dzñā na shū n+ya te a bhi ṣiñtsa ham̐'u: hoḥ des kun gzhi skye ba med pa rig pa rang gsal gnas lugs ye rdzogs chos dbyings lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i ngo sprod thob ste: dbang thig le mnyam sbyor gyis ngo sprod par bya'o: de nas chos nyid mngon sum gyi ngo sprod ni: hoḥ snang zhing stong la chos thams cad bdag med pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir: gang zhig 'dus ma byas kun rgyu ni rang byung gi rig pa: rtsal ni ye shes lnga yi rlung : stobs ni yang dag pa'i lta ba: byad chen po sna tshogs su 'char ba ni sgyu ma mkhan gyi rtsal bde chen gnyis la kun tshangs su grub cing ngo bo nyid kyis shugs bsdus bya ru chags pa ni thabs: 'phro zhing 'dus ma byas ni shes rab ste: ngo sprod 'khor 'das dbyings rig gsal rdzogs thob pa yin pas: de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur rdzogs par byas so: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: sa ma ya: 'di'i skabs su gsang dbang ngo mtshar bde stong ye shes drug 'dren bskur mos na zur du gsal: med kyang dbang bzhi la tshang : de nas las kyi rjes shes rim pa phrin las bzhi yi sgo nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir: cha lag kha skong gi dbang bskur ba ni:

thog mar gser gyi 'khor lo gtad de: hoḥ deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: 'gro ba lha yi sgra skad du: don ston chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: mtha' yas smin grol mdzad phyir bskul: oṃ dharma rat+na tsakra tu ta ghaṇ+ḍe ye swā hā: de nas dung dkar gtad de: hoḥ bla med nam mkha'i mdzod chen dag: gsang ba dbyings kyi pho brang nas: skye med snying po'i rang sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs ldan par gyis: oṃ rasma lak+ṣa pri ka ha sa swa bhā ga ga khaṃ swā hā: de nas po ti gtad de: hūm̐: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus kun: chig rdzogs rgyud chen 'di ka ste: brjod pas mtshan nyid dpag par dka': nam mkha'i klong mdzod 'di zungs shig: oṃ dharma li khi ti puṣ+ṭa ga ga khaṃ dha ra swā hā: de nas rdo rje rgya gram gtad la: hūm̐: phrin las bzhi yi phyag mtshan te: gang 'dul der ston las 'chang phyir: brda yi rten 'brel rab tu zungs: deng 'dir rjes gnang yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra tsakra dha ra hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa gtad de: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las kyi mtha' sdud pho nya ba: 'debs dang 'bebs pas 'byung por brdeg: sras mchog gyad 'di 'chang bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hom gzar dang thab gtad la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las mtha' bsreg cing bstab pa'i snod: rdo rje'i snod la chos 'byung hom: bskul ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra a ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ de nas gtor ma gtad la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra: mchod pa'i rmad byung ba liṃ rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: dus mchod skong bshags las mtha' zungs: oṃ bha ling+ta sarba pū dza dha ra hūm̐: de nas las chas kyi rdzas gtad de: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa rak+sha'i phreng : thun snod zhwa nag gos nag dang : rus rgyan me long phag rgod mche: dmod pa'i chas dag 'dzin par gyis: oṃ maṇ+ḍal sarba karma tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas srung 'khor gtad la: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la: rang shar pho brang srung ba'i gur: ma dag mtshams gcod 'khor lo phyir: rtag tu bsgom zhing gnas par mdzod: om̐ dzñā na tsakra sa ma ya dha ra hūm̐: de nas mdun du liṅga lan gsum 'gugs la bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ rngam byed 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: spros pa'i pho nya kī la ya: rbad do 'dril 'debs dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra mā ra kī la ya thum ril rbad nan: de nas gtub cing rol ba ni: hoḥ dpal chen che mchog yang dag ku mā ra: 'jigs byed drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rngam yangs bde chen 'khyil ba'i zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs sha khrag lhag med bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: de nas liṅga dum bu gcig me hom du bsregs shing : hūm̐: 'bar ba'i pho brang me hom du: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i bud shing bsregs: bstan dgra sgos dgra'i tshogs rnams kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: om̐ ru tra nṛ tri raṃ dz+wa la ye swā hā: de nas mnan pa bya ba ni: shing tsher ma can gyis byang bur liṅga bris te sgrub khang de yi phyi rol gom pa dgu'i mtshams su mnan cing : hūm̐: mdun du gshin rje'i brub khung du: nṛ tri dam sri dgra bgegs khug: 'chi bdag kha tham khyod la gtad: nam yang ma shor sa ma ya: om̐ nṛ tri dam sri ya ma nan kha tham swā hā: de nas bzlog par dpal 'bar 'dzugs la: hūm̐: dpal chen pho nya rbad pa'i rdzas: mu stegs nag po'i thod pa ru: dmar nag gtor ma rtsang gis brgyan: bskul lo phyi nang rkyen ngan zlog: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: de nas zor 'phang ba ni: hūm̐: rbad pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra:

brnag pa'i dgra srog chod la shog: bzlog med yin no dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: om̐ lok+t+ri pā la ya dgra bgegs ru tra nṛ tri hur thum rbad ya: zor kha ma gyu na bskyed la 'phang : de nas tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje tshe yi pho brang nas: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: om̐ gu ru dzñā na ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor lag tu gtad cing : hūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dag: de ring slob bu khyod la sbyin: rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' gsol bas: dkyil 'khor kun la dbang gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐ ra ye swā hā: zhes dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum bya zhing smon lam btab: de nas rjes shes nyams len gyi dam tshig bstan pa ni: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba thob pa yin pas: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang mi 'bral zhing bsnyen sgrub 'bad rtsol las kyi mtha' sogs phyi nang gi go rim thams cad byed du rung ba yin no: gtso bos ji ltar

bka' stsal sogs brjod: bkra shis bya zhing me tog 'thor: smon lam gyis rgyas gdab: sa ma ya: dbang chen 'di'i bla ma brgyud rim ni: thog ma'i mgon po: mngon 'byung rdo rje sems: mkha' 'gro nyi ma'i rtsal chen: he ru ka rdo rje gsal byed: yang dag ku mā ra: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: mkhas pa shrī singha: slob dpon pra bha hastī: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: e haṃ lo ha badz+ra ste gcig brgyud du bsgyur ba'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: yang zab kun gyi bcud thig bsdus pa'i chos: yang phur snying po gwa'u dmar nag bzhag: bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: las phur dum pa sna tshogs sbas na yang : yang phur gcig brgyud 'di 'dra sbas pa med: de bas las 'phro can gyi don du bzhag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing*/ lha sdings bde chen mngon dga' ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ maṅga laṃ// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i sgos sgrub bzhugs pa lags so: rdo rje gsang ba gtum po ye shes rab tu 'bar ba'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang gtum po ye shes 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs lo rgyus cha tsam bgyis pa kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab pa ste mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi shog ser 'di la gsum mo: spyi don dang po la lo rgyus kyi khungs bstan pa ni: ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo ru: gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje mi shigs pa rab tu 'bar ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe: ri de yi mdun du dza len spu rang sha bya ba'i chu mig nag po byang du kha gyu ba zhig yod de:

de'i shar phyogs su grong khyer chen po bdun yod pa las: grong khyer dbus ma der rgyal po ha ling sha bya ba mu stegs gi chos la dad pa zhig yod pa des: yul des phywa gyer ba'i tshe chu mig de'i gong gi shing bcad nas phywa rten la btsugs yon du khrag mchod: de yi tshe bu su ta ram bya ba'i klu de la phog thug song ba kho rab tu khros nas yul de la klu nad sna tshogs btang : khyad par mdze shu 'brum nag tre tre ho srin glang rgyug 'gyel sogs mang du mched pa'i grong khyer gcig tsam stong par gyur: khyad par mu stegs kyi rgyal po de la mdze nad snying kun bya ba'i nad drag po thebs: de yi tshe mu stegs ston pa gu na tri ra bya ba la phan pa'i thabs zhus: 'jig rten gyi lha la phywa gyer zhing gsol ba btab pas phan pa'i thabs ma byung nas 'chi ba la thug pa na: rgyal po yi mug cing mya ngan chen po shin tu mi bzad pa ri rab kyi dpangs yin kyang zhig nus pa tsam du gyur: de yi tshe nang pa'i drang srong mo lha mo mngon shes can bya ba nags la gnas pa zhig yod pas srod kyi dus su lung bstan pa: he badz+ra pā ṇi satwaṃ: gsang sngags 'chang ba rdo rje'i sku: mi shigs rtag tu rgyal byed pa: klu dang sa bdag gzir ba yi: rig sngags 'chang ba'i nga ro sgrog: brtan dang g.yo ba ma lus kyi: sa rnams rab tu 'jigs byed can: me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: 'byung po log 'dren sngangs skrag byed: ma rig pa yi dpung tshogs 'joms: de la gus dang mos gyur na: klu yi gdug pa nad rnams sel: the tshom bral bar dwang du longs: khyed la phan par lung bstan no: zhes lung bstan pas mu stegs pa chos la mi mos kyang : gtum pos 'dul ba'i dus la bab pas: rgyal pos kyang gsol ba btab ste smre sngags kyi 'o dod bos: de'i tshe drang srong mo yis gsang ba'i bdag po la zhus te: kyai gsang ba'i bdag po chen po rig sngags kyi nus pa 'chang ba lags:

mu stegs kyi rgyal po klu'i nad kyis gzir ba 'di la phan pa'i thabs gsung du gsol: khyad par ma 'ongs pa'i dus su klu srin gyi kha rlangs dar ba la bcos thabs kyi man ngag bka' stsal du gsol: zhes zhus pas: hoḥ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro legs par nyon cig: mu stegs pa'i chos dang bstan pa phan dge'i rtsa lag thams cad 'di ltar du mchis pa yin pa la: 'jig rten pa yis lha klu'i dug mi bsal te: dper na klu kho rang yang 'jig rten gti mug gi rgyu las byung ba yin te: ma rig pas ma rig pa bsal bar mi 'gyur te/ zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i phung po la ri rab chen por gyur pa bzhin: nyon mongs la nyon mongs shin tu mched de 'phel ba ltar ro: dper na mu stegs kyi lta ba ni mngon zhen gyi chos can yin pas sangs mi rgyas: chad lta had po can gyi mjug ma 'chang ba lta bu'o: nyon mongs pa ma rig pa'i rgyu bsags pa'i nad la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas bskyed rdzogs gi don zab mo nyams su myong ba'i thabs dang : shes rab kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i sdom pa'i gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag bdag gis bstan bya ste/ 'chang zhing yid du bsgoms nas rgyal po la bstan par gyis shig ces gsungs nas rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs drag sngags kyi yi ge bzhi po sham bu bcas gsungs pa rnams mkha' 'gro'i brda skad du rgyal po la bsgyur: rgyal po yang rig sngags kyi tshig la dad pa thob nas bsgrubs pas zla ba bdun nas klu nad las grol: klu nag snying kun shin tu reng bar gyur: de yi tshe rgya gar gyi skad du badz+ra nā ga rak+sha be ṇ+ya: bod kyi skad du rdo rje srin po klu 'dul bya bar grags so: rgyal po yid rab tu ches te: gsang ba'i bdag po gdan drangs shing man ngag gab pa'i rgyud mang du zhus: nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs: khyad par rgyal po de'i mnga' thang gis grong khyer thams cad nang pa'i bstan pa la btsud de gsang ba'i bdag po'i 'dul zhing du gyur:

de yi tshe gsang ba'i bdag pos lha mo mngon shes can la gsungs pa rnams mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas dbyings rang byung 'phrul gyi za ma tog tu sbas so: phyi mor bid+yot+ta ma la ru pra bha hastī la bka' bab ste gdan drangs: pra bha hastīs rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung la gnang ba pad+ma 'byung gnas las mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis zhus te: mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas rdo rje phur pa'i cha rkyen du bzhag pa'o: de lta bu'i bsgrub pa la 'jug cing dbang thob pa rnams la yon tan gyi mtshan nyid dpag par dka' ba yod pa ste: ci zhe na: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi bsdu ba gsang bdag gtum: dpa' bo lag na rdo rje 'chang : mtshan thos log 'dren kun kyang sngangs: lcang lo can nam srid rtse'i khyon: 'gengs shing ma lus zil gyis gnon: phra mo'i bgegs tshogs lta ci smos: de bas 'di nyid rab tu 'chang : zhes pa sgrub pa'i go cha bgyis pa rnams: gza' klu dang rgyal po'i gdon sogs gang la yang 'di nyid sgrub pa gtso che ste: phan yon ni: gza' steng grib kha shol nag pos dbang po lkug pa rnams la dar dmar po la mdud pa gsum bgyis nas drag sngags kyis sngags nas 'dogs pas steng gdon 'joms par 'gyur ro: dar mthing nag la mdud pa dgu byas nas nyer dgu la sngags nas 'dogs pas bar gyi sde brgyad spyi'i byad khas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro: khyad par klu nad mdze dmar gyi sna gzhom pa mig bud pa: yan lag chad pa khrag rnag gi rdzing 'khyil ba rnams la yang bskyed rdzogs ldan pa'i ngang la zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas sel bar 'gyur ro: phra mo rnams ni dbang tsam zhus pas kyang sel lo: khyad par 'di la rgyud don gsum yod pa ste: 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha bya ba ni slob dpon mañdzu shrī bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pa'i tshe tshong dpon gyi bu yi don du dgongs pa mdzad: rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul bya ba ni:

klu sog ma med nā gardzu na nam mtsho ka len dzar 'dul ba'i tshe dgongs pa mdzad: bya khyung nā ga klu'i rgyal po bā su ta klu yul du 'dul ba'i tshe dgongs pa mdzad: 'di nyid he ru ka gos sngon can bya ba'i ye shes sprul rgyud dang mthun pa rdo rje ya rtse'i dgongs don dang 'brel ba ste 'di lta bu'i gdams pa dang 'phrad pa ni: skal ba yang rab tu gyur pa'o: sa ma ya: de yang spyi don gnyis pa sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rdzas sgrig chag ni: thog mar dbang lung bka' gtad thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnas dben pa'i zhing bag sgrib chung ba'i yul phyogs su kha gtad pa'i brag phug gam gnam sa chos 'byung 'dra ba ru: dkyil 'khor mthing nag gru gang ba zur gsum pa bya: de'i dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma la: rtsibs drug tu: nā ga: rak+ṣa: bha su: ta ram: 'ub 'ub: chum chum: bya ba bris de'i steng du seng ldeng skyer pa tsher nag gsum gyi mañdzi kha ru mdze snod nang du sha sna sbrul sha sdig srin byang nga nag po'i sha gsum 'thag pa'i phye ma shug pa seng ldeng sbug bsreg gi mar khu bcas phyogs gcig tu sgril la blugs: kha ro sol byug pa'i rdo g.yam gyis bcad: mdze thod ma rnyed na mdze sha thod pa gang rung la byug: sngags thun mtshams su thod rdzas steng du mda' mo rgod sgro ma gsum tshom gyis btegs pa'i kha ru dri bzang gis gtams pa'i chu la sngags 'di: oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha nā ga phe laṃ bi na ya hūm̐ phaṭ: bzlas pa mang du bya la phu btab nas snga dro'i dus khrus bya zhing cung re 'thung : thod sngags 'bum tsho re song nas: lus la lan mang du byug: rdzas rnams nad ma thon par rgyun mi bcad par bya'o: grub pa'i rtags thod pa 'gul lam 'phang ba 'byung : de'i tshe bum pa'i dbang blang bar bya'o: yang na nad thon pa'i rmi ltas sam dngos su 'byung : spyir snang ba ma yengs pa do gal che'o: sa ma ya: de yang spyi don gsum pa lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni:

lus ngag yid gsum shes pa slod pa'i ngang la gu gul du ba bdug ste bag chags kyi 'byung po phral rten bca' ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje dga' ba dgyes par bzhed pa'i tshe: gsang ba yang dag snying po nyams su myong : gang zhig nyon mongs 'khri bas bcings pa'i tshogs: rig sngags 'bar ba'i shugs 'chang des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra dha ra ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐: gnyis pa ni: na moḥ snying rje'i dbang phyug bla med theg pa che: sgom pa spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir: ma nor lam la brten pa'i ye shes che: gsang sngags rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mu la na mo: gsum pa ni: oṃ: phyogs bcu dus gsum gang bzhugs pa'i: skyabs kyi mchog gyur sangs rgyas chos: 'phags tshogs dge la 'dun pa dang : ma gyur 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen rnams: ye shes chen po'i klong nas gshegs: mkha' khyab gdod ma'i gdan la bzhugs: mnyam nyid ngang gis phyag 'tshal lo: kun grol bde stong mchod pa 'bul: thog med 'khrul pa'i bag chags bshags: bdag med rtogs pa'i bstan la bstod: shes rab klong chen rjes yi rangs: don dam mya ngan la gnas shog: dmigs med rgya yan chos 'khor bskor: blo bral dge ba de bzhin bsngo: oṃ badz+ra shrī yaṃ dharma hrīḥ bzhi pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes pas bsang sbyang bya/ hūm̐: e las grub pa'i gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin yangs pa srid pa'i khyon dang mnyam: phyi nang bar med ma lus khyab pa ru: rdo rje char dang me yi ser ba 'khrigs: stong khams kun tu lta bas mi bzod pa'i: rang bzhin g.yo ba drag po'i pho brang dbus: khro chu ngad tsha mthing nag rgya mtsho 'khyil: de nang klu yi rgyal po sog ma med: bā su ta ni me mur nag po'i gzugs: gzhan yang klu rigs ma lus bsnol ba'i steng : dug gi ri rab bang rim dgu ldan pa: tshwa tshwa dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i lte ba ru: rdo rje rtse dgu nag po gyen du langs:

rang bzhin 'phro 'du gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: dpal chen thugs mchog gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: klu srin gshed du nā ga rak+sha'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad pa: rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug g.yas su thogs: g.yon pas 'ching byed sbrul nag zhags pa bsnams: spu gri chu gri'i gshog pa dbyings su brgyangs: thod skam dbu rgyan sbrul nag yan lag dkris: rus pa'i rgyan ldan phur pa'i lan tshar bskyod: lte bar chu srin 'bar ba'i rngam zhal bgrad: sku smad dug sbrul nag po'i mjug ma 'khyil: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i khro chu'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte ba ru: hūm̐ yig mthing nag gsal 'tsher lam me ba: de la bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom: drag sngags me dpung bzhin du mched pa'i tshe: lus kyi phyi nang bar med khyab par khengs: gza' klu rgyal po sa bdag 'byung po'i rigs: bsreg cing bskrad nas gzhom pa'i rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i rtsa sngags 'di snga dro la bzlas: bum sgrub kyi sngags 'di tho rangs bzlas: oṃ badz+ra bā su ki shu dha hūm̐: zhes sngags chu 'thung zhing khrus kyi las chog go: bskyed rim phyag rdor ya gcig gong ltar bum pa'i dbus su bzhugs par bsgom: de'i sku lus las bdud rtsi yi rgyun byung bas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur: 'byung bzhi'i khrus byas pa'i tshe klu srin rnams gdug sems zhi nas lus phyi nang gi nad gdon dang bral bar bsgom: gong gi rtsa bsnyen skabs 'don sgom sbrags te lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan par bya: de nas las sbyor thod sgrub sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha nā ga rak+sha phe lam bi na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'di cha gcig rtsa sngags cha gnyis so: dmigs pa ni: mdun gyi stegs bu gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba'i rtsibs kyi bar du nad gang yin de klu srin bā su ta gzugs su byur po de ran 'thag gi yos 'gam pa ltar phye mar 'thag par bsams:

de yi tshe kho'i stobs nus bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thod pa'i rdzas la thim pas rdzas de bya khyung mthing nag grangs med du gyur nas gshed du babs te hub hub ljib ljib tu za bar bsgom: skabs su bhan+dha de lcags sreg gi gling chen zhig tu gyur pa'i dbus su klu srin thams cad tshud nas gzhob thul gyis bsregs par bsgom: de rnams thams cad res mos su bya'o: bdag bskyed yin pas mchod bsham mi dgos: stobs ldan gyad kyi dpa' bo he ru ka bya ba ste rang shar gyi lha'o: sa ma ya: de yang spyi don bzhi pa dbang gi skabs su 'jug pa ni bum pa sngags phreng rdo rwa 'khor lo dug mtshon gri gug sbrul zhags thod phreng rus pa'i rgyan khyung dug gi ri rab gdol pa pho mo 'bod rdzas gzhi gang rung gi kha ru bzhag nas bsang sbyang bya: thog mar bum sgrub gzhal yas khang gi mtshams su bzla: rtsa sngags gong bzhin no: las sngags thod rdzas la bya: de nas bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang : swa bhā was maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi dang mthun: hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa chen po khyab brdal gyi ngang la ngad ldan khro chu rgya mtsho'i dbus su klu gdol pa pho mo gan rkyal du 'gyil ba'i steng du dug gi ri rab bang rim dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las: 'joms byed khro bo nā ga rak+sha sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad yod pa g.yas pa dgu na gri gug g.yon pa dgu na sbrul zhags bsnams pa: thod skam gyis dbu la brgyan cing rus pa'i lan tshar drwa ba rus pa'i phreng ba spu gri dang chu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs shing : lte bar chu srin rngam pa'i zhal gdangs pa sku smad dug sbrul nag po'i mjug ma 'khyil ba sku la bya khyung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro bas steng 'og bar gsum gyi: sde brgyad 'byung po klu srin thams cad bsngangs yed yed byed pa ste drag tu khros pa'i rnam pa can no:

de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nam rngam drag dpal la dgyes pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal 'byung po 'dul byed rdo rje me 'bar gyi lha tshogs rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min dbyings nas thugs dam bskyed pa'i lha: me ri 'bar ba'i gnas chen dgongs pa mdzad: snying rje khros pas ma rungs zil gyis gnon: theg pa rim dgu'i khro zhal rngam la bzhad: steng phyogs gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bar gdon gzhom phyir sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: gnas drug lam bzhi khebs pa'i rus rgyan la: thogs med mtshon cha drag po'i zar bu 'phyangs: snang srid 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: g.yas dgu'i gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon dgu'i sbrul zhags ma rungs sde brgyad 'ching : thugs rjes mi gtong chu srin rngam zhal can: ma rig 'khrul pa gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: klu bdud 'joms mdzad sku smad sbrul mjug can: 'og gdon 'dul phyir ri rab gdan du 'khyil: gdol pa pho mo 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: ba spu'i dbyings nas bya khyung sprul pa 'gyed: za byed sku la me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro: shin tu mi bzad klu srin 'byung po'i gshed: gsang bdag rdo rje srin po gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i phrin las bskul: oṃ badz+ra dha ra phe lam du ye dzaḥdza: a be sha ya a āḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra satwaṃ: zhes pas brtan par bya: slob mas: kyaiḥ gsang ba'i bdag po khro bo rje: dpal chen rdo rje gtum 'chang ba: bdag nyid dkyil 'khor la 'jug phyir: gtso bos bdag la dbang bskur stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ snying po yang dag rdo rje che: gsang bdag gtum gyi dkyil 'khor la: gus par gyis dang 'jug stsal gyi: de bas dam srung sdom par gyis: sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : bum chu lha dang gnyis su med: bcud ni gsang bdag gtum po dngos: deng 'dir sku yi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe lam hūm̐ phaṭḥ

kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas gsung sngags phreng gi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ 'byin 'jug sgra rnams rdo rje'i gsung : snying po bgrang phyir ma pi ta: dpal chen tshangs dbyangs brgyud ldan phyir: de ring gsung gi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe lam hūm̐ phaṭḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas thugs rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ gdod nas skye med rdo rje'i thugs: 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes che: gsang bdag kun gyi yang snying phyir: de ring thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe lam hūm̐ phaṭḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yon tan 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyug ma'i shing rta ltar: 'du tshan 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can: don rtogs gos sngon 'chang ba yis: de ring yon tan dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe lam hūm̐ phaṭḥ gu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phrin las dug mtsho'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ srid pa'i khron pa dbyug pa'i dug: ma rig g.ya' dag bsal ba'i phyir: dpa' bo rdo rje srin po yis: de ring phrin las dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe lam hūm̐ phaṭḥ gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan gri gug sbrul zhags kyis dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje'i mtshon chas nyon mongs gcod: ma rig nag khra mthar byed pa: rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub rnam pa can: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ka ra ti ka nā ga bhan+dha sa ma ya swā hā: de nas thod phreng dang rus rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rdzas: phar phyin drug ldan rab rdzogs pa: kun tu rtog pa bshig byed pa: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ bhan+dha ku mud ka ri ṭa sa ma ye swā hā: khyung dang dug gi ri rab dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ klu 'dul gnam lcags mchu sder can: myos byed dug gis ri rab 'joms: rtag tu de ltar bgyis pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin:

oṃ ga ru ṭa hā la ma sa ma ye swā hā: de nas gdol pa pho mo dang thod rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ klu bdud nag po gzhom pa'i phyir: myos byed rig sngags nag po'i rdzas: ma rungs gdon la gdab byed 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha nā ga rak+sha phe lam bhi na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas byin rlabs bka' bsgo'i dbang bskur ba ni sku 'bag dang rdo rje thogs la: hoḥ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa rdo rje gsang ba rdo rje dgyes pa lhan skyes rdo rje mi shigs pa rdo rje yang dag rdo rje snying po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje dpa' bo rdo rje gtum po rdo rje khro bo lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po klu dang 'byung po 'dul byed: mkha' 'gro gsang ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig 'dzin pra bha hastī rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs brgyud pa byin rlabs can gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lha dbang lus la bskur bas skye 'chi dang bral bar gyur cig: sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas bgres rgud dang bral bar gyur cig: chos dbang sems la bskur bas bying rmugs dang bral bar gyur cig: tshig dbang don gyi ngo sprod pas dgag sgrub dang bral bar gyur cig: chas dbang lus la brgyan pas he ru ka'i don dang ldan par gyur cig: rdzas dbang lag tu gtad pas klu srin 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig: de ltar dbang bzhi don lnga'i phrin las yon tan rdzogs par gyur cig: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor: gtso bo'i j-i ltar bka' stsal pa: sogs brjod: bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul: bkra shis brjod: hoḥ gsang ba'i bdag po nam mkha'i gos 'chang ba: log 'dren 'joms byed dpa' bo gar sgeg can: rig sngags rdo rje cod pan rab g.yo ba: dpal chen he ru ka yi bkra shis shog:

ces pas gzhan la bdag 'jug bgyis pa'i tshe slob ma lha bskyed stim bcas phyogs gcig go: rang nyid dbang blang na dbang chas sogs mi dgos 'di tsam bgyis pa'o: bum pa sngags phreng rdo rje dang gsum thogs la: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi pho brang dbus: yang dag snying po'i don ston pa: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: 'byung po 'dul byed gtum pa po: che mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: bum pa gzhal yas bdud rtsi lha: snying sngags pho brang rdo rje'i thugs: brda sogs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang : gnyis med dkyil 'khor gcig gi dbang : dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: ye shes chen po'i sku gsung thugs: deng 'dir de ltar bdag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la blang : de ltar go rim phra mo yis las tshogs gdams ngag nyams su myong zhing gsang ba'i bdag po lhag pa'i lhar bgyis pas lha srin sde brgyad gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus te: phyi rabs don du man ngag gdams pa bzhag: ma 'ongs rtsod ldan dus kyi yang tha la: sa steng kun du klu yi dbang byed nas: nad du tre tre ho dang ltar pa dang : srin glang gnam lhog sa lhog gag pa'i rigs: nywa gas sbos 'gas dmar bshal tsha nad dang : btsan 'bam kha shol dmu chu zha grum dang : mdze nag snying kun zhes bya ma rungs dar: de yi dus su gdams pa 'di nyid dang : gang 'phrad yid bzhin dbang gi bdag po ltar: nges par 'chang ngo gdams ngag dwang du longs: the tshom med do gsang rgya khyad par can: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyis tha ma ru: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di me 'od gdong gis srungs:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug brag nas gdan drangs shing sbas yul bdud 'dul sngags gling du me lug lor shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: me bskul gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs so: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang dpal chen gyi phrin las sbyin sreg brtsam pa'i las mtha' sreg byed kyi dbal rtse 'byed pa ni: gzhi shing rtsam mam me zhags la 'os pa zhib mor 'thag pa'i nang du rdzas gu gul: rgya rtsi dug lo: thang phrom re lcag: mu zi ro sol dug khrag gis ngar btab pa/ gri lcags phye ma spru nag /gnam lcags phye ma de rnams bsres nas til snum gyis ran tshod bya: lcags snod dam gang rung du bzhag la: sngags 'di stong tsam gyis byin gyis brlab phyir sngags: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ e muṃ mag trig chum ram trag rak+sha kha thun byad ma 'byung po gnod byed kyi snying rtsa 'gas 'gas he phu lu nan sod swā hā: phu btab nas mi mang gi lag mi 'grim par gtsang sbra bya: de nas rnal 'byor pas dmod chas zhugs nas 'tsham rngam gyi rnam pas 'byung po rnams la 'bar rtse bsnun pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi dkyil 'khor nas: srid dang ma sring rten rnams g.yo ba'i lha: dpal chen yang dag lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: mngon spyod rdo rje gzhon nu dbyings nas bzhengs: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: dpa' stobs khro bcu yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs: sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu dbyings nas bzhengs: las byed phur skyong nyer bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag la dbang bskur bstsal ba'i phyir: 'dir gshegs mi 'gyur ye shes brtan par bzhugs:

rdzu 'phrul shugs phyungs stobs bcu'i rtsal ston nas: deng 'dir drag po dmod pa'i lam brtsam mo: hūm̐: bdag ni dpal chen yang dag sku: khrag 'thung badz+ra kī la ya: sku ni srid rtse'i khyon yang 'gengs: rang bzhin ba spu'i dbyings nyid nas: 'joms byed 'bar ba'i pho nya 'gyed: deng 'dir las kyis me bskul na: rnam pa tsha ngar 'bar zhing mched: ngo bo khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: bzhin ni khro chu khol ma'i ngang : 'od stong 'khyugs pa'i zi ra khol: dmar 'od zhags pa'i 'tshub ma 'khyil: gnam lcags kyu mos chem chem 'gengs: ha la g.yo ba'i dud pa 'phyur: dmod pa dgu yi pho nya 'grims: ngar gyis brlan no rtsal ma zhan: hūm̐: de ring dmod pa'i me zor 'di: steng 'og phyogs bcur ma lus kyi: lha dang srung mar mi rings la: dgra bgegs 'byung por 'bebs pa yin: 'go ba'i chos skyong dpung grogs mdzod: gdab bo dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ yang : lha yi bka' chad dz+wa la ram̐: rgyal po'i smyo 'bog dz+wa la ram̐: gshin rje'i khram kha dz+wa la ram̐: btsan gyi shwa rdel dz+wa la ram̐: ma mo'i yams nad dz+wa la ram̐: bdud kyi zhags pa dz+wa la ram̐: gnod sbyin za kha dz+wa la ram̐: klu yi gtad mnan dz+wa la ram̐: gza' yi byad phur dz+wa la ram̐: sa bdag zha grum dz+wa la ram̐: the'u 'gong phung shig dz+wa la ram̐: rmu yi 'byams nad dz+wa la ram̐: pho gdon gre bo dz+wa la ram̐: mo gdon bsen mo dz+wa la ram̐: dam sri 'byung po dz+wa la ram̐: che sri chung sri dz+wa la ram̐: rgas sri gzhon sri dz+wa la ram̐: dar sri dur sri dz+wa la ram̐: pho sri mo sri dz+wa la ram̐: gri sri 'thab sri dz+wa la ram̐: na sri shi sri dz+wa la ram̐: god sri dbul sri dz+wa la ram̐: rmangs sri mug sri dz+wa la ram̐: phung sri gyod sri dz+wa la ram̐: lo skag zla skag dz+wa la ram̐: zhag skag za skag dz+wa la ram̐: dus skag tshes skag dz+wa la ram̐: rmi ltas mtshan ngan dz+wa la ram̐: mi mthun rkyen ngan dz+wa la ram̐: dgra dang bgegs la dz+wa la ram̐: bar chad bdud la dz+wa la ram̐:

ma rungs sna tshogs dz+wa la ram̐: bskul lo bskul lo da choms shig: mched do mched do da sregs shig: rbad do gzhom pa'i las mdzod cig: rnam par gzhob cig mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan rbad nan bzlog nan: ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka ku mā ra bā dza yā: bigh+nān tshe dang bsod nams kyi bdud thams cad ma rā ya trig nan ram̐ ram̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha bin+dha bin+dha da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas gang du me zhags bya ba'i gru chad ma lus pa yongs su 'gengs par bya: dgos chad yul lam: grong ngam: dgon pa'am: gang zhig 'dre chag che ba'i rigs lung ma bstan pa kun la me zhags 'di kho na zab pa'o: dmigs pa ni: rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga nas spros pa'i khro tshogs nyi ma'i zer 'khrugs pa ltar khengs pa spros nas de las mched pa'i me zhags tshwa tshwa khol ma zlum skor du 'khyil bas: khor yug gang du gnas pa'i bgegs thams cad bya sgro me la reg pa bzhin du 'ub kyis bsregs nas skya tshom me thal ba ltar gyur pa de: slar yang rlung gis bskyod pas mkha' ru spor bas ye 'byams su byos nas ming shul tsam med par bsgom: res me sbar las spros pa'i reg chod kyi rno so gnam lcags kyi zer las grub pa'i phur bus 'bum du gtub pas bsgral zhing ring bar bsam: pha rol bdud kyi gzi brjid me 'obs kyis bskul ba rang gis yod med zung du 'jug par bsgom: de ni dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi skor ro: me zhags grub nas hom khung du me thab tu bsnan: bsrung bya rnam kyang me las bskrun pa'i hūm̐ mthing dmar res mos so: zhes pa'i ngag tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rnam grangs tsam du brjod: rjes shes ni gzhung ltar ro: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rtsa gsum gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o//

// bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: smyo bcos 'byung po mtha' gtad bzhugs so: na moḥ dz+wa la he ru ka ni la sha ya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: srog rlung bcos thabs zab mo bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rlung ltar 'tshub: ban bon shi tshad sdug 'drer skye: srin mo sna tshogs mi ru brdzu: sha za nag po srog ltar zhan: de yi rkyen gyis snying rtsa khol: 'byung 'khrug sems rtsa 'khrugs shing zhum: snying mi dga' zhing 'gro snying 'dod: longs spyod bcud kyang zhu kheng che: sku dgra grib sogs rkyen gyis slong : de sogs smyo 'bog rgyal srin gdon: rkyen ni ma nyes kha yog dang : gnyen bral shi sogs sdug bsngal dang : sdang sems khong khro'i rgyud las byung : khyad par ma 'ongs dus kyi mthar: chos bzhin spyad na bdud bzhin sdang : mi dge sdig spyod rgyas yun ring : de phyir chos bzhin lam spyod dka': phal cher rgyal bsen las dbang 'gro: de dus gnyen po gnad kyi mchog: man ngag gdams pa 'di nyid zab: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dang po lag len bstan pa ni: gzhi ma rgya shog 'jam pa'i ngos: yi ge tsheg med rim bzhin bris:

de ltar za yig nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dis: rgyal bsen 'byung po'i snying rtsa phyungs: dregs pa nyi shu'i za yig 'di gang nas zos na thub pa yin: mtha' gtad ma lus za yig bcas: zab pa'i man ngag mthar thug sa ma ya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing lcags glang lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bdud rtsi bum pa'i za yig man ngag bzhugs so: bla med khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: yang zab gnad kyi man ngag las: gza' bcos bdud rtsi bum pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po za yig bstan pa ni: gza' brgyad gang yin brtag pa'i phyir: sngon 'gro za yig sbyin par bya: nad ngos zin nas mnol 'bebs sbyin: gzhung gi za yig rim par sbyin: de nas gab rlung phud pa sbyin: spyi 'joms dag ni skabs su sbyin: tha ma rjes gcod sbyin par bya: sa ma ya: mun rub za: de ltar las rim spyi bzhin du: rjes dang lag len shin tu gtso: za yig rnams ni mjug nas dril: so yis ma reg za ba gces: gdon tshogs dag ni ma lus kun: myur du zhi gyur the tshom med: mang du ma spel sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: sngags zhwa'i rgyan bkod pha rol rgol 'joms dam pa lags pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: mngon spyod chen po gzi byin me ltar du 'bar ba'i las kyi rim par 'jug pa'i go rim las rgyud spu gri rlung sgrom las byung ba'i slob dpon chen po shān+tiṃ gar+bha zhes dregs pa rdo rje rab 'bar gyi:

rdzu 'phrul sku'i bkod pa me ltar du 'bar ba'i nus pa'i gdeng tshad bskyed pa'i mu stegs rgol 'joms chen po'i skabs su ki kang khyab 'jug las chas bya rog prog zhu nag po zhes dgos chad dang rnam par dbye ba la: sngon mu stegs kyi ston pa skal ldan rgyal po dang hu lu khrag mig dang : na ra ho bhan dang : sha ra thod nag dang : 'bar rtse rtse sogs bdud dang srin po'i rigs las skyes pa dgu'i srid pa ye thub nag po'i ngan sngags bsgrubs: khyad par can khengs log dang rgol ba dpag med kyi sgo nas nang pa'i bstan pa la 'tshe zhing nub la nye bar brtsams pa'i tshe: ho zhes zer ba yang 'dug: phung byed shān+tiṃ gar+bhas rig sngags nag po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: mngon spyod las chas rgyan gyis brgyan: nus pa'i pho nya zor thun brtsams: dregs sde sum cu las la bskul: gza' mchog rgyal po'i dmag dpung bskyed: srid pa'i rgyal mo'i mtshon thun brdeg: dmar nad khrag mtsho chu ltar 'brub: dmag sna shel ging rgyal pos khrid: smyo 'bog rlung ltar 'tshubs par byed: bsad las bshan pa pho nyas bskor: phung yul dgra bo rtsad nas bcad: dmag steng khrag 'thung nag pos mnan: nam yang bstan dgra mi ldang bgyis: de 'og phung lung nag po ru: slob dpon shān+tiṃ ro zan gyis: gnam lcags thog gis mu stegs bsgral: de bzhin snga phyi thog mtha'i bar: srid pa'i las zhwa brtsams pa'i tshul: thog mar bya rog prog zhu ni: rtse mor rog ti nag po la: gnam lcags thog gi rtse mo gzengs: gang la dmod cing ldog med brda: ze ba spu gri me ltar 'bar: srid gsum dgra bgegs gzhom pa'i brda: rngam pa'i spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa la: yi ge rā yis brgyan pa ni: gza' bdud rgyal po mtshon pa'i brda: thod tshal phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar: yi ge raṃ gyis brgyan pa ni: khrag 'thung mngon spyod rdzogs pa'i brda: g.yas kyi gnam lcags 'khor lo la:

yi ge hūm̐ gis brgyan pa ni: gsang sngags pho rgyud 'dus pa'i brda: g.yon gyi gnam lcags 'khor lo la: yi ge bh+yo yis brgyan pa ni: gzungs sngags mo rgyud 'dus pa'i brda: me long lnga yis spras pa la: yi ge āḥyis brgyan pa ni: sku lnga ye shes rdzogs pa'i brda: thod skam lnga yis brgyan pa ni: khrag 'thung rigs lnga mtshon pa'i brda: cod pan lnga yi lan tshar la: yi ge hūm̐ gis brgyan pa ni: ma sring las la bskul ba'i brda: sher sna rin chen lnga tshom ni: yi ge hūm̐ gis brgyan pa ni: dpe dkar las la bskul ba'i brda: glog dang nyi zla'i gru chad la: yi ge ma yis brgyan pa ni: ma bdud pho nyar mngag pa'i brda: dug sbrul lnga yi lan tshar la: yi ge nā yis brgyan pa ni: bshan pa las la chas pa'i brda: rig sngags nag po'i zar bu la: yi ge phaṭ kyis brgyan pa ni: srog gcod nyi khri 'gyed pa'i brda: mtshon cha du ma'i sa pher la: yi ge ya yis brgyan pa ni: ri rab khrag mtsho nyil ba'i brda: sgro thur mdongs kyis brgyan pa la: yi ge dza yis brgyan pa ni: sgrol zhing rnam shes spar ba'i brda: stag lpags ral rgyan spras pa la: yi ge ṭa yis brgyan pa ni: srid gsum 'di na che btsan brda: zhwa lung gnyis dang dar 'phen la: yi ge ha yis brgyan pa ni: snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i brda: phyi nang zhwa yi lta mig tu: bla rdo srog 'khor 'chang ba ni: kun gyis 'gran zla med pa'i brda: de ltar drag sngags dmod pa yi: shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i las zhwa 'di: dang po tshangs pa'i yul nas byung : bar du zhang zhung yul du dar: tha ma shān+tiṃ gar+bha yis: dbyibs dang cha lugs khyad chos bgyis: phyi mo pad+ma thod phreng nyid: seṅge sgra sgrogs skur bzhengs nas: zhwa rgyan chas spras mu stegs bsgral: skabs su bdud po shwa ba zhes: mi sdug dgu yi chas kyis brgyan: sbyor sgrol dur khrod brgyad la mdzad: khrag 'thung sku chas rgyan gyis mdzes:

ma rungs bdud kyi sde tshogs bsgral: de ltar mngon spyod chen po'i zhwa: gyon pas srid gsum g.yo zhing yom: snang srid sde brgyad bran du mchi: las mkhan pho nyas phrin las bsgrub: sngags 'chang nus pa me ltar 'bar: dgra bgegs bdud kyi gshed du che: de bas phyis 'byung sngags pa yis: mngon spyod sna tshogs las spyi dang : dmod pa kun gyi las la bsngags: shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i khyad chos la: 'di ltar 'di dang 'brel ba yi: sngags zhwa dgu yod gzhan du gsal: 'di nyid mngon 'byung sar gnas ltar: khol bur phyung ba mngon rjen phyin: bstan pa'i gsol btod mngon mtho shog: ces pa'i sngags zhwa'i rnam bshad 'di rig 'dzin skyes chen du mas bskul bar brten nas rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas khol du phyung ba'o: brda ni sprin phung lhun brtsegs char gyi rgyun: rtags ni dgos pas brlan pa'i lo 'bras bzhin: don ni mo sham bu yi 'gying bag 'dra: des na 'di yang 'gal med de kho na'o: bkra shis par shog/ // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bdud rtsi bum pa'i bu yig gsal sgron bzhugs so: bla med he ru ka par 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bcud zab mo snying gi thig le las: gza' bcos man ngag bdud rtsi bum pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed legs par zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs bskal pa dus kyi tha ma ru: steng 'og lha srin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs las: dmar bshal tre tre rgyug 'gyel par+pa ta: steng grib nag po kha 'tham snying gzer dang : glog sha 'thib po rtsa la khyab pa sogs: sngar la ma grags nad rigs mang du dar: khyad par lha srin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs las: sngar gyi bcos ka rnams kyis mi phan zhing : nad ngos rtags kyang ma nges rtsa ring 'char: gdon gyi bsgribs pas sman dpyad rim gro rdugs: thams cad rkyen rnams dang po grib las byung :
