de yang grib kyi rnam dbye bshad pa ni: ye nas 'grogs pa'i ma rig nyon mongs grib: tshogs drug gang du shar ba'i rnam rtog la: re dogs rlung khams 'khrugs pa'i rkyen dbang grib: de ni bag chags gzung 'dzin dag las byung : gnyis bsdus rkyen gyis bslang ba'i grib dag ni: sngon tshe smon lam ngan pa'i so skye'i rigs: da lta mya ngan duḥkha smin pa sogs: de las brgyud pa'i gnas dang grogs btsal dang : zas gos mi gtsang la sogs bsre ba yis: lus lha nyams shing 'byung bzhi na tsha 'khrugs: las rlung nyon mongs gdung ba'i rlung log ste: 'phral rkyen bgegs kyi grib rnams de las byung : gsum pa dbyings la 'gyur ba'i gza' grib ni: sgra gcan rlung ga 'khor lo yab yum gnyis: dus dang grangs kyis ma ning sbyar ba'i tshe: rlung lnga nyon mongs 'khrugs pa'i gza' skar dag: ma rungs mkha' yi 'byung po'i sna khrid nas: gang dang gdong thug 'phrad pa de dag ni: dug gi rlangs pa ro rkyang dbu mar zhugs: rlung rtsa khrag rtsa go ldog srin rtsa 'gags: dug gi rlangs pas srog 'dzin srin bu myos: rtsol med brgyal dang rtsol bcas lus la zhugs: rlung rtsa'i nang du khrag 'debs srin bu myos: mig rtsa khrag mdog g.yo dang lus kun khol: sha rnams 'phar dang dmar nag ri mo 'byung : srog 'dzin dus su kha phye khrag rnams zag: dbu ma'i gzi 'od bcom nas mgo 'khor zhing : res 'ga' tsha 'ub dang bcas dran med 'gyel: srog rlung khrag rtsar chud pas kha yang lkugs: sa rlung dug dang 'dres pas lus rnams 'dzin: me rlung khrag dang dug 'dres gzhog g.yas 'dzin: chu rlung khams dang dang dug 'dres gzhog g.yon 'dzin: rlung gi dug chen langs nas khyab par rgyug: las rlung srog rtsar dug 'dres tshe dus byed: cha byed che chung ma snyoms zha rengs 'byung : de sogs grib kyi rnam dbye'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de ni ngos bzung bya zhing bcos thabs bstan:

snying dang mgo la phog pas dran med 'gyel: srog rtsa btung zhing ltag gzer lkugs pa na: zer ma rgyug pa pa sangs rlung gi gza': de la 'ching byed ma bu'i gdams pa gces: g.yas pa gzer ba nyi ma mig dmar gza': de la khro chu rgya mtsho'i gdams pa gces: g.yon du gzer ba zla ba lhag pa'i gza': de la zangs mkhar dmar po'i gdams pa gces: rus bzhi na dang khyab cing lci ba ni: phur bu pa sangs gza' ni ces kyang bya: de la phyung rdeg spu gri'i gdams pa gces: skabs su na dang phyi dro snying mi dga': res 'ga' don med brgyal dang gdon kha che: de ni rlung la khyab dang gdon grib gza': de la gza' bdud ma bu cha dgu gces: kha tham ring zhing dbugs sdud steng grib gza': de la par bu bdun dang gzer bu gces: dang po sngon 'gro nad brtag za yig sbyin: de nas mnol 'bebs rdzas dang za yig sbyin: de nas 'ching byed zhags pas dam por bsdam: dus drug la sogs rang rang rgyun ltar sbyin: rjes su bcad dang srung ba legs par 'dogs: sa ma ya: de nas rdzas kyi rnam dbye bstan pa ni: gza' brgyad dug dang klu dug btsan dug dang : khyi dug spyang dug ra dug phag dug pa: thang dug pa dang zangs lcags sbyar ba'i dug: nyi zla sa dang bar snang glog gi sa: sprin nag sa dang skar ma rgyas pa'i sa: pho rog sa dang nyi shu dgu yi sa: de rnams rdzas kyi rlan btab legs par byug: ar nag shu dag nag dang gla rtsi nag: shing kun mu tig nag dang bong nga nag: gu gul spru ba nag dang rgya snag dang : mi nag rta nag khyi nag bya nag khrag: phag nag dom nag sbrul nag sbal nag dang : g.yag nag ra nag spyang nag sram nag khrag: rdzas rnams za yig srung ba dag la byug: khrag sna de dang rdzas gnyis mnol 'bebs bdug: sher shing ar nag skyer nag tsher ma nag: gton te zam shing khu ba bskol nas btang : bong nag chos can khu ba dang sbyar bya: lus la byug cing yi ge mang du gzugs:

khyad par mi dgu spun gsum shin tu zab: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i yang snying mthar thug las: gza' bcos bdud rtsi bum pa'i lag len bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bog yig tu zhal bshus so// // bla med yang gwa'u dmar nag las: me dbal dbyug to'i bskyed rim bzhugs so: badz+ra ku la raṃ raṃ dz+ra ḍan+ḍa ye gar+bha: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: ma 'ongs 'gro la rab brtse phyir: me dbal dbyug to'i gdams pa bzhag: dbyangs can brda yi yi ger zungs: khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: mi phyed rgyal 'gong gdon gyis zin: snying 'khrug rten med smyo 'bog 'gro: rgyal 'gong gre bos bsdo ba yis: pho rnams yas gdon tshogs kyis zin: brtan ma sha zas bsdo ba yis: mo rnams mas gdon snying rlung 'phyo: ma nges 'byung po 'tshub pa'i dus: 'joms byed gnyen po'i gdams pa ni: me dbal dbyug to 'di nyid zab: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po bskyed rim man ngag ni: mi mang 'tshogs gnas ma yin pa'i: ku sgra dben pa'i gnas dag tu: smyo rgod yin na phur pa ni: dbang chen drag por lnga tsam gdab: yan lag gzug bzhi dag nas brgyang : gzhi bdag rnams la phrin las bcol: rang nyid dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: lag tu rdo rje phur pa thogs: gtum chen drag po'i nga rgyal gyis: 'gugs shing bsgral dang ar gtad bya: sa ma ya: drag po'i dmigs pa zhal las shes: rang nyid dran rdzogs lha bskyed ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dzaḥ stong pa'i ngang las snang srid dur khrod dbus: rtsub 'gyur 'khrugs pa ti ra baṃ gyi steng : rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: 'jigs byed mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa:

khro gtum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing gshe: bdud dpung zil gnon g.yas gnyis rdo rje gdengs: nyon mongs 'joms byed me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ 'bar: mtha' gnyis stobs ldan ri rab phur bu bsgril: sgro gshog me 'od tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu shigs se shig: 'chi bdag 'joms byed rgyas 'debs pang du 'khril: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum zil gnon he ru kaḥ me rlung dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan a mu ka gzer thum hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: yab yum thugs las sprul pa'i sras chen bzhi: khrag 'thung 'jigs byed sde bzhi 'khor bcas kyis: gnod byed 'di yi yan lag lnga nas sdoms: mnan cing gzugs phung 'di la da rol cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya a mu ka trig nan mā ra ya du satwaṃ bha ya nan: oṃ pad+ma kī li kī la ya a mu ka trig nan mā ra ya du satwaṃ bha ya nan: oṃ rat+na kī li kī la ya a mu ka trig nan mā ra ya du satwaṃ bha ya nan: oṃ karma kī li kī la ya a mu ka trig nan mā ra ya du satwaṃ bha ya nan:

de'i don las bzhi shes par bya: de nas lan gsum gyis 'gugs shing thun brdeg pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sarba bigh+nān a mu ka trig nan: gnod byed 'byung po rgyal bsen rnams kyi tsit+ta brlag brlag mā ra mā ra gzir nan: 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog rtsa 'gas 'gas: a mu ka rak+sha tri ta kha thum nan: a ka wa tsit+ta shag 'gas myog myog: 'byung lnga'i dug chings nṛ tri a mu ka kha thaṃ ha la ha la nan: khaṃ tri ya ma snying la dum dum nan: raṃ tri ya ma snying la dum dum nan: a mu ka mā ra trig sha trig thum nan zlog zlog: ces drag sngags bzla zhing thun gyis brab: de nas las kyi phur bu gnas lngar tshad de: hūm̐: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs sku: sras mchog srid pa'i ri rab kī la ya: ye shes 'jig rten kun gyi nus stobs rtsal: gnam lcags dbal dang ldan pa'i pho nya che: smyo 'bog snying gzer gdon la kī la ya: byad ma lkug cing rdul du brlag par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan a mu ka gzer thum spur thum myog thum ha la ya ha la ya mā ra tshin+dha shig shig: a mu ka du na pa tsa pa tsa nan: ra tsa tsit+ta shag 'gas hu lu hu lu thuṃ thuṃ: nan nan bhu ta mā ra rmug rmug: dzi wī tra tra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gnas lngar btab: de nas las kyi dbyug pa thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga nyid che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: rab khros 'jigs byed me dpung 'u ru ru: phyag g.yas 'joms byed 'bar ba'i dbyug tho phyar: g.yon pas bshig byed rdo rje be con thogs: mi bzad brtul zhugs gar gyi 'gying bag can: smyo 'bog 'byung po 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsal: hūm̐: 'joms byed rdo rje 'bar ba'i be con gyi: mtshon cha drag po gnam lcags thog ltar 'khyug: gdon bgegs byad ma'i bshang lam srog rtsar zhugs:

drag sngags me'i dbyug pas so 'thab brdung : lus kun chem chem khro chu lta bur khol: brdungs pas bsgral bsregs gtor zhing phye mar brlag: gzhom zhing btul te ming yang med par byas: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ḍan+ḍa baṃ a mu ka trig nan bigh+nān mā ra du na myog myog rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces sngags dang sbrags nas dang po chung ngu dang de nas rim gyis je cher brdung : cung zad skrang pa dang bzhag nas zhal bstab bya: rnam shes spar nas go rim shes: hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: 'byung po 'dre rgod dug lnga'i sha khrag 'bul: bzhes shig lhag med dgyes par rol: oṃ sarba bhū ta a mu ka'i sha khrag la kha kha khā hi: zhes pas gtub cing 'bul: de nas gnas rnams yi ge gzugs: za yig sbyin te langs par bya: sa ma ya: zhag gsum mam bdun du smyo tshab che chung gi: mtha' phur pa 'debs lugs bya: dmigs pa rgyas pa zhal las shes: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: man ngag dbyug pa smyo 'dul bzhag: zab pa kun gyi mthar thug ste: ma spel gsang rgya dam par gyis: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bu yig rdzas kyi man ngag bzhugs so: badz+ra ni la sid+dhi ma hā ku mā ra pu ru sha ya hoḥ sa ma ya: dang po rdzas kyi lag len bstan pa ni: rgyal po dang ni sde dpon rnam pa lnga: dpa' bo dgu dang dug gi ral gri brgyad: bsad pa'i snying dang nus ldan ma bcos chang : srog med sreg tshe ma shi'i rus pa dang : 'dab chags gtsug phud snying dang rak+ta dang : sa 'og seṅge rgya mtsho'i seṅge yi: rus pa dang ni khrag dang snying bcas pa: bud med shi pho'i snying khrag skra dang ni: 'dab chags snying dang mche ba srin po'i mchu:

rus sbal smug po'i sha dang rwa co dang : so bdun po yi rdzas de legs par byug: ha ri dra yi shing la lus yig gi: sngags rnams rko zhing lus la khyab par gdab: skabs su mdun ma hā mu ka ra daṇ+ṭin lam hal gar+bha ye: sa ma ya: me dbal dbyug pa'i gdams pa ni: dang po gang du nad rtags dpyad: snying rlung la sogs gdon yin na: nad pa shin tu dam par bzung : khrag gzer stod nad ltar 'dug na: nad pa kha sbub dag tu bzung : sgal tshig bdun gyi mtshams nas brdung : srog rlung dran pa mi gnon na: nad pa gan rkyal dag tu bzung : brang lhe sor bzhi'i mtshams nas brdung : shes pa rmug cing snying mi dga': mun 'thib gnyid bro 'dra ba ni: nad pa gzhog g.yon sa la phab: g.yas kyi rtsib ma lnga'i mtshams su: grang ba'i chu yi chag chag gdab: re zhig bar du chung ngu brdung : yam yam 'phyo 'phyo 'dar ba dang : kha so khrag khrag byed pa na: nad pa'i gzhog g.yas sa la phab: rtsib ma drug gi mtshams su ni: dang po phye phur cung zad brten: de nas chung ngur brdung bar bya: yid 'phyo kha 'chus dran med na: dang po stod nas smad phyogs su: rgyangs par 'phur zhing lan gsum brdung : de nas gsang lnga'i mtshams nas brdung : go ldog lan gsum cung zad sprug: de yi snying rlung gegs kyang sel: de nas dpral bar gri khrag gis: gnad kyi yi ge legs par gzugs: de nas rim bzhin za yig btang : rjes gcod me dbal 'khor lo 'chang : rdzas dang gnad gzer me btsa' dang : byug pa la sogs las gzhung bzhin: legs par bgyis pas smyo 'bog kun: nges par byang bar the tshom med: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs// // bu yig gud du sbas pa bzhugs so: gu h+ya pa ti la sha ni lam ro kha ku mā ra ya gar+bha na mo: sa ma ya: a ru ra dang zho sha rnam pa dang :

nag po dgu dang gza' brgyad ldum bu brgyad: gri snying dri chu gza' 'dzin chab rom dang : khyim bya'i snying dang khrag bcas byi ba'i snying : sbal pa'i sha khrag yugs sa'i mngal khrag dang : than bya'i snying dang mche ba 'ug pa'i mchu: sdig srin dang ni skra shad bcas pa bya: de yang rtogs pa thugs rje mtho dman la: cung zad phri ba slob dpon zhal las shes: sa ma ya: skyer pa'i shing la rdo rje phur pa yi: lus yig bkod pa legs par bris nas su: gzer thig dag bcas rgyugs lam kun la gdab: yig rgod bzhi yang de bzhin shes par gyis: spyi chings sde brgyad rnams ni skabs dang bstun: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gza' bcos bdud rtsi bum pa'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so: bla med he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: dang po drang srong sku'i 'khor lo ni: phyi ru sgra gcan kha sbyor bya: dbus su khyab 'jug lte ba ru: gnas rnams yi ge 'khrul med bris: phyi rol rdo rwa mig gi phreng : me rlung dang bcas rgya chings bya: ri bong 'dzin gyi bri thabs ni: ri bong sgra gcan 'dzin gyis bskor: ku mu ta la'ang de bzhin no: tsak+ṣu dmar po sbrul gyis dkris: rigs lnga me yi 'khor los dkris: 'dems rib dag gis bskor: pen chu'i zhags pas bskor: pa paṃ ral gri 'khor los bskor: thams cad ma yig bu yig sprad: mig dang me rlung drwa bas bskor: gnas gnon mig dang rdo rwas bskor: bsreg pa de yang rdzas dang sbyar: sa ma ya: spyir yang gab dang zhal shes mang bar yod: slob dpon med na lag len smon srid kyis: phyi nang log na reg phung dug dang 'phrad: de bas slob dpon zhal la legs par bsten: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: pad+ma gter bdag gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// ྀatsha: bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: khyi dug bcos pa'i zab rgya gzer thig bzhugs so: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: khyi dug nag po bcos pa'i thabs: gud du sbas pa'i gzer thig bstan: dbyangs can brda yi ri mo'i gzugs: yi ger thob la gter su sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po dug brtag za yig ni: spyi rgyud nang ltar shes par bya: mnal 'bebs dang ni dug chings gnyis: dug gnon rjes gcod las sbyar sogs: gzhung tshig 'khrugs sogs shes par bya: sa ma ya: zan sho rnams la man ngag lag len shes: e ma yang zab man ngag gnad kyi gzer bu las: khyi dug bcos pa ha la stobs 'joms bzhag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dri bsung zhing khams kun khyab dkon mchog mchod sprin bzhugs so: yang dag rdo rje bde chen rol pa'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdud rtsi bum pa'i yan lag bdun pa las: dri mchog ngad ldan dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin: zhing khams kun khyab rmad byung khams lnga'i dpyid: mthong ba gang zhig mtsho yi pad+mo'i tshal: ze'u 'bru ge sar shin tu legs bzhed pa: rnam dkar dag pa'i blo yi nyer 'tshe nas: du ba'i zer dang lhan cig yid gar skyes: mchod pa'i sgeg mo gaṅgā'i bye ma bzhin: sna tshogs mchod pas 'phags pa'i srid zhing kun: dgyes pas don gnyis bde dga' rgya mtsho'i dpal: go 'phang mchog tu myang 'das kyi: sa bcu rgyun gyi rtse mor rab bsnyegs nas: phyir ma'i 'jug pa 'bras bu ye shes che: bsod nams bgrangs pas 'dzin mar legs bsgyur te: sku gsum sa bon nges thob sha stag go:

des na kho mos yi ger rab bgyid do: dus dang mtshan rgyu dbang mos de srungs shig: sa ma ya: e ma: zhing khams phyogs bcu'i zhing dang nye ba'i zhing : kun kyang chos sku'i klong du tshogs pa yi: rtsa brgyud brgyud bcas bla ma rig 'dzin dang : yi dam chos srung mkha' 'gro nor gyi bdag: dam can gter gyi bya ra dregs pa'i tshogs: 'khor bcas kun tu gnas pa ma lus kun: dbang rten lnga la nye bar 'khor ba ste: tshogs drug gar mkhan lag dang mi gang ba'i: 'khrul 'khor de yi rta la kun kyang bskyod: des na skye 'gro nyi zlar dad pa bzhin: dri bsung mchod sprin 'di la rag las pas: dus dang gnas skabs rgyu rkyen rten 'brel bcas: kun tshang phra zhib ma 'dres so so yi: khrigs bsdebs tha dad ngo bo 'di ltar bstan: mos gus rgyun chags brtson 'grus go cha can: shes rab phra mo'i mi zum lag len can: lta spyod spyad la mkhas pa'i gang zag gis: dri mchog sbyor ba 'di ltar bgyis par bya: sa ma ya: thog mar bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa yi: sangs rgyas dbang po'i ngo bo gang de dag: mchod cing dgyes par byed pa'i spos sbyor ni: rab la tsan+dan dkar dmar zhib tu 'thag: brdar zhib 'jam pa'i phye ma rab tu bcos: 'bring la rgya shug dmar po rtsi can dang : tha ma shug skya dag la bzo bar bya: de la tshogs pa'i dri zhim ngad sbyor ni: bsil drod snyoms par bya ba'i lag len la: rgyal po a ru ra ni bdun nam la: li shi tsan+dan dkar po ba lu dkar: spos dkar sum cu tig la lnga nam re: dzā ti tsan+dan dmar po tang kun dang : spos shel dang ma bcas te bzhi nam re: sug smel ga dur gu gul brag zhun dang : gur gum ru rta dag ni sum cha re: ka ko la dang spang spos chu spos dang : gla rtsi bya rgod spos la gnyis cha re: ga pur dang ni ar nag lug mur dang : brag rtsi dmar po dag ni cha gcig go: shing phye dag ni lnga gsum bskor ba'o:

yang na lnga lnga dag ni shes par bya: de la drod sbyor bu ram lnga gnyis bskor: bsil sbyor sbrang rtsi dag ni lnga gnyis sbyar: snyoms la zung 'jug dag tu shes par bya: ka ras bsdus pa shing tsha se 'bru yi: drod sbyor phab tshad dbang lag chu yis sbrus: nam zla bsil drod blo yis dpag pa yi: zhag bdun nam ni zhag bzhi'i bar du bsnyal: yang na langs rta phra mo rgyab bam ci: gar chang snying po sbrus kyang rung bar shes: dri bsung 'khyil tshe ngad pa thon nam blta: thog mar ngad ldan sreg tshe dri zhim 'gyur: de la spos ring ngam ni ril bu dang : phye ma bya'am rang rang blo yis dpag: 'di ni zhing khams kun khyab bya ba ste: rig 'dzin rgyal ba mnyes pa'i spos sbyor ro: dri zhim mchod sprin 'di dag gtams pa'i tshe: phyogs bcu sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs 'ur: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba the tshom med: gnyis pa de las bsdus pa'i kha tshar ni: nā gi thun gcig shing mngar thun gnyis dang : gi wang thun gnyis li shi thun phyed gcig: dug mo nyung bcas thun phyed zhib tu 'dod: de yi spros pas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi: dpa' bo he ru ka yi lha tshogs rnams: dgyes pas rang bzhin shugs kyis 'grub par 'gyur: gsum pa de las spel ba'i kha tshar ni: rgya skag 'bri mog btsod rnams cha gnyis la: rgya mtshal ma nu spang rtsi de ba dang : pad+ma ge sar nā ga ge sar dang : sba 'bras smyug 'bras dag ni phyed cha re: de yi bskyed pas ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rtag tu 'du zhing sgrub pa'i grogs su mchis: bzhi pa de las mched pa'i kha tshar ni: chu shing nag po dang ni myu gu'i shing : spru nag phur mang dang bcas cha gnyis la: gri tshil 'brong tshil bya rog tshil lu dang : glang chen smyon pa bong nga dkar po bcas: thams cad 'tshogs pas thun phyed zhib tu 'dod: de dag bskul bas ye shes mgon rigs dang : zhing skyong legs ldan lha mo dpal 'bar ma:

chos skyong ma lus dri mchog ngar la chags: rtag tu bu gcig ma yi brtse ltar skyong : lnga pa de la spyod pa'i kha tshar ni: rdo rje mchu dang chu srin sder mo dang : ba le ka dang thal ka rdo rje dang : sle tre skyer 'bras bcas pa thun phyed gcig: bya rog snying dang byi la nag po'i sha: ra tshil stag gi sbar mo rtsa sprag 'bras: thams cad bsdus pa phra mo tsam zhig btab: de la shugs kyis ma bza' rdor legs dang : 'bar ba btsan sogs drag po dam can rnams: thugs dam dbang gis skad cig nyid la 'du: drug pa de la gzhol ba'i kha tshar ni: byi tang ka dang rtsi tra 'u su dang : ti mu pa dang tig ta na le sham: rtsa mkhris mañdzi ra dang sdo ma nam: a 'bras 'jam 'bras bsam 'bras sha 'bras dang : zi ra dkar nag khab len rdo dang ni: gser dngul mu tig byi ru drug dkar g.yu: ba dkar 'o ma dang bcas phra mo bsres: de'i dzam lha nor bdag dkar phyogs kyi: dngos grub dbang ba'i lha tshogs sprin ltar 'du: bsod nams dpyid kyi 'bras bu char bzhin 'bebs: bdun pa de la sbyor ba'i kha tshar ni: smug po sbal rgyab gang thig cu gang dang : shug tsher sro lo a krong a byag dang : til dkar til nag hong len so ma ra: bya pho'i snying dang mgyogs pa lag ring lce: dur bya'i mchu dang sprel snying khrung khrung sder: de rnams tshogs pa phra mo tsam zhig bsre: de dag brten pas ngad ldan phreng ba yis: gter srung bya ra sngon gyi dam tshig can: dregs sde myur mgyogs ma lus dgyes pa bskyed: phrin las bka' yi bya ra glog bzhin 'gyu: de phyir spos sbyor man ngag gnad du che: gzhan dang bye brag spos kyi rnam dbye ni: bgegs srin tshar gcod gu gul thang phrom dang : ra dug me tog seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa dang : ke tshe shang tshe spru nag rta bon bcas: brgyad 'gyur ngar che'i dud pa btang bar bya: sbyang byed rnams la spra ba ba lu dang : gu gul shing kun gla tsi shu dag nag:

btsan dug tsher nag shing bcas brgyad 'gyur btang : spyan 'dren mchod bstod dag gi gnas skabs su: bzang po drug gi nus pa brgyad 'gyur btang : bskul las tha ma'i dus su bab pa'i tshe: drag spos sha khrag sna tshogs kha tshar btab: de rnams dgos chad drag las dus su bya: gzhan yang sgrub pa po'i las rim ni: spyi yi spos sbyor rgyun chags mchod par bya: dgos su skabs skabs rang rang kha tshar btab: so so'i rgyud bzhin spyan 'dren skabs su gces: gtsug lag khang dang nad pa 'dre can sogs: rab gnas bya'am bgegs bskrad bgyis pa'i tshe: nag po dgu sbyor rdzas kyi kha tshar btab: de ni bgegs srin tshar gcod dag la bsngags: de yang so so'i nus pa cung bstan pa: a ru ra mang nus pa 'phel zhing rgyas: li shi mang na dri ga shin tu mngar: tsan+dan dkar dmar ka ko la mang snum: dzā ti spos dkar sum cu tig dang ni: tang kun spos shel mang na nus pa che: sug smel gur gum gla tsi ga pur dang : lug mur brag rtsi mang na nus pa g.yo: brag zhun ar nag spang spos chu spos dang : ba lu bya rgod spos dang gla tsi yi: dri ma ngar zhing shin tu nus pa che: sbrang dang bu ram rtsi mchog mang na mngar: dbang lag ra shug dam rtsi ran tsam bya: rang gzhung rdzas sman dag ni rab tsam btab: gar chang dwangs ma yod na nus pa che: khyad par tshes bzang rnams su brtsam par bya: kha tshar rdzas kyi nus pa bslad gyur na: ril bu bsgril kha dag tu zhib 'thag btab: gzhung la thog mar bsre zhing bsnyal bar bshad: 'dam thag byas nas nyin gcig legs par brdung : de yi dri bcud thams cad gcig tu 'dres: shin tu gtsang zhing grib kyis ma gos bya: nus pa mi nyams sgrom mam ras nang dril: dus ma yin du bcal bkram mi bya 'chang : sa ma ya: lnga lnga'i sdeb sbyor nyi shu rtsa lnga 'di: rje 'bangs nyer lnga tshogs pa'i khyad chos yin: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis legs par bsdus: phyis 'byung bstan 'gro'i bsod nams dpyid du bzhag:

snyigs ma lnga bdo rtsod ldan yang mtha'i dus: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' 'di bya ra dus kyi dbang mos srungs: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin gzhom pa'i dri bsung rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang gdon srung dgu sbyar ma nges bar: khol phyung bgyis nas cung zad smra bar bya: rgya gar sman gsum rgya nag sman gcig dang : bod kyi sman lnga bcas pa legs par bshad: brgyud pa 'di bzung sman mchog byin gyis brlab: a ru ra dang

dga' rab rdo rje shing kun 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rgya snag shrī singha gsum: bong nga ngar bzang ma hā gu ru gu gul man+da ra ba gla rtsi ye shes mtsho rgyal gsum: shu dag bo dhi sa twa spru ba nag po khri srong lde'u btsan mu zi sangs rgyas ye shes gsum: mtshon cha sna dgu spu gri phyung rdeg yin: dri tshor tsam gyis 'byung po'i klad khrag skem: 'go nad la sogs nad gdon spyi la bsngags: dus min gar thod sa ru bsreg mi bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ye shes gar gyi dbang phyug khrag 'thung gnam lcags rdo rje rol pa rtsal gyis mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bla med yang gwa'u dmar nag las: srung bzlog bsad pa'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang srung bzlog bsad pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni: dang po srung ba bri bar brtson pa la: shin tu 'jam pa'i dar ras sam: ma rnyed shog bu dkar 'jam la: bri ba'i snag tsha gser dngul dang : yang na rgya snag dag la ni: bzang po drug gi sman yang sbyar: spyi yi sgrub rdzas rnams kyang byug: 'bri tshe zhal kha byang la gyu: gdan gcig kha la rdzogs par bya: sa ma ya: dang po lte ba chos 'byung rdo rje ru: hūm̐: badz+ra: prañdza: bh+rūm̐: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: oṃ rat+na kī la ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: oṃ pad+ma kī la ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: oṃ karma kī la ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: bhirba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: a pa ra wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: ru ṭa sarba mā ra ya phaṭḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rol rtsibs drug la: oṃ bud+dha ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ rat+na ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ pad+ma ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ karma ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ karma ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍāk+ki hūm̐ phaṭḥ phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ ro ṣa ṇa maṇ+ṭa dha mañdza na ma hā sa ha shrī he ru ka badz+ra ku mā ra a pa ra tsit+ta gar+bha ma ma pa ti bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bcu la: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī laṃ dan+t+ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ de yi rtsibs mchan la: dza ya bha ti ye rak+ṣa: badz+ra ma la ye rak+ṣa: dzñā na ha sa ye rak+ṣa: uṣ+ṇi ṣa ye rak+ṣa: kriṣ+ṇa ṣa ye rak+ṣa: te dz+wa rā dza ye rak+ṣa: pad+ma a ta ye rak+ṣa: badz+ra kai ma ri ye rak+ṣa: a haṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ye rak+ṣa: prañdzā sūr+ya ye rak+ṣa: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra ku mā raṃ raṃ artsi dz+wa la ma hā ak+ṣ+yo bha man+t+ra su bha ga a pa ra tsa na raṃd+dhi ni hi ma hā ma ma pa ti sarba rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'i mthar: bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa:

de yi phyi rol rdo rwa: de yi phyi rol thod phreng : de yi phyi rol phur pa bsnol ma'i gur: de yi phyi rol ral gri bsnol ma'i gur: de yi phyi rol me ri 'khrigs pa'i gur: de sogs rgyas pa zhib tu lag len gces: 'di ni rgyun du lus la sus 'chang na: pha rol bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing : srung ba'i mthar thug rdo rje'i go khrab nyid: 'di nyid kun gyi yang bcud sa ma ya: gnyis pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo bri ba ni: dug shog gam ni ro ras dang : mchog chen dag gam gri lag ste: byi dor legs par 'jam pa'i ngos: dug sna khrag sna 'dzoms tshad bsags: gri khrag gam ni khrag chen la: rdzas sbyor tsher shing myu gus bris: dang po dbus su chos 'byung bsnol: de yi steng du sngags 'di bris: hūm̐ḥbh+yoḥbazlogaḥrbadaḥru ṭaḥmā raḥdza nanaḥ de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra kro ti shwa rī bh+yoḥ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ru tra bzlog nan: oṃ rat+na kī li kī la ya ru tra bzlog nan: om̐ pad+ma kī li kī la ya ru tra bzlog nan: oṃ karma kī li kī la ya ru tra bzlog nan: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ma tri ya ma dgra bo bh+yo zlog: oṃ rak+sha ya ma dgra bo bh+yo zlog: oṃ yak+sha ya ma dgra bo bh+yo zlog: oṃ ra tri ya ma dgra bo bh+yo zlog: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong ngan pa thams cad dgra bo kho rang la bzlog cig: oṃ lok+t+ri pā la ya zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs drug la: oṃ ma hā dhe wa ya dgra bo zlog zlog: oṃ u ma dhe wa ya dgra bo zlog zlog: oṃ mug ti kriṣ+ṇa ya dgra bo zlog zlog: oṃ ya ma ha la dgra bo zlog zlog: oṃ rak+sha ghṛ wa ya dgra bo zlog zlog: oṃ shu la tsa ti ya dgra bo zlog zlog:

rtsibs mchan: oṃ dza tri ya ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ ma tri ya ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ ra tri ya ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ ya tri ya ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ du tri ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ na tri ma dgra la zlog zlog: oṃ sha tri ma dgra la zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka kro ti ka li rak+mo ya dz+wa la dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad bh+yo zlog: pha rol gyi byad kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong mnan gtad du bcug pa dgra bo kho rang la phar bzlog par gyur cig: mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bcu la: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī laṃ dan+t+ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ khroṃ bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ trag bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ taṃ bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ shag bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ mā ra bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ ha la bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ ha tri bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ thun bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ ya du bh+yo ru tra nan: oṃ dzi bi bh+yo ru tra nan: mu khyud la: oṃ sarba lo ka duṣ+ṭa ha la rak+sha mā ra raṃ bh+yo shag trig hur thum raṃ byad ma hur thum rbad bh+yoḥ pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa byad kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra bo kho rang la bzlog cig: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rdo rje rgya gram gur: de yi phyi rol ral gri spu gri'i gur: de yi phyi rol me dpung 'khor lo'i gur: de yang shin tu 'bar mched sreg par bris:

sa ma ya: gsum pa ru tra mā ra bri ba ni: dug shog nag por dug sna lngas: ru tra dpe'u chung ltar bris: dbus su rtsibs bzhi'i lte ba ru: nṛ triḥya ma srog la rbad: rtsibs la: tshin+dha rbad: rtsibs mchan la: pa tsa thun dzaḥ mu khyud la: ha la sarba pur thum nṛ tri myog myog shag rbad: de yi phyi rol rtsibs drug la: nṛ triḥdzaḥthunaḥnṛ tri raṃ thun: nṛ tri yaṃ thun: nri tri khaṃ thun: nṛ tri suṃ thun: nṛ tri shag thun: ru tra la: a ya ma ha la nṛ tri myog thun dzaḥdza: ka wa tsi nan brlag: mā ra trig bh+yoḥ gnam lcags rtsibs la: nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad: nṛ tri ha la rbad: nṛ tri sha la rbad: nṛ tri kham shog rbad: nṛ tri dza thun rbad: nṛ tri dza thum rbad: mu khyud la: dzi wi nan bh+yo ya ma baṃ log shag mā ra chod bhan+dha kha la myog thum trig kha thum du ra ti ra tri bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i srog la chum chum: snying la rbad rbad: rtsa la sdud sdud: dbugs la rngub rngub: mā ra shag thun nan: de yi phyi rol ral gri nang du bsnol: de yi phyi rol me dpung nang du 'bar: ru tra'i lte bar: ya ma tsit+ta shag 'gas hu lu bh+yoḥ mā ra nan rbad: ces bris: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: srung bzlog bsad pa'i las rim bzhag: skal ldan shes rab blo gros can: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: spu gri dmar po tsa tri rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig rtsal skud bzhugs so: yang dag snying po bde chen rdo rjer 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang bla med snying po yang phur gwa'u dmar nag g-i skyabs yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni: mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mdun gyi nam mkha' chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong :

ka dag bde chen 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: kun gzhi dbyings rig 'gyur med pho brang nas: longs sku'i bdag nyid rdor sems yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: zang thal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i pho brang nas: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: skye med sna tshogs rol rtsal pho brang nas: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: klong yangs 'gag med khyab brdal pho brang nas: rig 'dzin shrī singha yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: rab yangs mkhyen brtse gzhal 'das pho brang nas: rig 'dzin pra bha hastī yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: zab dbyings rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas: gsang ba'i yum chen go byi dhe ma la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: snyan brgyud nam mkha' yangs pa'i pho brang nas: mtshungs bral pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab rgyud lung man ngag pho brang nas: gnubs ban bud+dha dzñā na yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig ma 'gag brda bzhi'i pho brang nas: gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje yab yum la:

gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: snying po bla med kun 'dus pho brang nas: yang dag ye shes rol pa yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku bzhi phrin las lhun grub pho brang nas: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sa bcu'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: khro bcu phra thabs yab yum 'khor bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas: phyi nang dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pho brang nas: bstan pa'i chos skyong dam can gter bdag la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: mchog thun dbang bzhi stsol bar byin gyis rlobs: de ltar gsol 'debs bden tshig gdung ba'i mod: skyabs yul rgyal ba brgyud kun ma lus kyi: thugs rje gzi byin nus pas bdag skyongs la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad dbyings su sol: mi mthun bdud srin dgra las rgyal ba dang : mtshan ma'i bgegs tshogs ma lus kun zhi zhing : rnam pa kun tu he ru ka pa nyid: go 'phang mchog la bdag nyid rab gzhol nas: skye dang gtan srid 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du: phrin las rnam bzhis gzhan don lhur blangs mthus: spobs pa'i ting 'dzin rtag tu brtan nas su: 'dzad med byang chub lta ba'i chu rgyun gyis: sred pa pre ta'i srad bu rab zhi zhing : nam yang bdag 'dzin mun pa'i 'jigs grol te: lhan skyes kun bzang dgongs pa gsal rdzogs shog: ces gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam pa ru gyur:

spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga rnams la thim pas sku gsum gyi dbang thob: tshig don gyi ngo 'phrod: nges pa'i don nyams su myangs nas dbang bzhi rdzogs rdo rje bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su grub par bsam mo: de yang rdo rje phur pa'i brgyud rim rgyas bsdus 'bring sogs brgyud pa'i khyer so mi 'dra ba mang po byung yang pra bha hastī hūm̐ ka ra go byi dhe ma mtsho rgyal sogs mang du brgyud kyang phur pa sa ya 'bum sde'i cha 'di kho nar 'dus pas nyams su len po rnams kyis de ltar shes par bya'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: me sprel lor rtsa gsum gling pas mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i 'brug sgra bzhugs so: bla med yang dag ye shes rol par 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma dam chos nyi ma rgyas pa'i 'od klong nas: gsang gsum rdo rje dpa' bo'i gzi mdangs kyis: mtshan ma'i 'khri ba ma lus bsal bya'i phyir: ka dag ye shes snying pos byin 'bebs so: de yang byin 'bebs bya ba'i rim pa ni: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: gar dang ging pa dbyangs snyan len pa'i rigs: khyad par rol mo bye brag sna tshogs pa: mdzes shing yid du mchis pa sna tshogs spro: rdo rje'i rta ring len tshe brda gar 'cham: dri zhim spos bsregs spyan gzigs du ma bkram: tshangs pa'i khyim ltar dwangs pa'i mdangs phyung la: bde chen thugs rje'i byin chen 'di ltar 'bebs:

hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang byung pho brang nas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum sangs rgyas dang : bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skur bskyod la: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ka dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur bas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang nas: gsal byed mi bskyod rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sna tshogs ma 'gag blo bral pho brang nas: bla med yang dag rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ci yang ma 'gag sa le'i pho brang nas: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mkha' spyod zab lam ye shes pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+kis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang byung lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: gsang bdag lag na rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: klong chen dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma la ya zhes ri bo'i gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin shrī singhas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bid+yot+ta ma la yi gnas mchog nas: grub chen pra bha hastīs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dpal gyi mchims phu dge'u gong gnas mchog nas: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

mon kha rdo rje rdzong phug gnas mchog nas: mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rgyal bas lung bstan byā tshal gnas mchog nas: slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka ras byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bka' bab rgyud lung gsang mdzod bod la bsgyur: gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying pos byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rgyud gcig lung gnyis brda bzhi'i bka' bab pa: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: zab rgya sgo 'phar gter gyi pho brang nas/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes byin phob cig /byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: /gsang sngags ma nges gang 'dul pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes byin phob cig /byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lung rigs rgya mtsho'i nges don gcig tu sdud: drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rngam brjid rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang nas: yang dag he ru ka yis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang byung rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang nas: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro 'dul pho brang nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nus byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: grol lam gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug 'khor lo rgyas 'debs byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las pho brang nas: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rtsal chen sgyu ma'i nyams 'gyur pho brang nas: khro bcu yab yum rnams kyis byin phob cig:

byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rang bzhin ngang las spros pa'i pho brang nas: phur 'debs phra thabs nyi shus byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: las bzhi thogs med sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: dbyings phyug sgo ma'i tshogs kyis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: srid pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis pho brang nas: las byed ging bdud nyer bzhis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mngon spyod thogs med sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: gter bdag gter srung rnams kyis byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phur: khro bo'i lha tshogs 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: dpa' bo 'bum gyis gar byed shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis glu len kyu ru ru: ging pa pho mos rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: ging mo rnams kyis bshugs sgra ti ri ri: rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'u ru ru: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: chos skyong srung ma'i las byed tshubs se tshub: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir: byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: thabs mkhas kun mkhyen nyid kyi dpal yon gyis: srid zhi'i gnas gol la sogs spangs mdzad pa: rgyal ba ye shes lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la dbang mchog bskur: nyams rtogs rig pa ye shes rtsal chen skyed: mi rtog rdo rje lta bu'i gnas lugs stsol: gang yang ma 'gag cir snang lam 'khyer ba'i: kun bzang ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa dang : rtsa rlung bde drod rang 'bar dngos grub stsol: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur du gsol: gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur du gsol: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol:

shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang thob nas: ka dag kun grol rang dbyings der rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te ka ru ṇa tsit+ta hrī dha ya ma ma kun+ta sha ra ṇa a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas rol mo yun ring brdung zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin phab par bsam: byin 'bebs rtags dkyil 'khor la bkrag mdangs rgyas: mchod pa'i bcud mi nyams shing rol mo dang dbyangs sngar las sgra che ba lha sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa sogs 'byung : rnal 'byor pa la byin 'bebs rtags nyams 'bar zhing ba spu g.yo ba sogs 'phar ba gar 'khrab snyam bgyi ba sogs bzhad gad kyi nyams ston pa ting nge 'dzin gsal ba bskyed rim la ngar 'byin pa sogs khyad par can dang ri 'bir ba: sa g.yo ba 'ja' 'od 'khyil zhing me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i ltas 'byung : de ltar ma byung bar yang yang bskyar la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo/ des nges par 'byung ngo : sa ma ya: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i rta ring ka len gdangs: snyan pa'i 'brug sgras snang srid yongs 'gengs 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra gsang sngags 'chang ba'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon yul brag sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dkar gtor 'dod yon kun khyab bzhugs so: yang dag rdo rje khrag 'thung bzhad par 'dud: sa ma ya: 'dod yon zad med rin chen gter gyi mdzod: snang srid dgyes pa'i mchod gtor dpog dka'i khyon: mos blo'i re skong bdud rtsi sprin phung 'di: mtsho rgyal bdag gis gzhan phan spyi la bkod: sa ma ya: de yang ye shes dang spyi rgyud skyong ba'i srung ma la gser skyems dang brngan cha dkar gtor 'bul ba ni:

rin po che'i snod du lha bshos dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyis brgyan pa la mar mtshon bzang pos bkra btab: gser skyems brgyud ldan dang zung gcig tu byin gyis brlabs la 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dkar gtor dang gser skyems 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum brjod rgyas pa sngags drug phyag drug bya: de nas 'bul ba ni: hoḥ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma dang gser skyems gnyan po 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni rin chen gter gyi srung ma gnyan po dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug ma ning nag po gdong bzhi pa bram ze gzugs can srog bdag nag po bya rog gi gdong can sogs ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po yum mchog si na ra ma sprul pa bam ro pho mo bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po btsan rgod bse yi khrab can 'khor bshan pa brgyad sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ drang srong gza' mchog rā hu la ma mo sngags bdag e ka dzā ṭi skyes bu dam can rdo rje legs pa gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen chen po gnod sbyin rgyal po dpe dkar la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ lha chen po brgyad klu chen po brgyad gza' chen po brgyad rgyu skar lha mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad

phyogs skyong gnyan po bcu 'jigs byed chen po dgu rgyal chen sde bzhi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ phyi yi lha ma srin sde brgyad nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad drag po sngags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad las byed myur mgyogs kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad 'jig rten rtag chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyong gnas sum cu rtsa bdun gyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad kyi dpa' bo gangs can bod kyi brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis ya ma bcu gnyis rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum la sogs gnas shing 'gyu ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par du yang gnas chen po rgya gar rdo rje gdan rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga li yul lcang ra smug po za hor siṃ ha la nub phyogs o rgyan yul byang sham bha la bal yul 'phags pa shing kun gangs ti tshe la phyi chu bar mkha' spyod tsā ri mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag brgya dang rtsa brgyad la sogs pa la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: 'di man bdag gis 'dzud pa yin/ khyad par sngar nas 'byin pa'i gter gnas che phra rnams la smos pa ni/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro/ dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang*/ brag yer pa/ mon sha 'ug stag sgo/ yar lha sham po gangs/ tsā ri/ dmar nag rak+ta/ gzi chen gsang phug /zhing skyong bla mtsho/ rngam pa sgra sgrogs/ gnyal smad dge ri brag /lha gnyan dwags lha sgam po/ bsam yas mchims phu/ kong po rdo rje brag la sogs dbus kyi cha 'dzin pa'i gter gnas srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐:

i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par lho brag ne brag /ri rtse drug /jo bo gze rgyal/ spu ru spur bcas/ gnas gzhi a mye mu khri/ mkha' 'gro snying phug dge bsnyen pho brang*/ rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa/ mdo khams sku rgyal shen ne/ lho wa lung sogs mdo khams kyi gter gnas rnams kyi srung ma yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par lho phyogs pad+ma bkod kyi cha dar sna pha wang stag mgo /bal phu lung*/ rngam pa rong*/ mgon po'i bla mtsho/ rdo rje gter phug /mdong chu gtsug lag /gdong pho brang gnas/ phag mo gsang ba lung gi phyag rdor bla mtsho/ 'ja' tshon phug /o rgyan khrus chu/ brag gad pad+ma shel phug /seṅge gnam rdzong*/ mye bo lha mo brag /mgron thang dge bsnyen/ gnas mdo/ khrom gzigs dag pa shrī/ mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i bla mtsho/ ma rkung lung gi g.yu mtsho la sogs gter gnas de nyid la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: -i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par da lo'i lo: da zhag gi zla ba: de ring gi nyi ma gza' tshes grangs rgyu skar la dbang ba sngon chad gang du 'gro ba phyin chad gang du gnas pa khyad par yul phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po gtsor byas pa mtho ba gnam la gnas pa dma' ba sa la gnas pa skye ba shing la gnas pa brtan pa sa la gnas pa sra ba brag la gnas pa 'gyu ba chu la gnas pa mched pa me la gnas pa g.yo ba rlung la gnas pa rten pa'i mkhar la gnas pa dben ri dang gtsug lag khang la gnas pa la sogs pa snang zhing srid pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig lha srin gzhi bdag sde tshogs rnams: bdag gis gsang sngags gnyan po dal bzung phyir: khyed rnams phrin las rogs dan ma g.yel sgrubs: chos nyid tshig la mi nyan gang yang med: rgyal ba'i gsung la mi bden gang yang med:

zab mo'i don la mi sems gang yang med: mna' dang khrims la mi 'jigs gang yang med: ri rab zom du mi gnas gang yang med: 'byung 'jug rlung gis mi zin gang yang med: skye 'gro lam la mi 'gyu gang yang med: longs spyod chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: rgyu 'bras las la mi bzlog gang yang med: de ltar 'phags pa'i tshig la snyan gsan phyir: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes nas: bdag gis bla med byang chub sgrub pa la: 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen bsam don spel: mi mthun bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rje btsun slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: tha tshig gnyer ba'i srung ma dam tshig can: gter gyi bdag po mgon chen sde lnga dang : las su chas pa'i srog bdag bya rog mtshan: ma gza' rdor legs btsan rgod klu bdud che: shel ging rgyal po li byin bhi ha ra: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jigs byed chen po dgu: rgyal chen sde bzhi gling phran bdag po dang : bya ra dus 'dzin gzhong thogs rtag tu myos: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig yul gyi zhing skyong bcas: gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod dpa' bo ging : brtan ma skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis dang : spar sme lo zla dus dang chu tshod bdag: rgya gar rgya nag bal bod mtshams shed nas: mnga' ris dbus gtsang mdo khams sgang drug sogs: sbas yul dang ni rong chen ma lus pa: khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : gar 'gro gar 'dug gzhi lam byes gsum gyi: rogs dan mel tshe sgrub pa'i srung ma rnams: mchod sbyin gtor ma gser skyems 'di bzhes la: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams la: phrin las sna tshogs thogs med bsgrub pa dang : mdun nas bsu zhing rgyab nas skyel ma mdzod: la chu'i 'phrang sgrol chom rkun 'jigs las skyobs:

dmag 'khrug nad yams lo nyes zhi ba dang : dgra gyod kha mchu rgyal po'i 'jigs pa srungs: dal bab mtshon dang dug las rgyal bar gyis: rig sngags dmod sogs pha rol gdug pa'i tshogs: chos skyong dang bcas phyi rgyud srung mas sgrol: mi mthun bgegs tshogs nye bar zhi ba dang : 'dod don bsam pa yid bzhin bsgrubs mdzad nas: dam tshig can la rtag tu skyong ba dang : dngos grub sna tshogs ster ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: oṃ lo ka pā la badz+ra pra tīts+tsha ye i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

zhes pas dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar bskyal: mdos sogs kyi sngon 'gro yin na de phyogs bskyal: sgrub pa'i skabs yin na sgrub khang gi mdun gang rung du 'bul: lam gtor yin na gar 'gro phyogs su 'bul: gzhi bdag so sor yin na de phyogs su 'bul: phrin las rang rang gang dgos pa'i gzhung bzhin bcol: 'di nyid dkyil 'khor sogs las kun gyi sngon 'gro yin pas med thabs med: phan yon chos skyong rogs dan bsgrub: phyi rgyud rnams kyis dngos grub ster: ko long sdom sogs gdug sems thams cad zhi nas bran bzhin du mchis: las gang la yang bar chad dang sgab 'dre mi 'byung : des na gtor ma gser skyems 'di kho na gtso che: khyad par yang sbas yul dben ri sna tshogs nyul ba'i tshe do gal: las can rnams gter 'byin pa'i tshe shin tu do gal: sa ma ya: e ma ho gsang sngags rgyal po rin chen za ma tog: nor bu bsam 'phel dgos 'byung 'od rab 'byin: ti la ka 'di dbyangs can bdag gis bgyis: de bas las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: spel rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje kā la drag po rtsal gyis me sprel lor mon sha 'ug brag nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang dag ye shes snying po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las: stobs ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bzhugs so: saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du: a ti saṃ bha ra dzñā na hṛ da ya rid+dhi ha ra ma hā bha la badz+ra ku mā ra karma da hi dz+wa la raṃ tsakra ye na ma: mkha' 'gro brda'i skad du: sid+dhi ba ri lam: u bā ri dhi hi: bod skad du: bla med yang dag ye shes snying po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba stobs po che rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo zhes bya ba: 'jigs byed he ru ka chen po yang phur rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo:

'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen por bcom ldan 'das yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras bzhi 'khor khro bcu sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa dran rig mngon gyur de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhugs so: yang de yi tshe skye med ye shes snying po rdo rje'i rang gdangs las bka' stsal pa: e ma hoḥ mkha' ltar kun tu khyab pa yi: dbyings las ma g.yos ngo bo nyid: rig pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: stong la ma 'gag cir yang 'char: phyag mtshan sa bon kun kyang grub: sgyu ma'i zhal phyag ye nas rdzogs: dbyings dang ye shes yab yum tshul: ma 'gag rtsal dang sras 'khor shar: nyid zhi gsal la me ltar 'bar: mtha' dang dbus med khyab cing mnyam: stong nyid snying po so sor rtogs: thig le chen po bya rtsol rdzogs: bskyed pas gsal la stong ste rdzogs: zung 'jug ngang gis sku gsum ston: rang bzhin shugs kyis kun snang gzhom: ye shes drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: kun rtog ma rig 'khrul 'khor bcom: 'khor lo lnga dang dkyil 'khor gsal: gsang ba mkha' 'gror rgya gdams so: sa ma ya: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nus gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gnyis med kho nar gsang rgya bstan te brdar gtad nas dbyings klong gong bu can du bzhugs pa slar ma hā gu ru la bka' bab pa'o: e ma hoḥ kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa pad 'byung ngas: bla med snying po yang gsang ti ka can: rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed pa'i las rim bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: mthing nag sa la dal kyang bcag: las thig cha tshang spyi mthun gdab: sku 'bag lha tshogs rten rnams bkram: phyi nang mchod pa tshang bar bsags: rang nyid bde ba'i gdan du 'khod:

phrin las drag po'i phyogs su 'gyur: sa ma ya: dang po sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das chos rnams smra brjod blo las 'das: de don ma rtogs rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs rnams: dran shes bag yod lam la 'god bya'i phyir: nges don rtogs par mi dmigs sems bskyed do: gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na moḥ dran rig ngo bo gcig la kun rdzogs pa'i: gdod nas lhun grub rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs: dbyer med sna tshogs zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang : kun nas klong yangs chen por skyabs su mchi: gsum pa bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: bdag nyid yang dag badz+ra ku mā ra'i: rang bzhin thugs las 'od zer pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med khyab par 'phros: sgrub la mi dbang bgegs tshogs gang yin pa: gtor ma len phyir skad cig 'dir mchis shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra ya ma hā kro ti bh+yo dza dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rang byung he ru kaḥ nga yi bka' las bgegs tshogs 'da' ma byed: gtor ma khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: rtsal chen las kyi pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: me 'od mtshon cha drag po'i thog ser gyis: brdung zhing phye mar bcom par gdon mi za: de bas gnod byed 'byung po phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las khro bcu phra thabs 'phros: steng 'og phyogs bcur khengs shing mu mtha' khyab: mtshams gcod khro tshogs drag sngags 'u ru ru: gzi brjid me char tshwa tshwa si li li: glags lta bgegs srin 'byung po mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ sarba da ha a mu ka bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

drug pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen yab yum sras bzhi khro bcu yi: thugs las spros pa'i rno dbal mtshon cha'i tshogs: phyi rol gur khang dum bu rim dgu 'khrigs: drwa mig rnams su spu gri'i so 'thab 'khor: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i mkha' ltar gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsakra ka ra ti ka tsakra khaḍ+ga yaṃ tsakra raṃ dz+wa la ya tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: bdun pa phyi yi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi snod stong gsum gling bzhi khengs pa yi: mchod sprin lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon: yongs su 'gengs pa'i phyi mchod sna tshogs 'di: zag med bde skyed dgos 'dod lhun grub gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rlung me thod sgyed steng du bhan+dha'i snod: yangs shing rgya che sman gtor rak+tas bkang : bcud g.yo mdangs ldan mkha' ltar rgyas pa 'di: byin gyis brlabs pas bla med rdzas chen gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dgu pa gsang mchod byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: dung dmar shes rab bhan+dha'i snod nang du: bde stong dpa' bo yab yum sbyor ba yi: mkha' lam bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs ltem gyis gang : gsang ba'i dam rdzas ye nas rnam par dag: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: bcu pa brda sgo dbye zhing rang rig lha zhal mjal zhing dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: grangs med bag chags brtsegs pa phung po'i sgo: ma rig blang dor 'thib po bsal du gsol: ye nas 'du 'bral med pa rtsa gsum lha: dran rig rtsal las shar ba'i rang mdangs te: gnyis su ma grub lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: nga bdag a 'thas sems can snying re rje: re dogs bral lo ro gcig ngang du bshags:

shes sgrib dag pas kun kyang stong pa nyid: cho 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems: gnas lugs ngo bo gcig la kun kyang rdzogs: de don rtogs pas rjes shes bag yod kyis: ma 'gag 'od gsal dkyil 'khor srog ltar bzung : g.yo med mkha' ltar tsit+ta'i klong du bsgrub: gdod ma 'khrul med ka dag mi gtong ngo : oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ sarba dharma shud+dhe hoḥ oṃ dharma badz+ra hrī dha hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa tsit+ta gu h+ya hūm̐: dang po ka dag gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: stong gsal ma 'gag kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab: ye nas rang byung ka dag lhun gyis grub: 'od gsal snying po bde chen 'dus ma byas: klong yangs rdo rje gzhon nus de ltar smra: oṃ dharma swa bhā badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa dran rig ma 'gag lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: chos sku blo 'das de bzhin las: dran rig klong las zang thal 'gyu: ma 'gag rang rtsal cho 'phrul gyis: sna tshogs kun rgyu'i sa bon ston: oṃ dharma dhā tu hūm̐: gsum pa 'bras bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: rgyu yi cho 'phrul sa bon las: pho brang sku dang zhal phyag rdzogs: ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: chu zla'i ngo bo ci bzhin snang : oṃ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na sa twa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: 'byung lnga bskal par brtsegs pa yi: rgyu nyid dbyings la rang byung du: rtsal dang sa bon so sor shar: ma bcos rang bzhin lhun grub bsgom: oṃ sarba dharma hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: lnga pa gdan dang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin pho brang rdzogs pa'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sbyor: zung 'jug sras dang khro tshogs spros: sa bon phyag mtshan so sor shar: oṃ bh+rūm̐ tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la:

ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsakra kro ti satwaṃ: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drug pa phyag mtshan so sor spros shing rgyas par bstan pa ni: hūm̐: e las drag po nam mkha' mthing : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram btegs: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: kham̐ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khrugs: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi nag: keṃ las ri rab dur khrod 'jigs: bh+rūm̐ las ye shes gzhal yas khang : thod pa'i sku mkhar gru bzhi rngam: phrin las bzhi yi sgo dang bcas: srin po'i bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs: 'dod snam ging mos gar stabs bsgyur: khro chu khol ma'i so phag bsdams: thod tshal sna tshogs drwa ba 'phyangs: dug sbrul nag po'i sham bu bskyod: mda' yab keng rus gar stabs bsgyur: kha bad mu tig thod pa'i phreng : klu brgyad ka ba lha brgyad gdung : gza' dang rgyu skar dral lcam tshags: ka zhu 'brug la ka gdan sbal: nyi zla 'bar ba'i mthongs skar ldan: zham chu dmar chen rak+ta 'khyil: mi lpags stag lpags bla re bres: don snying rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phyangs: thog steng g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rta babs chos 'khor tsit+ta'i tog: bha su'i zhags pa phyogs bzhir dpyangs: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa dang : me ri smug nag phyogs bcur 'khrigs: rab 'jigs pho brang chen por bsgom: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: de steng hūm̐ las skyes pa yi: yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nyer gcig dbu la zhe gnyis phyag: rtsa zhal lnga po mthing la rngam: dang po g.yas gnyis dkar dang ser: g.yon gnyis dmar zhing rab tu ljang : de steng g.yas gnyis dkar dang mthing : g.yon gnyis dmar dang smug nag gtum:

de steng g.yas gsum dkar ljang sngo: g.yon gsum dmar smug shin tu nag: de steng zhi zhal dkar dmar snum: phyag g.yas nyer gcig dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba'i lha tshogs yab yum gsal: phyag g.yon nyer gcig dkyil 'khor du: khrag 'thung lha tshogs yab yum gsal: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: bco brgyad zhabs kyis dor stabs bgrad: sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: yum mchog kro ti shwa rī mthing : dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: phyag g.yas dgu la rdo rje gdengs: g.yon dgu bhan dmar yab la stob: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum yab la 'khril: yab yum gzi brjid dpal 'bar bsgom: hūm̐: dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka ru: pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rtsa zhal mthing dmar shin tu nag: g.yas gsum dkar ser ljang nag 'khrugs: g.yon gsum dmar smug sngo zhing 'bar: zhal dgu rngam stabs 'jigs la khro: phyag g.yas dgu la 'jigs pa'i mtshon: rdo rje gri gug ral gri dang : dbyug to dgra satwa tho ba dang : beng dang gsal shing 'dzin pa'o: g.yon pa'i phyag dgu rim pa bzhin: me dpung bhan+dha lcags kyu dang : lcags sgrog tsit+ta zhags pa nag: kha ṭ+wāṃ sog le 'dzin pa'o: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug gtum pa mo: g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen gri: g.yon gsum tshe bum bhan+dha dung : yab kyi mgul 'khyud rus rgyan gsol: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum sked la 'khril: bskal pa'i me dpung klong du 'gying : thugs kar hūm̐ bh+yo sngags kyis bskor: oṃ badz+ra kro ti he ru ka kro ti shwa rī baṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i steng : gsal byed rdo rje he ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje be con 'khor: g.yon gsum bhan+dha par bu dung : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: gri thod mgul 'khyud zung 'jug dang : khro 'dzum rgyan drug brkyang bskum bzhugs: thugs kar srog yig sngags kyis bskor: oṃ badz+ra rid+dhi driṣ+ṭa pradzñā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: de yi thugs kar 'ja' 'od klong : yang dag rdo rje sku mdog mthing : phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar: zhabs gnyis mthil sprad bzhengs pa'i stabs: rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs su bsgom: oṃ saṃ bha badz+ra ma hā dzñā na hūm̐: hūm̐: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: shar du badz+ra kī la ya: dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje tho ba ral gri dang : bhan+dha zhags pa phur bu bsnams: lho ru rat+na kī la ya: ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: gri gug dgra satwa lcags sgrog dang : dung dmar tsit+ta phur bu bsnams: nub tu pad+ma kī la ya: dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo be con rgyu zhags dang : thong gshol dril bu phur bu bsnams: byang du karma kī la ya: ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: spu gri kha ṭ+wāṃ rgya gram dang : me dpung mdung thung phur bu bsnams: kun kyang dur khrod chas brgyad dang : rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal dang ldan: lnga ldan me dpung klong du 'gying : hūm̐: sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen bzhi: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs sogs khro zhing rngam: dkar ser dmar ljang rgyan drug ldan: gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum zhabs bzhi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug gzi brjid ldan par bsgom:

oṃ ma hā kro ta tsa tur kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bcu ru: nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan steng du: g.yas bskor tshul gyis rim pa bzhin: khro bo hūm̐ kar sku mdog mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: mda' gzhu 'gengs shing gri thod 'dzin: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje sgra 'byin be con thod: phra thabs phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: khro chen rnam rgyal sku mdog dkar: g.yas mthing g.yon dmar dbus dkar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo dgra satwa tri shūl dbyug: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje mda' snyems gri bhan+dha: phra thabs stag dang bya rgod mgo: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngo: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: gri gug rdo rje me dbyug bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje sder mo lcags kyu thod: phra thabs g.yag dang bya rog mgo: khro chen gshin rje gshed po ser: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser nag: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: thod dbyug rgyu zhags dgra satwa gri: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: dur khrod bdag mo dbyug tho me: phra thabs shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo: khro bo chen po mi g.yo mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: ral gri beng dang lcags sgrog zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gtun khung lcags tho bhan: phra thabs gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: khro bo chen po rta mgrin dmar: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: spu gri dbyug pa bhan+dha zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gtum mo spu gri bhan: phra thabs byi la pu shud mgo: khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar zhing smug: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar zhal:

phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje tho ba bhan+dha dbyug: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje bde bskul tho ba bhan: phra thabs spyang ki khra yi mgo: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rgya gram ral gri dril bu zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje rlung bskyod dgra satwa bhan: phra thabs seṅge pha waṃ mgo: khro chen khams gsum rgyal ba mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: rdo rje be con zhags pa sgrog: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje gsod byed gri gug bhan: phra thabs dom dang sre mong mgo: khro bo stobs chen sku mdog smug: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: be con 'khor lo rnga yab zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje las bskyod kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan: phra thabs dred dang byi la'i mgo: khro bcu shin tu khros pa'i gzugs: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs gyad kyi 'gros: bdud dgra dam sri'i snying khar brdzis: yum rnams khro mo'i rgyan drug spras: phyag gnyis rang rtags mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sked la 'khril: thugs kar srog yig sngags kyis bskor: gzi brjid ye shes lnga ldan gsal: sprul pa khra thabs phra men tshogs: g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dzin: thams cad me dpung klong du bsgom: oṃ dzñā na badz+ra kro ta he ru ka dā sha baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyi rol shar lho nub byang du: 'dab drug dbus bdun lte ba ru: g.yas bskor tshul gyis rim pa bzhin: dkar mo g.yag mgo rdo rje bsnams: dkar ser sbrul gdong pad+ma bsnams: dkar ljang gzig gdong tri shūl bsnams: sre gdong dkar sngo 'khor lo bsnams: dkar dmar dred gdong mdung thung bsnams:

dkar mo dom gdong rgyu zhags bsnams: dkar mo khu byug lcags kyu bsnams: hūm̐: ser mo pha waṃ spu gri bsnams: dmar mo chu srin bum pa bsnams: dmar ser sdig gdong pad+ma bsnams: dkar ser khra mgo rdo rje bsnams: ser ljang wa gdong dbyug tho bsnams: ser nag stag gdong thod khrag bsnams: ser mo ra gdong zhags pa bsnams: hūm̐: dmar ljang rgod mgo be con bsnams: dmar mo rta gdong khog chen bsnams: dmar skya khyung gdong dbyug tho bsnams: dmar mo khyi gdong rdo rje bsnams: dmar mo pu shud mda' gzhu 'gengs: dmar mo shwa mgo bum pa bsnams: dmar mo seng gdong lcags sgrog bsnams: hūm̐: ljang sngon spyang gdong ba dan 'phyar: dmar ljang skyin mgo gsal shing bsnams: ljang nag phag gdong mche zhags bsnams: ljang nag chu glang bam ro za: sna chen glang chen bam ro bsnams: ljang sngon sbrul gdong sbrul zhags bsnams: ljang mo sbrul gdong dril bu bsnams: thams cad 'jigs pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: rngam dang dgyes tshul gshe bar bsgom: oṃ kau rī shwa rī de wi dā ya aṣ+ṭa hṛ da ya baṃ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: phyi rol sgo bzhi skyong mdzad ma: pu shud skya ga srin bya dang : khra mgo la sogs phra men ma: dkar ser dmar ljang myur mgyogs ldan: phyag na lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams pa'o: oṃ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan pa: bar khyams 'khor yug rim pa bzhin: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi ni: mthing nag lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon: dmar nag zangs wa rkang gsum zhon: ser nag 'phar ba lce brgyad zhon: sngo nag g.yu khyi mgo gsum zhon: kun kyang gcer mo g.yang gzhi gyon: dpal gyi phur bu dgra la 'debs: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan re ti bzhi: mthing nag drel rta rkang gsum zhon: mi lpags gos gyon phur pa 'dril: ser nag gser sha yu mo zhon: rma bya'i thul gyon gser zor 'dzin:

dmar nag chu glang sngon po zhon: gtsod gyon khram bam lcags kyu bsnams: ljang nag rnga mong sngo nag zhon: chu dar gos gsol khram bam bsnams: hūm̐: bka' nyan sa bdag chen mo bzhi: ya byin lcags phur ral pa can: mthing nag mthing ber bdud rta zhon: de byin gser phur ral pa can: ser nag gser ber gza' rta zhon: bswe byin zangs phur ral pa can: dmar nag ber gsol btsan rta zhon: phag byin mchong phur ral pa can: ljang nag ber gsol klu rta zhon: thams cad phyag na phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: skyes bu chen po ging chen bzhi: srin po gshin rje bdud dang ni: gnod sbyin la sogs 'jigs pa'i gzugs: dkar ser dmar ljang phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: bdud po dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: dung gser g.yu mchong phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: shel ging dmu gza' dgra lha dang : skyes bu la sogs srog bdag bzhi: thams cad phyag na ral gri thogs: kun kyang khro tshul 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mi bzad rngam pa'i skur ston gsol: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur:

de nas spos sna sha chen bsreg: rol mo gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas: dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzñā na pañtsa sarba sa ma ti a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya satwaṃ dhā tu gar+bhe āḥ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje brag dmar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen he ru kaḥ rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul drwa bas sa gsum g.yo: 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la: ye shes rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya baṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: rkang tshil zhun mar dmar chen dri chab gtams: sha khrag gtor chen rol mo sna tshogs 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: lnga pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang sman mchog lnga: legs par sbyar ba'i rdzas chen bla med 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: stong nyid mkha' la bde stong legs sbyar te: zung 'jug srub cing rlung gis bskul ba las: dung dmar snod du dkar dmar 'khyil ba 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul:

oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdun pa spyan gzigs gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi snod yangs pa gling bzhi nyi zla'i snod: bha ling gtor chen sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod sprin bkod pa 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ sarba ba liṃ ta māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: oṃ bi shwa a wa lo ki te ma hā me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa swā hā: brgyad pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub bde chen yangs pa'i klong : gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod dbus: mi shigs rdo rje brag dmar khri steng du: yang dag che mchog bla med he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag chos dbyings rang bzhin 'bar: nyer gcig zhal rnams khros pas sa gsum sngangs: zhe gnyis sdigs mdzub sor rtse'i dkyil 'khor du: zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od zer thag 'tsher: sgro gshog brgyangs pas 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas rdzogs gar dgus sa bcu g.yo: bco brgyad zhabs kyis srid pa'i 'khor lo bcom: sku la skyes pa'i ye shes me dpung 'bar: dpal chen 'jigs byed he ru ka la bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog kro ti shwa rī ma: mthing nag dbu dgu khros pas log 'dren gzhom: bco brgyad phyag mtshan ban bon phur kha zlog: dur khrod chas rdzogs ma sring dbang du sdud: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum bde chen yab la 'khril: dbyings kyi yum chen rdo rje gtum chen ma: brda yi drag sngags mi bzad phyogs bcur sgrog: las kyi dbang phyug dpa' mo che la bstod: hūm̐: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog rdo rje las: skyes pa'i dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa 'jigs byed skur ston pa: zhal dgu khros pas snang srid sngangs shing 'dar: g.yas dgu'i mtshon chas pho rgyud zil gyis gnon:

g.yon dgu'i mtshon chas mo rgyud dbang du sdud: rtsal sgro gzengs pas 'dre rgod phye mar gtor: dur khrod chas brgyad bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: zhabs brgyad gyad kyis gling bzhi ri rab gnon: gar dgu'i chas ldan me dpung klong na bzhugs: dpal chen phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yum chen khro mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid don dang ldan: zhal gsum khros pas ma rungs 'byung po 'dul: phyag drug mtshon chas log rtog rtsad nas gcod: rgyan drug chas ldan ma sring pho nyar 'gyed: yab la zhal sbyor skye med skur ston pa: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs kar sems dpa' gsal byed rdo rje ni: mthing nag skur ston chos nyid skye med klong : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dpa' stobs mkhan: gsang ba khro mo zung 'jug bla med ngang : gnas lugs mi 'gyur sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje mthing : spyi bor thal sbyar chos dbyings zang thal ngang : zhabs gnyis mthil sbyor ngan song srid sgo khegs: mi 'gyur mkha' la rdo rje 'dril ba'i gzugs: rig pa rdo rje he ru ka la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rol nyi zla ti ra baṃ gyi steng : dpal chen sras mchog khro rgyal chen po bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: dur khrod chas brgyad ma rungs lha srin 'dul: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam par ston: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog bar snang g.yo: rigs bzhi yum 'khyud sku smad dbal dang ldan: stobs ldan khro bo yab yum bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sa bcu'i dbang phyug khro rgyal chen po bcu: sku mdog sna tshogs shin tu mi bzad pa: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms: sgro gshog rtse la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: las kyi yum chen drag mo rang 'dra sbyor:

za gsod 'jigs pa'i phra thabs sprul pa 'gyed: khro bcu yab yum sprul par phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo ma mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mgo brnyan sna tshogs sprul pa cir yang ston: shin tu mi bzad gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur can: phrin las bzhi ldan ma sring tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: ye shes sgo skyong bka' yi bya ra mkhan: las kyi ma mo 'jigs pa'i gdong can bzhi: rgyan drug gsol zhing rang rtags phyag mtshan bsnams: las bzhi bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: 'jigs pa'i ma mo shwa na chen mo bzhi: snang srid bdag mo re ti chen mo bzhi: las byed chen mo myur mgyogs sa bdag bzhi: skyes bu chen po sgrol ba'i ging chen bzhi: 'bar ba chen po gsod byed bdud po bzhi: bshan pa za byed chen po srog bdag bzhi: bka' yi las byed dregs pa nyer bzhi'i tshogs: mi sdug gzugs 'chang ha ha'i gad mo sgrog: myur mgyogs las la mngags pa'i mthu bo che: las mkhan pho nya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing bskul ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam tha tshig gnyan po'i dam dgongs la: log 'dren bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang : sgrub la 'dod don mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dang po rigs bdag rtsa sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra rid+dhi driṣ+ṭa pradzñā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ saṃ bha badz+ra ma hā dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ gtso bo'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ rigs bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ ma hā kro ta tsa tur kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro bo bcu yi sngags ni: oṃ dzñā na badz+ra kro ta he ru ka dā sha baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dbang phyug nyer brgyad sngags ni: oṃ kau rī shwa rī de wi dā sha ya aṣ+ṭa hṛ da ya baṃ bh+yoḥ

sgo ma bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shwa na ma mo bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ ma tri shwa na tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ re ti bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ rak+mo re ma ti tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ sa bdag ma mo bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ ma tri bhū mi pā ti ka li tsa tur baṃ bh+yoḥ ging bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ yak+sha ya ma rak+sha pra ma ghṛ wa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdud chen bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ du pra ma rak+sha ma hā tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ srog bdag btsan bzhi yi sngags ni: oṃ ha tri shu la tsa tri tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces lha rang rang gi rtsa sngags rgyas 'bring gang thon bzla: spyi gzungs rgyud ltar bstun te bsgrub na: gtso bo la bye ba: 'khor rnams la khri re bya'o: skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: zhes rtsa sngags kyis phul kyang rung : sa ma ya: de nas dang po tshogs mchod bya ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gdod nas rang byung stong pa'i dbyings: snang tshul tsam du spros bsgyur gyis: sbyangs spel yi ge 'bru drug 'phros: dal la phog pas dngos 'dzin sbyangs: oṃ dharma dhā tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ā hūm̐: gnyis pa: hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis nyes skyon bsregs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs mchod dbyings dang mnyam: rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza sarba me gha ya hūm̐: gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la: thugs mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor:
