zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bzhi pa tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phyi nang khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ saṃ bha ro pa tsit+ta kro ta kro ti ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: oṃ dā+e shwa ma hā dā sha dharma pā la ya ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs spyan gzigs lha mo'i gar: nang mchod sman raka gsang mchod sbyor sgrol tshogs: bla med bde ba chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: drug pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang : bdun pa bsgral ba ni: na mo: rtsa brgyud dkyil 'khor mchog gsum rgya mtsho yi: bslu med phyag rgya sngags kyi bden stobs kyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra gnod byed gang yin pa: rang dbang med par liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ ru tra a mu ka mā ra ya dza dzaḥ brgyad pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen stobs ldan badz+ra kī la ya: nus mthu rtsal 'byin stong gsum me 'od 'khrugs: thugs las sprul pa'i bshan pa phur bu'i tshogs: dbyings nas bsgril zhing thog ltar dgra la phob: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs ru tra tshin+dha mā ra bh+yoḥ badz+ra duṣ+ṭa ru tra nṛ tri thum rbad ya: dgu pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams:

rngam pa'i zhal phyes dgyes pa'i ljags dmar rkyongs: dgra bgegs sha khrag 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hi: bcu pa dngos grub tshogs la rol pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: don gnyis bla med dngos grub stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni rang byung ye shes mchog: spang blang dgag sgrub bral bar rol: a la la hoḥ bcu gcig pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: ma sring ging sman bdud dang bran g.yog tshogs: rngam tshul 'jigs pa'i gcer bu sna tshogs kyis: mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon zhing stong khams nyul: zas su gdug pa'i sha khrag snying la za: las su dgra bgegs srog dang dbugs la rngam: rig 'dzin dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: chos mdzad sgrub la bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ya she ṣa bi shwa kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: mthu stobs dpa' bo'i rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi mtha': ma rungs gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar nas: gsang sngags bstan la bdud kyis 'tshe lags pas: khro rgyal chen po'i mngon spyod mi mdzad na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin yi chad mi 'gyur ram: gsang sngags gnyan la 'bras bu cang med dam: yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas ma dgyes sam: phyag rgya sngags kyi nus pa nyams lags sam: rig 'dzin gong mas thugs kyis mi khrel lam: de bas dpal chen lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: log 'dren bar gcod rtsom pa'i 'byung po la: dpal chen mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar phob:

bsgral zhing bzhes nas ming shul med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yo: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dbang po lnga la kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang chen lhun grub dur khrod du: thog ma'i mgon po yang dag rdo rje dang : rigs kyi yum chen gsang ba mkha' 'gro gnyis: 'od gsal dang po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi dpa' bo ma sring ḍāk+ki yis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og rngam klong me ri 'bar ba ru: yang dag khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ra: dbyings phyug yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis: yang phur snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: khro bcu phra thabs phur skyong srung ma yis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bid+yot+ta ma'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po seṅge sgra sgrogs dang : gsang ba'i yum chen rdo rje drag mo gnyis: yang phur 'bum sde'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug laṅka gnas nyul ma tshogs kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : rigs kyi yum chen ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: yang phur gwa'u'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gnod sbyin btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun gyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru:

lho rgyud mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas: rig 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa dang : yum chen a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma gnyis: yang phur gwa'u'i zab gter bton pa'i tshe: byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod spun bdun gyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa ru: gsang rgya rtags bdun shog ser phab pa'i tshe: phur pas zhal gzigs drag sngags dngos su gsungs: gter srung btsan rgod mdun du byon pa'i tshe: sa g.yos ri 'bir stong gsum 'ur gyis khengs: ci bcol thogs med sgrub par khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub stsol zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki nī dharma pā la k+ṣe tra pā la ma hā shu la tsa tri saṃ bha ye i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: bran g.yog mang po yang 'khor 'bum dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i dar zab rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan rkang gling rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: la la sgeg mo la la dgyes pa mo: la la gar mo la la gtum pa mo: la la rngam byed la la ha ha dgod: la las g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhan+dha thogs: la las mi ro za zhing rgyu ma 'dren: la las mgo snying nang rol thogs te rgyug: la la gcer mo khrag gi ral pa bsigs: la las klad khrag 'thung zhing mtshan ma bsgrad: la las khrag rkyal la las nad rkyal thogs: la las lcags phur la las zangs phur 'debs: la las gcan gzan zhon zhing ku sgra sgrog: la las 'jig rten khyo rnams bla tshe rku: la las dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: la las cho 'phrul sna tshogs dgra la 'gyed: la las byad ma nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston pa yi: rnal 'byor chen mo phra men bcu gnyis ma: 'khor ni ma nges 'bum phrag bcu drug 'gyed: dbyings la 'gyu ba'i rnal 'byor bcu gnyis ma: 'og tu 'gyu ba'i sa bdag bcu gnyis ma: srid par 'gyu ba'i skye mched bcu gnyis ma: tshogs khang 'grim pa'i nyul le bcu gnyis ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ma: dus la gnas tshe lo skor bcu gnyis ma: sgrub mchog skyong tshe sngags srung bcu gnyis ma: don la ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro yang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: cha lugs sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'gyed: bka' yi gnyer gtad ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ḍāk+ki dā sha dī ya: rak+sha li dā sha dī ya: ma tri dā sha dī ya: yo gi dā sha dī ya: du pra ma li dā sha dī ya: yak+sha li dā sha dī ya:

maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭha pa la dā sha dī ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rngam byed rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: ru tra dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ro ṣa na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ru tra a mu ka bigh+nān mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo nan nan: zhes gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor: lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: yang gsang 'dus pa bla med dkyil 'khor lha: thugs rje skur bzhengs rig 'dzin bdag cag la: bum gsang shes rab ye shes dbang bskur dang : 'chi med rig 'dzin gzi byin mthu dang stobs: snyan grags mnga' thang longs spyod chos dang srid: yid la bsam pa'i 'dod rgu mchog thun rnams: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā āḥhrīḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na badz+ra ku mā ra hṛ da ya sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: byin rlabs chu bos bdag rgyud smin par shog: yi dam bkra shis yang phur he ru kaḥ dngos grub 'dod rgu'i gter la spyod par shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dbyings phyug rgyas 'debs ma: snyan brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing brtan par shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan nag po che: log 'dren tshar gcod phrin las 'grub gyur cig: gter srung bkra shis btsan rgod myur mgyogs bdun: zab chos skyong ba'i bya ra 'grub par mdzod: gter gnas bkra shis sha 'ug stag gi sgo: bod khams yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog: bdun pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ ma skyes stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' shar ltar: sgyu ma'i rnam rol cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: mi dmigs ka dag rang rig mkha' la bsdu: 'od gsal gshis lugs gnyug ma zang thal āḥ a a āḥ zhes rang byung 'od gsal rdo rje snying po lhun grub gdod ma'i gshis lugs su mnyam par bzhag:

rdzogs chen ye grol mnyam bzhag rjes thob med tshul shes kyang : 'khos chung rnams la 'di tsam 'os: brgyad pa bsngo ba byed pa ni: hoḥ rang byung snying po dpal yon las 'khrungs pa'i: bla med byang chub rgya mtsho dge bcu'i tshogs: snying po'i dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed pa'i phyir: mtha' yas ma gyur mchog gnyis thob phyir bsngo: dgu pa smon lam ni: hoḥ chos dbyings ye shes snying po'i gzi byin gyis: dngos rlom rmongs pa'i ma rig tshogs gzhom ste: don gnyis shes rab drwa ba'i rtsal rdzogs nas: kun nas kun kyang mchog tu reg gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas legs par gdab: sa ma ya: e ma rgya gar kho bo rig 'dzin pad 'byung ngas: klong yangs thugs rjes 'gro la brtse ba'i phyir: ma 'ongs don du yang phur sgrub pa bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: zab chos 'di yi 'gro don 'dul zhing ni: nyi shu'i mgo tshugs yang mtha'i dus dang mnyam: sa rtags mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung dbus su 'khrigs: dur sa phyogs nas mkhar rdzong kun la 'debs: bod kyi mdun ma lcang kha'i byi'u chung 'dra: lo zla zhag dus rim pas dmag 'khrug g.yo: chos rgyal gyis bzhengs gtsug lag phal cher 'joms: zog po khrims ral dam nyams lung pa 'gengs: gsang sngags bstan pa nyams pa'i snga ltas su: gter ston yin zer rtags bdun mi shes shing : kun la zag pa bsags pa'i blo rten du: gter chos yin zer bca' bzhi ma tshang ba'i: dpe rnying dkrugs pa'i bslu chos mang po 'byung : kho bos bka' gtad kha byang ma thob pa'i: nyams dang rmi lam tsam la byung zer ba'i: bdud kyi cho 'phrul grub thob cher rlom ste: gzu lum ras chod gter du kha 'dogs nas: gsang sngags dkrugs shing bstan pa'i sel byed mkhan: bdud dang the'u rang sprul pa mang du 'byung : khyad par lnga brgya tha ma de yi dus:

chos dang chos min dbye ba mi phyed nas: bslu brid zol zog g.yo rgyus sems can 'dul: rgyu 'bras gzu bor bzhag na kun gyis smad: dkon mchog dpang du btsugs kyang skyon du blta: kun khur dman sa bzung bas tha mal mthong : rang 'dod snang sems mtho de lha ltar mchod: chos la rgyab gtad mi dge dpang btsugs pa'i: mi chos mgo skor mkhan la skyabs su btsal: bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams ni dmangs su 'khyams: gsang sngags bstan pa nyi ma'i ba thag tsam: mthu dang chos la ris su mi phyed dus: bod khams mi rnams mi bde chu ltar khol: de rnams thams cad dus kyi sa rtags te: ma 'ongs de dus bod 'bangs skyob pa dang : bstan pa'i snying po srog shing 'dzugs pa'i phyir: yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag 'di nyid zab: kun gyi nang nas yang bcud dril ba 'di: tshig nyung don che cha tshang gnad kyang 'dus: mthong ba kun kyang mos pa'i byin rlabs 'ur: 'di dang 'phrad pa tsam gyis grol nus pa'i: yid bzhin thugs kyi nor bu bla na med: brgyud pa khungs btsun zab khyad bzhi tshang zhing : nges don mngon du phyung ba'i yang snying 'di: skal ldan smon lam can gyi don du bzhag: ma 'ongs snyigs dus yang mtha'i bskal pa ru: gnubs kyi lo tsā bud+dha dzñā na ba: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags nas: brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod byed des: rgya bod gangs can gnas mchog nyul ba'i tshe: yang snying zab chos 'di dang 'phrad par shog: sha 'ug sbas lung stag sgor a thaṃ rgya: rol pa btsan rgod spun bdun bka' gtad rgya: las can thugs kyi sras la sprod cig rgya: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: stobs ldan me rlung gwa'u kha sbyor rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra kho bo rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs te/ glang lo'i glang zlar shog ser nas phab pas drag po nyer dgu'i nyin grub bo//

// ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: stobs ldan phur pa nag po'i hūm̐ sgrub bzhugs: dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma rtsal chen stobs 'byin pa: yang phur nag po'i sgrub pa 'di: kun gyi thun mong ma yin zab: khyad par ban bon sngags pa dang : lha srin 'byung po gdug can gyis: bar chod 'tshe ba ldang gyur na: de tshe 'di nyid shin tu gces: spros med sgrub pa khyad mchog go: sa ma ya: dang po dran rdzogs lha bskyed ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kham nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: khro gtum tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: g.yas gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i ban bon 'joms: g.yon gnyis me phung kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog snying phral: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po rdul du rlog: sgro gshog spu gri brgyangs pa yis: snang srid kun gyi cho 'phrul zlog: 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad kyis: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gyis: dam sri 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham gyis: stong khams ru tra'i srog dbugs phral: sku la me dpung 'khrigs pa yis: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs sreg: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: khro rgyal stobs ldan kī la ya: bdud 'dul dpal gyi sku ru shar: dbang sdud zil gnon lhun gyis grub: bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: grags stong ngang du ci nus bzla: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: yang zab snying gi sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs nas sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las legs par bshus pa'o//

// bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: srung zlog gur gyi drwa mig bzhugs so: bla med yang gsang rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: srung zlog bya ba'i rim pa ni: dmigs rkang las rim gzhung ltar shes: bsdus na bskyed rdzogs 'di ltar bya: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas bsad pa bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru kaḥ grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces bzlog pa'i dmigs rim bcas rgyud ltar bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: rdo rje dpa' bo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

bla ma dang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa yis: yang snying dpa' bo lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi: bsgrub pa'i zab rgya gnad kyi man ngag bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi lag len ni: nyams dga' dben pa'i gnas su cha rkyen bsags: 'bru tshom kha ru bum gdan dkyil 'khor bzhag: de steng rnam rgyal bum pa rdzas kyis bkang : kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham: tshogs dang mchod rdzas spyan gzigs gang 'dzoms bkram: bgegs bskrad bya zhing srung 'khor bsgoms nas su: mchod rdzas dmigs par byin brlabs dal du 'jug: sa ma ya: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: oṃ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes bum pa byin gyis brlabs: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes phyi mchod byin gyis brlabs: sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs pho brang 'bar ba'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i dbus: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud:

gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed med dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dmigs pa spro bsdu la sogs gzhung ltar bya: spros med lugs su bsgrub na mchod pa dang : spros pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs med par bya: rten 'brel thabs gtso spros pa byed mos na: sngon 'gro dang ni rjes rim 'di tsam sbyar: hūm̐: dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: yang dag ye shes dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlabs brtan par bzhugs: dug lnga rnam dag phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi:

de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: de nas dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas lhan skyes rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: lnga ldan ye shes byin rlabs nus mthu yis: skal ldan bdag la dbang bskur rgyud smin te: mchog thun 'bras bu yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra baṃ ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing dmigs pa'i spro bsdu ngang nas rang la bstim: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i yang snying dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi: man ngag gdams pa snying gi thig le bzhag: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las byang phrin las rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: dpal chen yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yang zab sgrub pa snying gi thig le las: gsang ba'i las byang yid bzhin nor bu bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: bdud rigs sems can dmu rgod rnam rtog rags: de yi rkyen gyis dug lnga'i chos shig dar: gsang sngags chos kyi sgrom bu bun ltar gtor: sdug bsngal rnam smin las dbang zad mtha' med: sems can skyabs med dbul phongs a tsa ma: gang phyir pad 'byung nga yi smon lam gyis:

gnubs kyi lo tsā bud+dha dzñā na 'di: skye ba du mar sems can 'gro don byed: lan gcig yul gyi stod dag la: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags nas: bod 'bangs skyob pa'i gter kha dpag med 'byin: ma 'ongs de dus zab chos 'di 'byung ste: 'brel tshad byang chub thob par lung yang bstan: bka' yi rgya 'di ma mo gsum gyis srungs: gter min bdud rigs lag tu ma sprod par: pad 'byung nga yi thugs sras de dang sprod: gnas chen sha 'ug stag sgoṛ atsha rgya: sgra gcan me rlung gwa'u dmar nag rgya: dang po thun mong sngon 'gro bcu bzhi dang : dngos gzhir nyer gcig rjes la bcu gnyis so: dang po sbyang ba dbyer med sngon 'gro ni: ho: 'khor 'das mnyam yang phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs par de bzhin sems bskyed do: gnyis pa ni: na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum: kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: gsum pa ni: hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'gyed pa pho nya'i tshogs: bar med khyab pas bgegs tshogs ma lus kun: a 'thas gzhom phyir gtor ma len par khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnyis 'dzin ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bzhi pa ni: hūm̐: snying rje'i sbyin yul ma rig bgegs kyi tshogs: rtog med de bzhin gtor mas tshims par dengs: ci ste mi 'gro zhen pas bcings srid na: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra bidh+wa dzñā na mā ra sarba bigh+nān tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa ni: ham̐'u: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag: ye nas ma bcos gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin rlung lnga srung ba'i gur: so 'thab 'khrigs pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tra ya maṇ+ḍa la yaṃ pañtsa sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: drug pa: hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: phyi mchod kun bzang mchod sprin gyur: oṃ sarba puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

bdun pa: hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong snod yangs mchog: nyi zla zhu ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ a haṃ pū dza hoḥ brgyad pa: hūm̐: 'dus byas rnam dag stong pa'i snod: phung khams skye mched bdud rtsi spel: oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: dgu pa: hūm̐: rdo rje'i mtshon bsnun ma rig bsgral: rgyud drug dmar chen sna tshogs gyur: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa āḥhūm̐: bcu pa: hūm̐: kun gzhi lhun grub bhan+dha ru: rnam thar bcu gnyis gtor mar gyur: oṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hūm̐: bcu gcig pa: hūm̐: rtsa ba gsum gyi brgyud pa yis: sku lnga ye shes byin phob cig: oṃ a be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭha ham̐'u: bcu gnyis pa: hūm̐: rang rig lta ba'i zhal mjal phyir: rnam dag thugs kyi brda sgo dbye: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gsum pa: hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis su med: de don ma rtogs gol bar bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bcu bzhi pa: hūm̐: gnas lugs rig pa'i gzung thag gis: rang rtsal dkyil 'khor mi gtong bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dang po ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong chen kun tu khyab: ngo bo lhun grub blo 'das ngang : oṃ dharma swa bhā hoḥ gnyis pa: hūm̐: rang bzhin ma grub rtsal chen gyis: sgyu ma'i rlung gis cho 'phrul 'gyed: oṃ swa bhā dharma hūm̐: gsum pa: hūm̐: kun tu sgyu ma'i snying po yis: mkha' ltar bdag med sa bon shar: oṃ hūm̐ baṃ dharma hṛ da ya hūm̐: bzhi pa: hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i 'byung lnga la: sor rtog yi ge rim par shar: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: lnga pa: hūm̐: gdan steng yab yum sbyor ba'i sras: 'khor tshogs zhal phyag ma 'dres rdzogs: oṃ pad+ma sūr+ya ti ra baṃ: maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐ swa bhā haṃ swā hā: drug pa: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ las rlung : ram̐ las me ri kham̐ las chu: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ rus ri: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rdzogs:

dbus su mdzes tog phyi rol gur: mtshan tshang drag po'i pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bdun pa ni: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'dus las: che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: bco brgyad phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin: gri gug ral gri dbyug to dang : rdo rje tho ba gsal shing khyung : 'khor lo nor bu bcas pa g.yas: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ thong gshol rnga: lcags sgrog rgyu ma dril bu zhags: phur pa dang bcas g.yon du bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs brgyad khro rol gyad kyi 'gros: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: gri thod drug bcas mgul 'khyud stob: sku las skyes pa'i me ri 'bar: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka ru: nī laṃ mchod rten sngon po'i dbus: bum pa'i gzhal yas lte ba'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : ma hā badz+ra ku mā ra: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: mthing dkar dmar ba'i rngam zhal brjid: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : rdo rje thod khrag stobs te 'khril: thugs kar sems dpa' srog yig bcas: mi bzad 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: yab yum rdo rje pad+ma'i tog: bu ga'i yi ge dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zung 'jug bde stong rol pa las: hūm̐ bzhi baṃ bzhi sras su shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs te khrag 'thung bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad dbal: rtse dgu rtse lnga me kha ṭ+wāṃ:

phyag gi mtha' gnyis phur pa bsgril: rigs bzhi yum 'khril sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgur gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: yab yum gsang ba'i bu ga nas: hūm̐ yig baṃ yig phyogs bcur 'phros: khro bcu yab yum mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phra thabs gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti dā sha ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: slar yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bar ba'i gar: phur skyong nyer bzhi mi bzad tshogs: yang 'khor sprul sogs so sor gsal: oṃ ma ti kro ti ghṛ wa lak+ṣi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ brgyad pa: hūm̐: ye shes phur pa bskyed pa'i lha: gsal rdzogs mi g.yo brtan pa'i phyir: deng 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dgu pa: hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag dpal chen phur pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ bcu pa: hūm̐: rang bzhin brtan pa'i sgyu rtsal lha: bzhugs mdzad dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs can: gdod nas ma bcos rang byung ba: rol pa'i khrag 'thung che la 'dud: oṃ sarba tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na maḥsarba hāṃ sa pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gcig pa: hūm̐: dbang po'i 'bras bu tshim byed pa: lha mo sna tshogs phyi mchod 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu gnyis pa: hūm̐: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi mchog: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa khā hi: bcu gsum pa: hūm̐: rig ma bcu drug mi phyed sbyor: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mchog:

dug lnga rnam dag sman mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bco lnga pa: hūm̐: 'khor 'das rgyu drug bsgral ba yi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bcu drug pa: hūm̐: phung po lnga nyid ye shes su: bsgyur ba'i ba ling mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu bdun pa: hūm̐: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: nyams chag bskang dang bshags phyir 'bul: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ bco brgyad pa: hūm̐: mchod yul bskang bya mi dmigs pa: kho na de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: oṃ sarba dharma swa bhā wa pū dza hoḥ bcu dgu pa: hūm̐: che btsan yang dag he ru kaḥ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: bco brgyad mtshon chas dug lnga gzhom: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' la bgrad: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' bar 'gro: dor stabs zhabs kyis ri rab brdzis: sbyor ba'i yum chen shwa rī ma: bde stong zung 'jug gri thod bsnams: rgyan drug rol pa'i gar stabs can: dpal chen yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: thugs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa po: khro bo'i zhal rab gdangs shing rngam: phyag mtshan drug gis rig sngags gcod: rdo rje sgro gzengs me char 'bebs: dgyes pa'i dur khrod chas dang ldan: dor stabs 'gying zhing dpa' rab 'chang : 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rtsa 'jib ma: khams kun g.yo ba'i zhal mnga' ma: zung 'jug thabs shes 'khyud pa mo: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sgra 'byin ma: drug gis sbyor ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde chen g.yo zhing g.yo ba mo: thugs mchog yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mchog: sems dpa' rdo rje'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol ba: las bzhi'i phrin las dpal yon gyis: mi zad lta ba'i gar 'gyed pa: rigs bzhi'i sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa chen po khyon gyi rtse:

khyab cing sgeg bzhad ston pa po: sa bcu'i lam ni rab bgrod pa: yab yum khro bcur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zer gyis snang tshul cho 'phrul gyis: khyon ltar lta ba yangs shing 'geng : 'bebs pa rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: phra thabs phur 'debs phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nyer bzhi sa yi rim pa bdun: shes rab gcig la thabs drug gi: skur ston gar sgyur nyi shu brgyad: dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: skye mched gnas gsum gzhir dag pa'i: rol rtsal za byed mche ba dmar: las su grub pa'i ma mo'i tshogs: ma sring bcu gnyis khyod la bstod: hūm̐: las mdzad mā ra ya yi tshul: sna tshogs sde dpon gtso dang 'khor: za gsod dbugs la rngam byed tshogs: bcu gnyis sde dpon khyod la bstod: hūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje yi: rtsal gyis sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: srid gsum 'geng ba'i las byed pa: yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: nyi shu pa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti kī li kī la ya sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyer gcig pa: dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: srog ltar mi gtong bsgrubs lags na: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: oṃ sarba gar+bha sid+dhi hūm̐: gsum pa rjes kyi dang po la: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshogs rdzas nyid: dngos 'dzin mi dmigs stong par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren no: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor byin chen phob: sgrub la dbang bskur mchog thun stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa: hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul:

skye med ngang la thugs dam bskang : shes sgrib ka dag klong du bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol: lnga pa: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan bye ba 'bum: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhal du bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: drug pa: hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra la zor gyi las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa: hūm̐: gsang chen ma la mchims phu ru: rgyal kun 'dus pa yab yum gyis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gter srung khas blangs chad mdo bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi:

brgyad pa: hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan gar mkhan mas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: dgu pa: hūm̐: stong gsum ru tra mnan pa'i bro: khro bo khro mos chem chem brdungs: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: bcu pa: hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags dpal: brtan g.yo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: bcu gcig: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong dgu'i gter chen gyis: zab rgyas 'gro kun smin mdzad pa: deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shog: bcu gnyis: hūm̐: mi dmigs dkyil 'khor ka dag dbyings: rang bzhin ye shes klong du ho: a a āḥ rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtsho nyid: mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: bde dge mchog gsum 'dus pa yi: thugs rje'i smon lam de 'grub shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: snying thig yid bzhin nor bu bzhag: yang gsang shog dril mgul khug ma: mthong thos dran reg byang chub thob: mig ltar gces la snying ltar chongs: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya 'di la bya ra gyis: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: mdun bskyed pho brang gi cha bkod bzhugs so: bla med yang phur rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi lag len rnams phra zhib rgyas par 'grigs nas bskyed: las byang sngon du song nas sngags la bskyal: de nas chos skyong rnams gang dgos yongs rdzogs phrin las btang : skabs su gtor mdos la sman raka bran zhing bdun bskyed rten bca' ba ni:

rang nyid ye shes rol pa'i ting 'dzin dang bcas nas 'di ltar 'jug pa'i go rim mo: oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra yo gi ni ma ma ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni tsakra iṣ+ṭi sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas rten gyi srog tu bsgom: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: de yongs su gyur pa las: mdun du drag po'i sa gzhi smug nag rang bzhin gyi me ri dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa de yi dbus su dur khrod kyi gling chen por bam gsar rnying ri ltar du spungs pa klung thams cad dmar chen gyi rgya mtsho rba rlabs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa: de yi dbus su bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las: drag po'i gzhal yas khang rmang thams cad rdo rje'i rgya gram dang khro chu khol ma las grub pa: lte ba'i gnas su thod mkhar dmar nag gru bzhi pa sgo rdzogs ldan zhing : bhan+dha skam rlon gyi rtsig pa ri rab ltar mtho ba: pha gu khro chu las grub pa: 'dod snam lha gnas su khyab par ma mo rnams kyis gar bsgyur ba: rgyu ma'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa la: mi yi glo snying mkhal ma mchin pa mgo dang lag pa'i lda ldi 'phyang ba: shar bu rnams gcan gzan khrag 'thung gi pags pa du ma la byas pa: mda' yab thod tshal phreng ba dang ldan zhing : klu chen gyi ka ba: zhing lpags kyi ka rgyan: lha chen gyi gdung ma: gza' chen gyi ka zhu: sa bdag gi ka gdan: rgyu skar gyi dral lcam phub ste nang thams cad mi lpags stag lpags kyi yol ba bres pa: zham chu dmar chen rlabs su 'khyil pa: steng thams cad ti ra'i rlid bu'i rgyal mtshan la tsit+ta'i tog gis spras shing pho brang gi rtse mor chos 'khor rnams su lha drag po'i nga ro sgrog pa nyi zla'i tog tu he ru ka za byed kyis gar bsgyur ba'o:

phyi rol thams cad me ri rlung nag 'tshubs shing sprin nag po'i 'ur sgra 'byin pa'i nang nas gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs pa: bdud dang srin po sha za gnod sbyin dang ma mo sogs 'byung po'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis 'jigs pa'i gad mo dang rngam pa'i bshugs glu sgrog pa'o: pho brang gi dbus su ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la ru tra ti ra baṃ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa hūm̐ kro ta ya kro ti ya āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes pas pho brang bskyed chog rdzogs nas lha bskyed la 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan: sogs? skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: bar du gzhung bsrang : de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: sha chen gyi gsur btang : rkang chen gyi gling bu bus: rol mo sna tshogs bgyis nas rngam pa'i gdangs dang bcas te 'di ltar bgyid do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa'i pho brang chen po nas: rigs bdag sems dpa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: rngam yangs bde chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: drag po e yi chos 'byung pho brang nas: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcur rang rtsal rol pa'i pho brang nas: khro bcu yab yum phur 'debs gshegs su gsol: drag po'i pho brang gnyer ba'i las mdzad ma: sgo skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: za gsod dbugs la rngam pa'i pho brang nas: pho nya ging bdud nyer bzhi gshegs su gsol: phyag brnyan sna tshogs ma nges bsgyur ba'i tshogs: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po'i phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: ma rungs bdud sde gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol:

oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod e yi pho brang dbus: khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas: byad ma mi ro rta ro'i gdan: bdud srin bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor du: dpal chen lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar stabs kyis: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyag 'tshal bstod: sngags chas 'dzin cing phyi phyag 'tshal: rgyan drug ldan pas nang phyag 'tshal: zag med sbyor bas gsang phyag 'tshal: yang dag mnyam bzhag phyag 'tshal bgyid: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: oṃ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung bhan+dha rin chen snod mchog tu: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmar chen gtams: lbu ba lang long 'phyo zhing phyur ba 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: lcang lo bsigs pa'i ya kha'i snod mchog tu: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mig dang rna ba sna: lce dang snying bcas spungs pa'i me tog tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: hom yangs 'bar ba'i me thab gru gsum du: sha chen sna tshogs gu gul bsregs pa yi: ngad ldan dud pa bun ltar g.yo ba'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: khro chu las grub sra mkhregs kong bu ru: tshil chen rkang mar bzhus pa'i mar khus gtams: nyi ltar gsal zhing 'bar ba'i sgron me 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: drag po'i snod mchog yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dgra bgegs klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs pas gtams: kha ba'i ngad ldan mkhris pas legs bsgyur 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul:

bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: lcags zangs la sogs gtor gzhong khyon chen nang : 'bru nag ngar phye'i dpal gtor rgyan gyis spras: lhun mtho bcud dang ldan pa'i zhal zas 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnga bo che dang thod rnga rkang gling sgra: gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag rnam pa lnga: g.yo zhing 'bir ba 'brug ltar grags pa'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings dang mnyam: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag ri ltar spungs: sbyor sgrol la sogs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nam mkha'i mtha' klas yongs su khyab pa yi: spyan gzigs la sogs lho bun lta bur gtibs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mthun rdzas 'di: dpal chen khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra rak+ta ko la puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta go ro tsa na rak+ta bha ling+ta ye pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa las byang ltar bya: skabs su dzap kyis thugs dam bskul zhing dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dgongs shig dgongs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: bskul lo bskul lo 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang : khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas phrin las bskul: sgrub pa'i lha tshogs bkrag mdangs ya la la: ma bsgoms lha tshogs gsal stong lams se lam:

rol pa'i lha tshogs thig le shigs se shig: zhi ba'i sngags phreng 'ja' 'od spungs se spung : drag po'i sngags phreng tshwa tshwa si li li: gzhan gyi sngags rnams bung ba'i sgra dbyangs ltar: rgyun chad med par 'byin 'jug rlung gis bzla: sku gsum snying po rang shar ci bzhin du: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags kyaiḥ lhag pa'i lha khyod bdag la dgyes par dgongs: 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang dgyes pa'i zhal ston la: sku yi byin rlabs oṃ gyi rnam pa yis: dpral ba nas thon bdag gi spyi bor thim: 'ja' lus bum sku'i lha dbang bskur du gsol: bskyed rim snang stong sgyu ma'i ngo bo rol: gsung gi byin rlabs āḥyig rnam pa yis: mgrin pa nas thon bdag gi mgul du thim: gsang dbang rlung gi sngags nus bskyed du gsol: zab lam bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyed: thugs kyi byin rlabs hūm̐ gi rnam pa yis: thugs ka nas thon bdag gi snying gar thim: ka dag dkyil 'khor sher dbang bskur du gsol: gsal stong spros bral chos dbyings khyab gdal ngang : sku bzhi'i byin rlabs 'od zer rnam pa yis: ngo sprod tshig dbang rin chen bskur du gsol: yang dag ngo 'phrod sku lnga'i don rtogs phyir: deng sang skya rengs dang po dbyings nas shar: rdo rje srin po bde ba'i nam langs nye: mchog thun dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: sgrub pa'i snying po 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: ma yengs mi bsgom gnyug ma'i gzer gyis bsdam: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang kho na: deng nas rang nyid rtsa gsum lha ru shes: 'da' dka' rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan pa'i phyir: mi gtong yid kyi dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung : rang bzhin gsal ba nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: snang la rang bzhin bral 'di e ma hoḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu h+ya sid+dhi hrīḥ

zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha sngags thog mtha' bar gsum gyi bya ba legs par grub pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bstan pa'o: 'di nyid de kha'i 'dzab bskul lam dngos grub 'gugs pa'i skabs kyang rung : nges tshig ni sku gsum ngo bo gcig tu bstan pa'i don no: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: bskyed rdzogs lam gsum gcig tu bstan pa'i phyir: bdag mdun cho ga'i bsgrigs chag mngon rjen bzhag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing me lug lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: bskang ba bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs so: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nyams chag bskang zhing bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms pa'i: rgyud kyi cha lag mchod bskang rim pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: 'di nyid dgos ched go rim bstan pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon thugs 'gal dkyil 'khor gyis: dus mchod chad dang g.yar dam g.yel ba dang : bsnyen sgrub g.yeng dang bag med dam las 'gal: bsrung bar khas blangs bslab sdom yal ba dang : snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul 'byung 'khrugs sogs: mi 'dod rkyen ngan sna tshogs gang shar yang : zab gnad skong bshags 'di yis sel bar byed: de bas 'di nyid 'bad rtsol brtsam par bya: sa ma ya: bskang rdzas gzhung bzhin spyi mthun legs par bsham: rol mo bya zhing rkang gling drag tu gtser: dri bzang spos dang sha chen dud pa bdug: bag dro lhun chags dgyes pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis: bskang mchod cho ga'i rim par 'jug brtsam bya: sa ma ya: dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab cing spel ba ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: 'byung lnga yongs gyur lhun grub dal gyi dbus: gling bzhi'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: rmad byung sna tshogs bkram pa'i mchod sprin mchog: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas bla med gyur: oṃ sarba dharma maṇ+ḍal pū dza hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ dharma dhā tu ma hā me gha āḥhūm̐: oṃ swa bhā dzñā na sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa shrī ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa bskang bar 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min gsang chen lhun grub dur khrod du: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir dgyes shing gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs drag po'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs: 'jigs byed gar dgu'i skur ston tshogs la bstod: phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spyan gzigs 'bul: dpal chen lha tshogs bstod cing thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen yang dag bla med he ru kaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dud sprin gtibs: rkang mar tshil gyi sgron me nyi ltar gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: tsit+ta'i dpal bshos lhun po'i dbyings dang mnyam: rkang gling rol mo'i sgra chen 'brug ltar sgrog: dpal chen lha tshogs dgyes par bskyed pa yi: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang :

shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas: gzugs mdzes gar mo 'bum ni lang ling 'phyo: glu dbyangs sgeg mo'i pi waṃ phyogs bcur sgrog: thabs shes byang sems bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: bsgral mchod sha khrag klad rus khyon yangs khengs: ga ṇa tshogs kyi 'khor lo ye re re: sman mchod dza gad bdud rtsi chi li li: dmar chen mchod pa'i 'od zer ta la la: bcud g.yo zhag gi kyu mo lings se ling : gsang mchod nang gi mchod pa rgya mtsho 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas:

dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha lcang lo ru: dmar chen gtor ma dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: sku 'bag bla 'khor srog rten gnyan po gzung : rten dar g.yab dar ru mtshon mkha' la gzengs: g.yang gzhi rgyan dang bla bre du ma bras: don snying 'phan dang lda ldi sna tshogs 'phyangs: g.yul las rgyal ba'i go mtshon du ma bshams: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thugs dam bskang : kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med klong du bskang : mchod du med de du ma ro gcig mchod: sbyor du med de bde gshegs ye shes sbyor: sgrol du med de gnyis 'dzin dbyings su sgrol: bshags su med de ye grol chen por bshags: 'khor 'das dbyings rig chen po'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ye nas rang byung blo 'das ka dag phyir: bcom ldan yang dag rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : zung 'jug ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i phyir: gsal byed he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : ma bcos lhun grub yon tan kun 'byung phyir:

dpal chen che mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'od gsal dbyings las 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: rdo rje gzhon nu'i yab yum thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul drwa ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i phyir: kī la rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon phyir: ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag phyir: phra men khra thabs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes thabs mkhas sna tshogs cir yang ston: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : tshad med bzhi ldan 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir: sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi gnas su dag pa'i phyir: shwa na ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i skye gnas rnam bzhi'i sgo bcad phyir: re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : rigs drug lam rim gzhi ru 'dren pa'i phyir: sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi ma rig gnas su mthar byed pa: 'bar ba bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med lhun grub phyir: bshan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : kun nas thams cad chos sku'i rol rtsal phyir: sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: chos sku khyab gdal chen po'i klong du bskang : longs sku zangs thal chen po'i klong du bskang : sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol klong du bskang : lta ba ye grol chen po'i klong du bskang : sgom pa mi dmigs chen po'i klong du bskang : spyod pa mtha' bral chen po'i klong du bskang : kun gzhi ma bcos spros bral klong du bskang : lam rnams shar grol 'gag med thugs dam bskang : 'bras bu skye med ka dag klong du bskang : ngo bo gsal la 'dzin med klong du bskang :

rang bzhin stong la bdag med klong du bskang : thugs rje 'khor 'das ro gcig klong du bskang : zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang : khro bo lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang : gnyis med lha tshogs thams cad klong du bskang : dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: kun rtog ma rig bag sgrib byang gyur cig: tshe rabs bsags pa'i las sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu bla med sku gsum thob gyur cig:

gsum pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dam 'gal dbang gyur te: bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa grangs nyung g.yeng ba shor: mchod rdzas phud lhag 'dres dang 'bag pa dang : nya stong lo zla dus kyi mchod pa chag: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig g.yel ba dang : bskang dang sbyor sgrol gnad du ma bsnun sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang zhing : sgo gsum 'dun pa mi phyed drag pos bshags: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab bla med skong bshags rim pa bstan: 'di la 'bad rtsol brtsam pa'i skan ldan kun: tshe rabs bsags pa'i las sgrib bag chags byang : pha rol gdug pa'i bsam sbyor dmod pa zhi: bka' chad 'khu ldog rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur: 'di phyi byang chub reg cing dngos grub 'thob: 'dod yon longs spyod dpal la lhug stsol 'byin: 'di ni zab pa'i mthar thug sa ma ya: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sha 'ug stag sgor mi nub-i atsha rgya: rol pa btsan rgod rgya 'di legs par srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dbang phyug las bskul rdo rje spu gri bzhugs so: ཿ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i mngon spyod las tshogs kyi skabs su gtor ma che ba gcig la 'khor drug khrag kyu nyer gcig zor mde'u ltar la sha khrag gis brgyan par bshams: de nas bskul gyi rim pa ni: hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen ku mā ra'i: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ni: rnam pa gcig tu ma nges kyang : thabs kyis so so'i skur ston pa:

sprul pa nyid sprul pho nya'i tshogs: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams: myur mgyogs las la mngag pa'i phyir: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: phyag gnyen bya gcan ming can dang : chu gnas gdug pa gnyan po sogs: lha srin sde brgyad bshos pa'i bu: mgo brnyan mi sdug srin mo bzhin: gling bzhi 'di ru mi bsrun gzugs: gshin rje'i mi mo mngon rtags can: las mkhan 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog: gnas yul dur khrod brgyad la rgyu: sha khrag dri tshor tshang tshing nyul: bzhin mi sdug cing ku sgra 'debs: la las rtsi shing phyags mas sdud: la las srog gcod srin po rgyu: la las nad yams dal kha 'bebs: la las thog mda' glog ltar sbran: kun kyang mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs: ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: khrag dang nad kyi char pa 'bebs: zhal nas ngan sngags dug rlangs 'thul: snang srid khyab pa'i las byed ma: dpal chen drag po'i bka' mched pas: de ring mngon spyod dus la bab: khrag mchod dgyes pa'i rak+ta 'bul: māṃ sa snying dang nang rol 'bul: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: za byed phra men nyer brgyad tshogs: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir phrin las bskyod: bh+yo bh+yo ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yoḥ dkar mo nyi khri'i las byed ma: g.yag gdong sbrul gdong gzig gi gdong : sre dred dom gdong khu byug gdong : shar gyi ma bdun dgra la bh+yoḥ shar phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bh+yoḥ ser mo nyi khri'i las byed ma: pha waṃ chu srin sdig pa'i gdong : khra gdong wa gdong stag gdong ra: lho yi ma bdun dgra la bh+yoḥ lho phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bh+yoḥ dmar mo nyi khri'i las byed ma: rgod mgo rta gdong khyung gi mgo: khyi mgo pu shud shwa seng gdong : nub kyi ma bdun dgra la bh+yoḥ nub phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bh+yoḥ ljang mo nyi khri'i las byed ma: spyang gdong skyin mgo phag gi gdong :

glang chen chu glang sbrul gyi gdong : byang gi ma bdun dgra la bh+yoḥ byang phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bh+yoḥ rbad pa'i pho nya las mdzad pa: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: myur du sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig: badz+ra ma nu rak+sha si bh+yoḥ prah+ma ṇi bh+yoḥ rau trī ma bh+yoḥ bha na bhe bh+yoḥ ku mā ri bh+yoḥ in+d+ra ṇī bh+yoḥ ka la ma bh+yoḥ badz+ra bhi ka la ma bh+yoḥ a mṛ ta bh+yoḥ su u me bh+yoḥ da dha ha bh+yoḥ rak+sha si bh+yoḥ bhak+ṣa si bh+yoḥ tsa ka la ma bh+yoḥ badz+ra ra tri ma bh+yoḥ ru hi ma bh+yoḥ e ka tsa ra ma bh+yoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bh+yoḥ si dha ka bh+yoḥ bha ya bh+ya bh+yoḥ ku la ma bh+yoḥ badz+ra ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ag+na ye bh+yoḥ bha ra hi bh+yoḥ tsa mun tri bh+yoḥ ur+dha ma bh+yoḥ bha tu kha bh+yoḥ lam+bho dhā ra bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas dbang phyug las zor dmigs pa spro bsdu sogs spyi ltar las: rang nyid dpal chen lha yi nga rgyal gyis bskul bas dregs pa gnas nyul gyi tshogs thams cad sgrol byed kyis mtshon cha gzir ba'i dbal can byad ma'i yul zhing sogs gang la dmigs pa rdul du brlags par mos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: phur skyong bcu drug gi gtor bskul dug mda' spu gri bzhugs so: dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu'i phrin las bdud rgol 'joms par byed pa phur skyong bcu drug tu grags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod phreng skabs gtor chen bskul ba ni: gtor snod gang rung gsum mam bzhi bhan+dha lcags zangs sogs kyi snod du: thog mar bswe mo bzhi la dpal gtor nag po g.yon gcus: ljang gu bya rog mgo: dmar po g.yas gcus: sngon po sbrul dkris: ming po bzhi la dmar gtor rtse zur bzhi yod pa dmar nag dkar ser yin:

ging bzhi la dpal gtor nag po: dmar gtor sho ris: nag po khram ris: dkar po gru lag: sngon po chos 'byung bcas gri ris bya: re ti bzhi la sog kha'i steng du dpal gtor chu ris sngon po: me ris bu pang : sa ris ri rab: shing ris gru bzhi bcas kha dog rang mdog bya: mar rgyan mtheb skyu ci rigs sha dum bcas la dpal 'bar yang btsugs: dag gtsang dang sman raka gis legs par bran la: khro bo'i nga rgyal dang bcas: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phrin las bka' yi bstan srung ma: 'phrul byed gdug pa'i byi nu bzhi: bal yul khud kyi bdud rje'i lcam: mar khu'i mtsho la brten bca' ba: rdo rje ya byin mthu mo che: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ci ltar bsgos pa'i tha tshig bzhin: ma g.yel dam longs bcol ba'i las: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phrin las bka' yi bstan srung ma: kha la rong gi dmu gza'i lcam: zhag gi mtsho la brten bca' ba: rat+na de byin mthu mo che: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ci ltar bsgos pa'i tha tshig bzhin: ma g.yel dam longs bcol ba'i las: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phrin las bka' yi bstan srung ma: mang yul la phreng btsan gyi lcam: khrag gi mtsho la brten bca' ba: pad+ma bswe byin mthu mo che: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ci ltar bsgos pa'i tha tshig bzhin: ma g.yel dam longs bcol ba'i las: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phrin las bka' yi bstan srung ma: snye lam lde'u klu yi lcam:

'o ma'i mtsho la brten bca' ba: karma phag byin mthu mo che: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ci ltar bsgos pa'i tha tshig bzhin: ma g.yel dam long bcol ba'i las: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: bka' nyan mi bsrun shugs 'chang ma: sku nas mched pa'i me ri 'bar: rngam pa'i zhal gyis khrag la dgyes: ral pa'i zer rtser phur char 'bebs: phyag na 'debs pa'i dbal kha thogs: rlung ltar thogs med cang shes zhon: dmod pa'i mtshan ltas dgra la 'bebs: khyed rnams las kyi gnyer len ma: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: nyams pa'i srog rtsa sdud la shog: ma thaṃ ma thaṃ badz+ra: su ru su ru badz+ra: mu ru mu ru badz+ra: dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya mā ra mā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ bswe mo bzhi'i gtor ma phul zhing phrin las 'don sgom sbrags pa gces so: de nas skyes bu bzhi yi gtor bskul ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: phrin las ma bzhi ming po bzhi: bswe lcags dung gser skyes bu'i tshogs: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon chen pos dam mnos nas: yang dag bde gshegs snying po yi: phrin las dbang rtags bka' bsgos ltar: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: rdzu 'phrul mngon spyod ltar bskyod tshe: ya lad ru dar tshubs se tshub: ya tsha 'od ldan wa la la: stag ral go khrab ljibs se ljib: ru mtshon me lce lhabs se lhab: cang shes 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: gnam sman bu yug thibs se thib: phur bu thog mda' sha ra ra: skyes bu chen po nyi khri stong : bal bod mtshams nas gling bzhir rgyug: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: dge bsnyen sde bzhir mtshan gsol ba: dmar po shan+ta pu ri btsan: 'brong rtse nag po klu yi rje: ldang lha zangs rtse shel ging rje:

rdo rje gnam lha ser po dmu: ming po bzhi yi dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yang phur sngags kyi bstan pa srung : gsang sngags gnyan la dgra dar na: srung ma dam can pho nyar rbad: skyes bu sde bzhi dgra la chos: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sngags srung sde bzhi pho nya'i tshogs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: shrī gh+raṃ ka ra ya: ma ra sa na pra marta na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ skyes bu bzhi yi gtor ma phrin las gzhung ltar bgyis: de nas ging bzhi la ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: bka' nyan ming po ging chen bzhi: 'dzin byed dmar po srin po'i bu: bar snang khams la gling dbang bsgyur: 'ching byed nag po gshin rje'i bu: smag rum mun pa'i rta la zhon: sgrol byed bskos rje brag dkar bu: skye 'gro kun gyi nyin snang bcom: za byed sngo nag gnod sbyin bu: mdze nad gtad khram char du g.yo: bshan pa pho nya sde bzhi'i tshogs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las brtsam phyir: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: khyed la rbad pa'i las bcol ba: 'dzin ging myur mgyogs lcags kyu can: dgra bo'i snying nas zungs la shog: 'ching ging g.yo byed zhags pa can: dgra bo'i mgul nas chings la shog: sgrol ging 'bebs byed lcags sgrog can: dgra bo'i yan lag sdoms la shog: za ging mngon spyod dril bu can: dgra bo myos shing 'bog tu chug: las byed yin no rgyang ma ring : bshan pa yin no rtsal ma zhan: pho nya yin no bang ma bul: srog gcod yin no mthu ma chung : mngags pa'i las la rbad pa'i tshe: rlung las mgyogs pa'i rta la zhon: phyung rdeg mtshon cha thogs ltar phob: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyams pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bstan pa'i ru tra nyes btsugs pa'i:

chos skyong mthu med yin kyang sun: de bas mngon rtags ma zhan par: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ ka taṃ ka ye: dza ye bī dza ye: a tsi te: a pa ra tsi te: ma ra se na: pra marta na ye: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad mā ra mā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ging bzhi la gtor ma 'bul nges tshig ltar ro: de nas re ti bzhir phrin las bskul ba ni: bh+yo bh+yoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: bstan pa'i gnyer skyong re ti bzhi: rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar ma: bying byed 'brug la brten bca' ba: mthing nag dpal ldan re ma ti: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: bar snang g.yo zhing dus bzhi dkrugs: 'byung ba g.yo la brten bca' ba: ser nag dpal ldan re ma dzaḥ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: ri rab g.yo zhing lhun po 'gul: srid pa'i rtse la brten bca' ba: dmar nag dpal ldan re ma tri: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: dbang chen bsgul zhing zhing rdul bsnyil: mchog rab khong gseng brten bca' ba: ljang nag dpal ldan re ma bh+yoḥ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: bh+yoḥ srid pa'i bdag mo dmag la bzhengs: khrag gi rgya mtsho rlabs su 'phyur: dmar yams nad sprin glog ltar 'khyugs: khrag bdag chen mo dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' nad dud sprin mkha' la 'khrigs: 'joms byed me yi bskal pa mched: dus bdag ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ ri rab stong sgras 'gul zhing bsnyil: gnam lcags thog ser bu yug 'thibs: rtsi bcud 'bras bu myos su gshed: srid pa'i ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ nyi zla'i 'od nyams skar mda' gtong : mtshon chas ri rab skye 'gro gum: gling bzhi 'khrugs pa'i dal kha 'bebs: ma mo dus mtshan dgra la bh+yoḥ snang srid g.yo ba'i khrag mig ma: drel zhon bong zhon rlung ltar 'tshubs:

'tshub ma nag pos sa gzhi khengs: nad kyi rkyal kha dgra la phyes: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra la phob: 'brum nag tshad gzer dgra la phob: dgra la dmar nad me ltar byos: dgra la rmi ltas mtshan ngan phob: nag mo 'bum gyis ngu brang rdungs: dgra bo'i khang khyim gshig tu bor: bya nag sha 'thab gshog sgras bskul: gcan gzan sna tshogs zug ngu ldir: dgra bo'i sgo bzhi stong du chug: byer zhig phung thal nang 'thab thongs: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sdig can gyis: snying khrag dkrug cing thang la 'phos: rbad do ma mo mthu ma chung : dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: ma mo'i mngon spyod dgra la phob: rdul ltar brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ nya ka ra i dhan te ma ma shrī kraṃ ka ra ye: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad mā ra mā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ re ti bzhi gtor phrin kha bsgyur ltar bskul: rdo rje phur pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' gter srung ma bcu drug gi gtor bskul dug mda' spu gri 'di las bskul skabs yin na dus mchod dang bstun: dgos ched 'phral du byung na bskul thabs su dgra la rbad na rtags 'byin nges the tshom med mkhar chen mtsho rgyal bdag gi zab rgya bzhi pa spyi lung nas gsal ba ltar ro: khyad par bal bod mtshams su mu stegs mi 'byung bar sa mtshams mdzad pa'i tshe yang phur srung ma 'di kho na la gnyer byang gtad pa dang : bod 'bangs kyi legs nyes phrin las thams cad kyi bya ba 'di kho na la rag las gsungs phur pa spa ma gong khug nas kyang gsal lo: des na nus pa'i srung ma ni gnam lcags thog gi sgyogs chen las: khol phyung nus ldan mtshon thun phyung rdeg sgrom bu'i skor zhes grags pa'o: 'dis kyang bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: nus rtsal rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing chu yos lor nā ga ko ṭa'i nye 'dabs su shog ser nas tshes bco lnga'i nyin zhal phyes pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gter srung btsan rgod kyi gsol kha bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang btsan rgod rol pa khrag 'thung bco brgyad kyi gsol mchod brtsam pa ni: zangs lcags bhan+dha gang rung gi snod du bang rim sum brtsegs kyi kha ru btsan mkhar gru bzhi bzhag /de'i steng la dmar gtor ra dgu pa tsit+ta gsum gyis brgyan pa bzhag: de yang dbus kyi btsan rgod har len chen po yin: de nas rim bzhin btsan rol pa bco brgyad g.yas skor rnam pas: ber ma la ri rab thog mde'u: dmar po kong zor snying brgyan: beng smug chos 'byung bra gzugs: rol pa khrag kong liṅga: lha btsan dkar gtor rtse gsum: mig dmar zangs sho zangs khrab: mtshal stag bam ro zlum po: lho btsan dpal gtor thod brgyan: sog ra g.yas gcus g.yon gcus: zangs ri zla skyong g.yas gcus: sham po rmog gzugs 'phru can: 'bar ba khrag 'thung glo ba'i rgyal mtshan: rdo rje 'bar ba bshos bu rtse gsum: zangs btsan mkhar thab shwa rus brgyan: rong btsan sprel dmar bya dmar: rdor legs ra mgo 'dab can: shel ging phyi ba lag sbrel: de rnams mtho dman cha snyoms bya zhing dkar dmar gyis brgyan: mthar mtheb skyus bskor: mdun du sman raka bsham: sha dum bha ling gi mchod pa bzhag /skabs su tshig dang bstun nas mchod: mchod pa'i 'bag pa thams cad: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ ma hā ku mā ra hṛ da ya badz+ra ye sarba dra byāṃ shwa dha ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bya: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ:

stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ming yig dang po zhu ba las byung ba'i dngos po zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam par spel: khyad par du yang sprul pa'i chos skyong btsan rgod chen po gnas bco brgyad kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs rnams thogs pa med par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs nas rnga gling rol mo drag tu bsgrag: sha chen gyi gsur btang : spyan gzigs dang ru dar sna tshogs mkha' la bsgrengs shing : rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas: rten bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du me rlung 'tshub ma dang khrag gi rgya mtshor mi ro rta ro ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su he tsa tri dang zangs gri ru mtshon las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog can dbu la zangs rmog rtse phran ru dar lnga yis brgyan cing : zhal gyi mche ba bsdams te dpral ba'i khro gnyer sum brtsegs bsdus pa: sku la dar dmar gyi phod kha dang zangs khrab gsol ba: g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba klad la bskor zhing : g.yon dgra bgegs kyi glo snying dang btsan zhags thogs te mchan ru mtshon dmar po bsnams nas stag ral gzigs shubs kyis brgyan pa'o: zhabs la hor lham g.yu mthil gyon zhing sga srab mdzes pa'i zangs rta dmar zhur la zhon nas stong gsum gling gzhi thams cad kha lo bsgyur ba'i las byed du gsal ba'o:

nyid las mi zhan pa'i sprul pa bcu bdun ni: cha lugs phal cher gtso bo la mthun zhing : la las dgra la thog mda' char ltar 'bebs pa: la las zangs mdas dgra snying gzir ba: la las spu gris dgra srog gcod pa: la las dgra bo 'ching zhing drud pa: la las pags pa dmar bshus byed pa: la las bam chen dmar po za ba: la las mgo mjug ldog nas drud pa: la las nang rol rgyu ma 'dren pa: la las don snying dmar po za ba: la las rlid bu khrag rkyal thogs pa: la las bam bkal btsan shwa khrid pa: la las ru mtshon dgra la bsnun pa: la las zangs kyi 'ug pa 'gyed pa: la las mtshal stag dgra la 'phyo ba: la las rlung dmar 'tshub ma 'debs pa: la las 'jigs pa'i bswo sgra sgrog pa: la las dgra la sho khram 'debs pa: gzhan yang ma nges pa'i mdzad spyod sna tshogs mdzad cing mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te dgra bgegs thams cad gsod cing bcad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i las byed du gsal ba'o: yang 'khor du za byed gsod byed sgrol byed 'ching byed sdom byed: bya sha zan gcan gzan khrag 'thung la sogs mdog mi sdug pa'i cha lugs can du ma'i 'khor bcas ldan pa ste: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang : rang rang gi pho brang nas chos skyong chen po sku 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma la ya yi byang shar mtshams: zangs ri rtse dgu'i gnas mchog dbus: mchong lding smug po'i pho brang nas: btsan gyi rgyal po mthu bo che: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan zhing : slob dpon pad+ma'i dam gnas pa: bid+yot+ta mas tha tshig srungs: har len chen po gshegs su gsol: yang le shod du mtshan gsol ba: ber ma chen po gshegs su gsol: byang chub ring mor mtshan gsol ba: dmar po dpon g.yog gshegs su gsol: sha 'ug stag sgor mtshan gsol ba: gnod sbyin bswe khrab gshegs su gsol:

sham bha la ru mtshan gsol ba: rol pa mi gzan gshegs su gsol: ti se gangs rir mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje thog 'bebs gshegs su gsol: bsam yas mchims phur mtshan gsol ba: bshan pa mig dmar gshegs su gsol: yang rdzong shel phug mtshan gsol ba: gnyan stag dmar po gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod tsā rir mtshan gsol ba: gha ya dha ra gshegs su gsol: gzho stod gnas su mtshan gsol ba: sog ra chen po gshegs su gsol: zangs ri gnas su mtshan gsol ba: 'bar ba zla skyong gshegs su gsol: sham po gnas su mtshan gsol ba: myur len har ting gshegs su gsol: sbas lung brgyad du mtshan gsol ba: 'bar ba khrag 'thung gshegs su gsol: gze rgyal gangs su mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: sku rgyal shen ner mtshan gsol ba: gnod sbyin beg rtse gshegs su gsol: rong btsan gangs su mtshan gsol ba: bshan pa rlung dmar gshegs su gsol: gtsug lag skyong bar mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol: dkor gyi srung mar mtshan gsol ba: shel ging rgyal po gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed pa: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus: dgra bgegs mi ro rta ro'i gdan: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus nyid du: gsol zhing mchod pa bzhes slad du: dgyes pa'i ngang gis bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya shu la dharma pā la tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: de nas gsol mchod bya ba ni: sman raka phud dang bha ling bran zhing : hoḥ btsan rgod chen po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mthun pa'i rdzas: rol mo sgra snyan gdung ba'i dbyangs:

yid du bkod dang sprul pa'i tshogs: chos skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: hoḥ rgya gar bid+yot+ta ma la yi btsan rgod har len chen po la gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag gser skyems: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa: bha ling brgyan pa'i mchod pa: btsan bshos dgra snying dmar po: btsan mkhar btsan chas sna tshogs: dar dmar cod pan du ma: gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i bka' dang bstan pa skyongs: grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ yang le shod kyi btsan rgod ber ma chen po la gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag? rak+ta dmar gyi? dgra sha khrag gi? bha ling brgyan pa'i? btsan bshos dgra snying? btsan mkhar btsan chas? dar dmar cod pan? gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i bka' dang bstan pa skyongs: grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ chu mig byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog la gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i? sogs 'gres gong ltar bshangs/ ngar chen dug khrag? rak+ta dmar gyi? dgra sha khrag gi? bha ling brgyan pa'i? btsan bshos dgra snying? btsan mkhar btsan chas? dar dmar cod pan? gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs? dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i?

grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ sha 'ug brag gi btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ sham bha la yi btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ ti se gangs kyi lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ mchims phu brag gi btsan rgod bshan pa mig dmar l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ yang rdzong shel brag gi btsan rgod gnyan stag dmar po l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ mkha' spyod tsā ri'i lha btsan gha ya dha ra l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ gzho stod ti sgro'i btsan rgod sog ra chen po l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ dbu ru zangs ri'i btsan rgod drag po zla skyong l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ sham po'i btsan rgod myur len har ting l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ sbas lung btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung l sha chen? ngar chen?

rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ gze rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ sku rgyal shen ne'i btsan rgod zangs btsan beg rtse l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ rong btsan gangs kyi btsan rgod bshan pa rlung dmar l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ gtsug lag gi btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ dkor skyong btsan rgod shel ging smug po l sha chen? ngar chen? rak+t dgra sh bha ling? btsan bshos? btsan mkhar? dar dmar? gzhan yang? dgyes par? grogs dang? phrin las? i daṃ? hoḥ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul gyi btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa la: gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag gser skyems: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa: bha ling brgyan pa'i mchod pa: btsan bshos dgra snying dmar po: btsan mkhar btsan chas sna tshogs: dar dmar cod pan du ma: gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i bka' dang bstan pa skyongs: grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bar brjod la: de nas bstod pa bya zhing*/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos he ru kaḥ thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje lta bu'i klong : rdo rje gzhon nu yang dag ye shes rol: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ

drag sngags 'bar zhing mched pa'i rang sgra sgrog: sku yi rtsal 'byin 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khro bo gar dgu sprul pa cir yang ston: de ltar dbyings las ma g.yos rang byung lha: dpal chen 'bar ba'i rtsal las shar ba yi: bka' yi las byed gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : srin po khros 'dra 'jigs rung rnam 'gyur can: 'od ldan zangs khrab rmog zhu nyi ltar gsal: ru dar dmar po bar snang 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: zangs gri 'bar bas bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: thog ltar 'gyu ba'i ru mtshon dgra la 'bebs: ma rungs dgra snying gsol zhing btsan zhags 'phen: stag ral gzig shubs dpa' bo'i cha lugs 'chang : sga srab chas ldan zangs rta dmar po zhon: bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum yud kyis bskor: rang 'dra'i sprul pa btsan rgod las la 'gyed: bshan pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin ma ru rtse: cha lugs sna tshogs snang srid 'gengs par ston: bsam pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: om̐ rak+sha ma ru tse shu la pu ri shan+ta tsa ye swā hā:
