de nas phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: dzaḥ rab 'jigs pho brang mchong lding smug po'i gnas: rtag tu 'gyu ba'i byang shar ma ru rtse: sham bha la yi gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : me ri 'bar bar gsang bdag gtum po yis: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gral du bzhag: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i gnyer byang gtad: bla med dkyil 'khor skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung rin chen gter gyi bya ra mdzod: ta ma la ru pra bha hastī la: gsang bdag gtum po'i bka' bab lung bstan rnyed: yang phur 'bum sde'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal tshab mnga' gsol tshe: rdo rje lta ba klong yangs rgyud sde'i don: rig 'dzin rnam gnyis dbyings rig gcig tu rdzogs: dgongs don brda bzhi'i gnyer kha gtad pa'i tshe: gnod sbyin khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: gsang sngags tha tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter srungs phyi nang bar chad sol: yang le shod du gsang phur bka' rgya gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal phur pa'i gdeng tshad thob: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mchims phur yang dag snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad: rje 'bangs grogs lngar gsang phur gtad pa'i tshe: bka' yi tha tshig rol pa mched la gdams: ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin: sngon tshe pad 'byung bka' las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig gnod sbyin mthu bo che: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyongs: sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: bdag gi nor dang ka cha'i phyir la 'brongs: bdag la 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo la: mi rung cho 'phrul sna dgu'i ltas ngan thongs: wa la sprel zhon mang po'i sgo khyim khongs:

a tsar mon pas me 'bud ran 'thag bskor: bya rog 'ug pas sgo rtsar skad ngan sgrogs: ming nas bos la bshan pa'i ki sgra sgrogs: mdze long zha bos cho nge ngu brang rdungs: srod la sngangs skrag smyo 'bog snying rlung 'gyed: gcer bu skra dmar gzengs pas sa gzhi khongs: zangs lcags 'phar spyang mang pos za kha ston: lha yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis bka' chad phob: gshin rje'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis khram la thob: ma mo'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis dmar yams thongs: bdud kyi btsan rgod 'bum gyis zhags pas chings: shel ging btsan rgod 'bum gyis smyo 'bog thongs: bshan pa'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis sho rdel sprugs: gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bum gyis za kha ston: klu yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis mdze char phob: dgra lha'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis thog mda' rdegs: gza' yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis steng grib byos: dam can btsan rgod 'bum gyis khang khyim dkrugs: rmu yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis gnam rdo brobs: yul lha'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis dgra mkhar snubs: chos shig chos shig bshan pa dmag la chos: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: lo zla zhag dus ma bsrings myur du sgrol: sha zo khrag 'thung dbang po phye mar shigs: choms shig thul cig ming yang med par mdzod: gdug cing sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: gsol zhig rol cig tshims par bzhes su gsol: oṃ tha ra ha sha traṃ pi tsi pi tsi ru tra la ma ra ma ra trig trig myog myog thum thum dgra bo'i sha khrag dbang po lnga la kha kha khā hi: braṃ braṃ tre'u tre'u gur len gur len rgyug rgyug dgra bo'i snying la rgyug: srog la rgyug: khrag rtsa la rgyug: khaṃ maṃ shaṃ trig bh+yo bh+yoḥ zlog zlog: ces pas gtor ma dgra phyogs su kha bstan la 'phangs: thal mo brdab dar nag g.yab dmod pa bor dmigs pa ni: btsan gyi rgyal po me 'od gdong gis sde brgyad kyi dmag sna khrid nas dgra bo'i yul zhing khang khyim bcom nas zhal du bstabs te ming yang med par bgyis par bsgom:

'di nyid shin tu do mi gal na 'phang bar mi bya: chad mdo'i mtshams nas 'bul: nges par bskul nas bsgrigs chag bzhin du bshangs: 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong myur mgyogs can te: bshan pa spun bdun zer: rol pa skya bdun: jag pa me len spun bdun: btsan dmar spun bdun: zangs ri spun bdun: tsi'u dmar spun bdun: gnod sbyin spun bdun: a bswe spun bdun: mgar ba spun bdun: dpe har spun bdun: sogs lugs gang drangs kyang don la gnas kyi khyad par dang gang zag gis mtshan gsol ba'i khyad chos so: don la dbang chen hūm̐ ka'i sprul pa kho na'o: 'di zhi ba ltar bsgrub na tshangs pa yin: rgyas pa ltar bsgrub na nor bdag gnod sbyin mdung dmar can yin: dbang ltar bsgrub na rta mchog rol pa yin: drag po ltar bsgrub na btsan rgod yin: dregs pa ltar bsgrub na bshan pa mi gzan bya ba yin: yang phur gyi bka' srung skabs rdo rje theg pa'i gral du tshud cing 'jig rten pa yang cung zad du 'dres: ci zhe na: rgyud srung dang gter srung gi khyad par yin: de ltar gnod sbyin chen po'i las bskul khrigs su bsdebs pa ste nges bar bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: yang phur 'dus pa'i bla med bka' bsrung phyir: lcags shog sngon po nyer gcig logs su bris: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi mtha' ma ru: skal ldan las 'phro can gyis 'byin pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bya ra shog: me 'od gdong khyod gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: bka' yi rgya srungs mi nub-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: man+t+ra dha ra ka ma la ni dī pa ti ram marga ṭa'i lo ru mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing me mo lug lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas mkha' 'gro'i brda sum 'gyur ltar zhal bshus so//

// bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dmag bskul mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: las bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: dar nag gzengs shing dpal chas bsham: bzlog par dug khrag rak+tas bran: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: gdong la khrag zhag thig les brgyan: drag po'i rnga ni chems 'gros brdung : gri rkang gling bu drag tu 'bud: bskyed pa'i lha srung 'khor bcas rnams: go gyon mtshon thogs dmag dpung bskyed: rbad pas las kun 'grub par bsam: sa ma ya: gtor chung dang liṅga bshams la 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: yang dag dpal chen khro bo khrag 'thung tshogs: bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal deng 'dir phyungs: mdzes 'dzum bzhad gshe dpa' ba'i mdangs ston la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku'i rang mdangs drag po 'gyed pa'i tshe: skye med hūm̐ sgra drag po 'u ru ru: ka dag zang thal glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dran rig ma 'gag so ma hri li li: byin rlabs nus rtsal thog rgod sha ra ra: stong nyid mtshon cha drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes lnga ldan me ri wa la la: stobs bcu thugs rje'i tshwa tshwa si li li: rol rtsal sgyu ma'i pho nya sha ra ra: dug lnga sgrol ba'i ging chen nyi li li: rigs drug sa bon sreg pa'i me zhags 'khyugs: rang rtsal rol pa'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rigs drug sa bon sreg pa'i dus la bab: skye gnas sgo bzhi gcod pa'i dus la bab: las ngan duḥkha sbyong ba'i dus la bab: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i dus la bab: sdig can btsan thabs 'pho ba'i dus la bab: sems can ngan song gnas su shor ra re: tha mal 'jig rten dbang du gtong ra re:

bskul lo rbad do 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: mtha' med sems can drongs mdzod las la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: kun bzang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ sems dpa' sems ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ thub drug sgo ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ye shes khro bcu'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ kau sing ma mo'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ dbyings phyug sgo ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ce spyang srung ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bzlog drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha tra tsa tur dā sha kro ta he ru ka pañtsa dā sha ya ma tri sa ma ya duḥkha mā ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog: ces bskul gyi gtor ma 'bul: de nas phur pa'i bskul gtong ba ni: hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras: khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbyings phyug bcas: sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed: rngam gtum gshe zhing mi bzad skur ston pa: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen drag po las la sku bskyod tshe: sku mdog mun nag dud sprin chi li li: dbu skra dug rlangs sngo dmar phyu ru ru: 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gad mo 'u ru ru: mtshon cha'i rtse la glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dur khrod chas la me yi ser ba 'dril: khro bo'i dmag tshogs thog mda' sha ra ra: khro mo'i dmag tshogs tshwa tshwa si li li: las mkhan myur mgyogs bshan pa khyugs se khyug: bya gcan sha za srog len zhungs se zhung : gzhan yang 'khor tshogs sprul pa 'bum dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra sgos dgra 'joms pa'i dus la bab: ban bon byad zor bzlog pa'i dus la bab:

ma rungs dmag tshogs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: sdig can dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra gtong ra re: bskul lo mthu rtsal skyed cig dgra la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa phra men khra thabs dgra la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis dgra la bh+yoḥ ging chen bdud po sde brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra pra bha swa ra ma hā karma tso dā na kī la rak+sha lak+ṣa sri ka nā na a mu ka ru tra mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces bskul zhing gtor ma 'bul: yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul te: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: ci bcol las kun mdzad par bsam: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas byā ka ra bzhin mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas/ raṃ marka ḍa rā dza saṃ ra'i lor gdan drangs shing*/ ha ti rā dza gu h+ya dharma dī pa ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag las: bsad las spu gri'i 'khor lo nag po bzhugs so: bla med yang gsang rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: las mtha' spu gri'i 'khor lo bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang snyigs dus kyi mthar:

bstan dgra sgos dgra rlung ltar 'tshub: khyad par ban bon dam sri'i rigs: bstan la sdang dang nang rgyal byed: rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grims rnams la: dgra rkun chom pos ting 'dzin 'phrog: khyad par ser mo yongs la 'tshe: ma nyes rnal 'byor dgra ru bzung : 'tshe zhing gdug sems sdang gyur tshe: las mtha' bsad pa 'di nyid zab: spu gri phyung rdeg sa ma ya: las can gcig dang 'phrad nas kyang : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: dang po rdzas dang lag len bstan: dgra bgegs bsad dang 'debs pa'i tshe: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: dar mdung mtshon cha sna tshogs gzengs: mdun du gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs bla dwags ming rus gzugs: spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab bzhag: dar nag mun pa nag pos bkab: bsgral ba'i mtshon cha gzhung bzhin thogs: dang po gzu dpang gser skyems btang : las byed sprul pa'i dmag dpung bsdus: snying rje khros pa'i ngang nyid du: las kyi mtha' 'di brtsam par bya: dang po gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang : longs sku ye shes lnga ldan 'khor tshogs la: 'jig rten ma rungs dregs pas phrag dog skyes: dug lnga log rtog sbyor zhing bsnyad btsal bas: rnam dag dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags mnyam bzhag skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: mi rtog ye shes snying po don ma chung : ye bzhugs gdod ma'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas shāka thub kyis: bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las: ma rungs lhas byin nag po phrag dog skyes:

sna tshogs bar chad brtsams shing bsnyad btsal bas: ye shes bdud rtsi gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags ngur smrig chas kyis rab brgyan nas: grangs med chos 'khor bskor ba don ma chung : sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis mkhyen par gsol: byang sems 'phags tshogs gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pad+ma 'byung gnas la: klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' bas: mu stegs bon blon rnams kyis phrag dog skyes: mi mthun dmod pa bor te bsnyad btsal bas: rmad byung bla med gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtshos brgyan: 'ja' lus skye 'chi spangs pa don ma chung : bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams kyis mkhyen par gsol: brda brgyud drang srong grub thob gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: zab gsang snying po a ti bla med la: sde snod lung rigs kun gyi bcud 'dus kyang : nyan thos bshad 'byams dred por chags sdang skyes: mi dge'i lung 'dren sdang sems bsnyad btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags ma bsgoms tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam: gsang sngags thos tsam 'gro 'dren don ma chung : chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mkhyen par gsol: dbyings kyi yum chen gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal bas lung bstan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: gsang mdzod bla med brda bzhi'i klong rdol ba: don med chags sdang can gyis phrag dog skyes: kun slong ci rigs 'brub cing bsnyad btsal bas: sku lnga dam tshig gser skyems 'di bzhes la: che rtags 'phags pa'i gdung gsob dkyil 'khor 'dzin: zab lam mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud don ma chung : lugs gnyis rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: hūm̐: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rjes 'jug rnal 'byor la: bslu med las 'bras bzang po smin pa'i tshe: log 'dren bar chad kun gyis chags sdang skyes:

'khrugs rtsod tshe bsod bcom zhing bsnyad btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags rgyu 'bras dkon mchog dpang du btsugs: phan sems dge tshogs rgya mtsho don ma chung : dkar phyogs dge ba'i lha tshogs mkhyen par gsol: skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyis gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'tsho chos rgyal la: longs spyod mnga' 'bangs 'khor gyis bskor rgyas par: bdud rigs sdig to can gyis phrag dog skyes: dmag 'dren g.yul gshom phung ba'i dgra btsal bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: che rtags dge bcu'i khrims la srol btod nas: mnga' 'bangs snying rjes skyong ba don ma chung : 'di phyi las kyi bdag por mkhyen par gsol: chos 'khor gnyan gyi srung mas gzu dpang mdzod: hūm̐: phyi nang skyong ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po rtsad nas chod: phyi rgyud lha dang srung ma thams cad kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: dgra bo kho rang lha bdud gshed du phob: mā ra ya yi phrin las dus la bab:

gnyis pa hom bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che: sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu shin tu rngam: bco brgyad mtshon chas log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i gar dgu ldan: sgro gshog rtse la mtshon cha si li li: zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs pang du 'khyud: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: ba spu'i bu gar mtshon thogs dmag dpung 'gyed: hūm̐ sgra drag pos pho nya sprin ltar gtibs: rngam gshe rgod pas shan pa rdul ltar 'tshubs: las la chas pa'i srog bdag chu ltar khol: gzir mdzad gnam lcags phur bu 'dril ba yis: dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa'i srog snying phral: 'jigs byed stobs ldan khrag 'thung sku ru gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdun du dgra bo dmigs pa ni: phaṭḥ bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i mdun du: yi ge na nag po las spros pa'i smyo 'bog dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa: de yi dbus su kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom bskal par brtsegs pa'i mun nag ltar dum bu gcig tu 'khrigs pa: de yi nang du nṛ tri dmar nag las skyes pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma de nyid: lus sngo nag bam bzhin ham pa shi mig can bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bkyigs shing bshan pa srog gcod bzhi yis 'dzin pa kho yi spyi bor gnam lcags kyi spu gri ngar ma las grub pa'i 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas klad khrag thams cad phye mar dkrugs pa: spu gri'i so la yi ge raṃ dmar nag 'phros pas: rtsa srog tsit+ta'i lam du zhugs pas bla snying dwangs ma'i sbubs su tshud pas rlung gi spu gri dmar nag gnyis su gyur nas las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor te:

bla srog rnam shes kyi rten rnams khrag skyo ltar dkrugs: slar yang 'khor lo de las spros pa'i rtsibs ldan grangs med kyis dgra bo'i phung po khyab par 'khor te dbang po lnga yi rten rnams brlag cing bcom ste dum bur gtub pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: oṃ raṃ haṃ shaṃ kā la rak+sha ma tri du na khaḍ+ga tsakra ya a mu ka nṛ tri trig nan e hur thuṃ rbad myog: gsum pa 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang : chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum rje 'bangs grub thob bka' bab rgya mtsho bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : che mchog bla med yang dag he ru ka yab yum rigs bzhi: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis: 'bar ba khrag 'thung drug cu: bka' nyan ce spyang ma mo 'bum phrag sa ya la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras bzhi: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu: za byed kyi pha bcu: gsod byed kyi ma bcu: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: sgo ma rigs bzhi: ma mo rigs bzhi: bdud mo rigs bzhi: srin mo rigs bzhi: las mkhan rigs bzhi: srog bdag bdud bzhi: bshan pa btsan bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang le shod kyi btsan rgod ber ma chen po: bid+yot+ta ma'i btsan rgod har len chen po: byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog: sha 'ug brag gi btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab: sham bha la yi btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan:

ti se gangs kyi lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs: mchims phu brag gi btsan rgod bshan pa mig dmar: yang rdzong brag gi btsan rgod rgya stag kha che: mkha' spyod tsā ri'i lho btsan gha ya dha ra: gzho stod ti sgro'i btsan rgod sog ra chen po: zangs ri'i btsan rgod drag po zla skyong : sham po'i btsan rgod myur len har ting : sbas lung btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung : gze rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba: sku rgyal shen ne'i zangs btsan beg rtse: rong chen gangs kyi btsan rgod bshan pa rlung dmar: gtsug lag dkor skyong btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa: yul ri dben gnas btsan rgod shel ging smug po la sogs pa bshan pa srog bdag rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par chos skyong dam can srung ma rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa khyed rnams kyi bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sgos dgra: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba: ma nyes do bsdo kha yog 'gel ba: khyad par nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen: tshe rabs las la grub pa'i bdud: smon lam ngan pas 'brel ba'i dgra: bsam ngan gdug rtsub 'chang ba'i 'dre: khyad par dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: snga dgra yid la bsam zhing : da dgra thad du langs pa: mthu bu lon bzhin du bsnyag pa: gdong la langs shing 'gras ya btsugs pa: longs spyod za lam du dug gtong ba: 'gro lam bsam ngan gyi rtsang 'dzugs pa: gdong nas skra ltar g.yeng ba: zur nas khyi ltar zug pa: rgyab nas gshed bzhin 'brang ba: ngo bstod lkog nas smad pa: shag ngan sna 'dren byed pa: phu yi chos g.yag 'phrog pa: mda' yi zhing khang bcom pa: ri rgya rlung rgya 'don pa la sogs pa rnams dang :

mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: phod btsugs pa: do bsdo ba: 'gras btsal ba: ya bo bzung ba: khyad par bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: bran g.yog dam nyams bdud rigs: nyos pa'i chung ma snying ngan: gsos pa'i le'u lha log: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan la sogs pa lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rigs sum brgya drug cu: nad bdag rkyen ngan sna 'dren dang bcas pa: gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo gang yin pa de: las byed pho nya rnams kyis lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungs: zhags pa can gyis ske nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis myos su chug: las rlung drag po'i rta la skyon: mun nag 'jigs pas mdun nas bsus: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis mgul nas khrid la rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bo dza dzaḥ oṃ rat+na pā sha dgra bo baṃ baṃ: oṃ pad+ma s+pho ṭa dgra bo myog myog: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe dgra bo chom chom: oṃ pra we sha ya phaṭ dgra bo phyes phyes: oṃ a be sha ya dgra bo bkug stims: mā ra nṛ tri bhan+dha rbad bh+yo: bzhi pa pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na srog bdag ma mo che: mthing nag gdug pa'i kha rlangs can: myur mgyogs lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon: dgra bo'i srog len zhungs se zhung : lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri nā ga dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na dbugs len ma mo che: dmar nag khrag gi bu yug can: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum zhon: mi snyan skad sgrogs tse re re: lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri shu la dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na bla 'khyer dus bdag ma: ser nag na bun thu lu lu: za byed 'phar ba lce brgyad zhon: cho nge ngu zug di ri ri: lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri du ya dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i pho nya mo: shwa na mdangs 'phrog tshe len ma: sngo nag mun rum phyu ru ru: srog gzan g.yu khyi mgo gsum zhon: mi sdug 'dre zug congs se cong : lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rang 'dra'i ma mo bye ba 'bum: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha ra ra: bsgral ba'i phur 'debs hri li li: bla rkun ma mo las la chos: rak+ta khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: dus dang chu tshod ma 'da' zhig: oṃ shwa na ma tri ya ma dgra bo a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lnga pa lha dang dbye ba ni: hūm̐: mthing nag dpal ldan re ma ti: ser nag dpal ldan re ma dzaḥ dmar nag dpal ldan re ma dzuḥ ljang nag dpal ldan re ma bh+yoḥ

srog bdag ma bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes: dgra lha lus lha srog lha phyes: srung lha skyes lha yul lha phyes: ban bon skyabs dang mchod lha phyes: dgra bo'i mgon skyabs thams cad phyes: rdzas ngan dud pas myos par gyis: dug mda' nag pos 'bigs par gyis: spu gri dmar pos g.yas nas phyes: chu gri sngon pos g.yon nas phyes: rlung gri ljang gus rgyab nas phyes: sa gri 'thib pos dbang po phyes: phyes shig rmug 'thibs 'khrugs par gyis: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo rak+mo rak+sha ma tri ya ru tra bhan+dha pra be sha ya phaṭḥ drug pa bdud dang sprad pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ya byin lcags phur ral pa can: de byin gser phur ral pa can: bswe byin zangs phur ral pa can: phag byin mchong phur ral pa can: bshan pa ma bzhi'i dus la bab: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di: 'chi bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: srog bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: las kyi bdud dang da sprod cig: rkyen dbang bdud dang da sprod cig: log pa'i bdud dang da sprod cig: lag dmar bdud dang da sprod cig: dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di: bdud dang sprod cig myur du sgrol: oṃ ma tri ya tri rak+sha mā ra ma du dgra bo baṃ log hu ti ya mā ra rbad bh+yoḥ bdun pa dgra bo spu gris bskor ba ni: hūm̐: rak+sha ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: ya ma ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: pra ma ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: yak+sha ghṛ wa'i dus la bab: khyed rnams las kyi pho nya ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs spyi gtsug tu: spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo bskor: dgra bo'i klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs: 'khor lo lnga yi 'du byed gtor: dbang po rnam lnga'i khrag rtsa myog: srog rten phung po smyo 'bog dkrugs: g.yas su bskor zhing pho rgyud chod: g.yon du bskor zhing mo rgyud chod: khyab par bskor la rigs rgyud chod: phye mar gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ya dgra bo pi ta se shrī ro hab sha thum ling myog ling rbad tsakra kā ya bhan+dha bhan+dha mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ brgyad pa dgra bo byad du bcug pa ni: hūm̐: shar bdud dkar po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i lha srung byad du chug: lho bdud ser po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i nor rdzas byad du chug: nub bdud dmar po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rgyud byad du chug: byang bdud nag po'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i bla rten byad du chug: shar lho'i btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo'i yul mkhar byad du chug: lho nub btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo'i dbang thang byad du chug: nub byang btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo khram khas byad du chug: byang shar btsan rgod dus la bab: dgra bo mnan gtad byad du chug: bdud btsan bshan pa'i dus la bab: byad du chug cig mā ra ya: oṃ du pra ma ya dgra bo ka khor+dha mā ra ya nan bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: oṃ ya ma ya dgra bo a pa ta nan: oṃ ru tra ka wa satwaṃ bha ya nan: dgu pa dgra po bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen ku mā ra: 'jigs byed khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rang bzhin thugs las spros pa yis: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: stod ni khro rgyal 'bar ba'i gzugs: rngam pa'i zhal gsum me ltar 'bar: phyag drug mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : las mkhan dmag tshogs nyi li li: sku smad gnam lcags ngar ma yi: phur gsham rngam stabs hri li li: khro chu'i tshwa tshwa thu lu lu: srog bdag las la rngam pa yi: bshan pa phur bu stobs ldan pa: dgra bgegs snying la kī la ya: klad rgya'i mgo la kī la ya: lta byed mig la kī la ya: nyan byed rna bar kī la ya: dri tshor sna la kī la ya: ro 'dzin lce la kī la ya: snyob byed lag par kī la ya: 'gro byed rkang par kī la ya: reg bya lus la kī la ya: don snying lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes sgo dgur kī la ya:

zhe sdang pho la kī la ya: 'dod chags mo la kī la ya: gti mug rigs rgyud kī la ya: yul mkhar khyim la kī la ya: nor rdzas phyugs la kī la ya: dgra bgegs sgrol cig kī la ya: dkar nag mtshams su kī la ya: 'du byed rnam shes rten dang phrol: dug gsum bsgral nas skye med ngang : ming rjes shul yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ yak+sha kī la ru tra mā ra mā ra: bhan+dha myog thum rbad: ha la ha la mā ra ya bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ bcu pa rnam shes chos skur spar ba ni: hoḥ skye med ye shes lnga ldan dbal phur gyis: mtshan 'dzin dug gsum phung po bsgral ba yi: rlung rig ngo bo rnam shes a dkar de: mi dmigs ka dag chos sku'i klong du 'phros: ye grol mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭḥ bcu gcig pa thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po sha rī raṃ: lha rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: zi ra gnam lcags thog chen gyis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ta ti la dgra bo mā ra ya an+dha bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dug thun nag po rlung ltar 'tshubs: gshin rje yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: myos byed dug mda' nag po yis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ ya ma ha la ka la dgra bo mā ra bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs: ma mo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: khrag nad dmar yams chu ltar khol: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ ma tri rak+ta ya dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: srog bdud yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: pha lam khro chu myur 'bebs 'dis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ du pra ma she la du ya mā ra dgra bgegs bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: ke tshe shang tshe glog ltar 'khyugs: shel ging yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku:

reg chod srog gzer smyo 'bog 'dis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ she la ra tsa khaḍ+ga bhan+dha mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: tsher mda' drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: btsan rgod yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: gzer mda' drag po sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ shu la tsa tri ka khor+dha mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: me thun drag po lhabs se lhab: gnod sbyin yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: bsregs dang tsha ngar 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ rak+sha raṃ dz+wa la mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: chu thun mdze nad thibs se thib: klu bdud yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: sngo nag sbos 'gas rlangs thabs 'phyur: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ nā ga ra mā ra dgra bo bh+yo bh+yoḥ

bcu gnyis pa gtub pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni badz+ra he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na gri gug lcags kyu bsnams: lcags kyus zungs la gri gug gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yo: dgra bgegs bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni rat+na he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams: zhags pas chings la ral gris gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ rat+na kro ti he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na dgra satwa lcags sgrog bsnams: lcags sgrog sdoms la dgra satwas gtub: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ pad+ma kro ta he ru ka kī la ya ham̐'u bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni karma he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug dbal gyi gsham: phyag na dril bu phur pa bsnams: dril bus myos la phur pas dkrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ karma kro ta he ru ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs mā ra mā ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga ni khro bcu yab yum sku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: phyag na rdo rje hom gtun bsnams: rdo rjes hom du phye mar rdungs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ta kro ti dā sha ya baṃ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du tri dz+wa la ya dgra bgegs kyi srog la rbad rbad: dbugs la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: 'du ba drug la rbad rbad: gzugs phung brgyad la rbad rbad: rgyu lam dgu la rbad rbad: mā ra ya: mā ra du: mā ra nan: mā ra baṃ: mā ra trig: mā ra myog: mā ra thum: mā ra rbad rbad: bcu gsum pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: las byed 'bar ba pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: phyag na rngam yangs drag po'i hom thogs te: dgra bgegs sha khrag bdud rtsir bsgyur bas bkang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: gti mug bsgral ba'i sha mchod bla na med: 'dod chags bsgral ba'i khrag mchod rmad du byung : zhe sdang bsgral ba'i rus mchod ngo mtshar che: phrag dog bsgral ba'i mchod sprin a la la: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: dam can gter srung rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: pho nya sprul pa yang sprul zhal phyes shig: hūm̐: klong yangs gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes shig: rngam gzengs gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: myur mgyogs glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: dug gsum dgra bgegs sha khrag zhal du bstab: lhag med bzhes shig ye shes chen por rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa: tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na: bha su ta i daṃ ba ling+ta pū dza la kha kha khā hi: zhes sha khrag phul zhing dgra bgegs lhag med bzhes par bsam: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: spu gri mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhag: ma rungs bstan dgra sgos dgra'i rigs: las mtha' phyung rdeg gu h+ya rgya: mthu chen sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmag nag las: rtsang bskul bshan pa dmag 'gyed bzhugs so: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra drag sngags thod phreng gis: rtsang bskul bshan pa spu gri bstan: bzlog bsad tsa tri nag po ste: rtsang phur dbal kha bstan pa yis: dgra bo phung thal the tshom med: de phyir rin chen gter du sbos: mthu chen de dang 'phrad par shog:

dang po rtsang bzlog gtong ba ni: mdos la rak+tas bran la sha chen gyi dud pa bdug: rol mo 'ur rdung dang mā ra ya yi rngam stabs bya: rkang gling gtong : rang nyid dpal chen gyi nga rgyal dang bcas rngam bzlog bya'o: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dur khrod e yi klong : rab 'jigs bshan pa 'tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: baṃ ri keng rus khrag mtsho'i gdan la bzhugs: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: myur mgyogs las la bskul phyir gnas nas bzhengs: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gnyis pa rtsang gi 'byung khungs bstan pa ni: hūm̐: dang po rab 'jigs rtsang phur gang nas byung : las mkhan rtsang phur mu stegs yul nas byung : zhang zhung nag po rlung 'khor bya ba ru: gdug rtsub 'jig rten dregs pa 'tshogs pa yis: kha di ra dang ha ri dra zhes dang : tsan+da a nu bha wa la sogs pa: mu stegs shwa shwa ra yi bla shing skyes: nyin mo gdug pa'i na bun sngo dmar 'khrigs: mtshan mo me 'bar mi min 'byung po 'tshogs: skabs su 'gyu bas 'jig rten kun la 'tshe: mi rung bar gcod sna tshogs brtsams pa'i tshe: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ras: dam can the'u rang sde gsum las la bskul: gnam lcags dbal gyi dgra satwa kha che brdungs: mi gtsang khrag sna dgu yis ngar yang btab: bshan pa bdud kyi dmag tshogs pho nyar rbad: rigs ngan nag po shan pa gcer bu yis: gdug pa'i shing la satwa re phyogs bzhir brgyab: shar du yo bas mi sdug skad ngan sgrog: lho ru 'gyel bas 'o dod gnam du ldir: nub tu gshags pas rak+ta'i rlabs chen babs: byang du gzhogs pas ngan sngags rang sgra sgrog: dbus su bsgrigs shing rak+ta'i rtsi yang btab: lhag ma'i khrag de gling bzhir gtor ba las: mi sdug drag po'i shing sna dpag med gyur: drag po'i rtsang phur khrag 'thung phyag tu phul:

hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ras: mu stegs tha nag can gyi thod pa ru: drag rdzas dgu la dmar nag gtor ma bzos: rtse mor ru tra'i snying gi rgyal mtshan btsugs: mtha' rnams bshan pa phur bu rtsang gis bskor: las mkhan pho nya bzhugs par mnga' gsol nas: zlog sngags dmod pa reg chod btab pa'i tshe: mu stegs 'byung po'i dmag tshogs brgyal zhing reng : bsam chod bshan pa rtsang phur de nas byung : de ltar sngon gyi rtsang phur rtags mngon bzhin: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: rkyen ngan bar chad rtsang gis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rno dbal gdug pa drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: rtse mor dmar nag me ri wa la la: sked pa rgya mdud rlung dmar 'u ru ru: rtsa bar bskal pa'i mun nag thibs se thib: khro bo khro mo rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: ma rungs ban bon byad kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtse gnam lcags zur gsum gyen du gzengs: sked pa gru bzhi thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs: rtsa bar rak+ta'i rba rlabs chi li li: chos skyong dam can tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: chag che nyam nga rtsang gis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtse gti mug sprin nag kyi li li: sked par nga rgyal ser ba sha ra ra: rtsa bar gnam lcags thog rgod zi ra 'khyugs: las mkhan srog la rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: pha rol dmag dpung g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser shwa na ma mo sprin ltar gtibs: sked par re ti ma mo glog ltar 'khyugs: rtsa bar ya byin de byin rlung ltar 'tshubs: srog bdag ma mo 'tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: dmag 'khrugs lo nyes yams nad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser sgrol ging gri thogs zengs se zeng :

sked par srog bdud zhags pa na ra ra: rtsa bar btsan rgod bshan pa rengs se reng : pho nya las la 'tshogs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser srin byas ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : sked par 'dre byas gshog 'gyur lings se ling : rtsa bar bdud byas skad ngan congs se cong : dgra la than ltas 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: mi rung than ltas sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang rtser rnga mong khyung zhon nyi li li: sked par wa la sprel zhon zhums se zhum: rtsa bar 'dre mo bong zhon tshubs se tshub: dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: shar gyi rtsang phur a nu bha wa'i shing : dgra bgegs zhi ba'i rtsang phur 'tshub ma ris: ma rungs gdug pa zhi bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su bh+yo bzlog rbad bskul sngags kyis brgyan: mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: shar dang shar lho'i dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: lho yi rtsang phur ha ri dra la'i shing : mthu rtsal rgyas pa'i rtsang phur gar stabs 'gros: nus stobs gzi brjid rgyas par mnga' gsol nas: logs su khram bh+yo raṃ bh+yo sngags kyis brgyan: shwa khram char ltar 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: lho dang lho nub dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: nub kyi rtsang phur kha di ra yi shing : snang srid dbang sdud rtsang phur srin mo 'gros: las bskul byad ma tshar gcod mnga' gsol nas: logs su ma bh+yo dza thun sngags kyis brgyan: yams nad me ltar 'bar ba'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: nub dang nub byang dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog:

hūm̐: byang gi rtsang phur tsan+da dan+ḍa'i shing : dgra bgegs tshar gcod rtsang phur phur bu'i 'gros: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su e thun rbad bh+yo'i sngags kyis brgyan: spu gri dmar nag 'khor lo'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: byang dang byang shar dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: dbus kyi rtsang phur dz+wa la ka la'i shing : srung zlog rtsang phur mig mang drwa ba ris: dug lnga bdud bzhi bcom par mnga' gsol nas: logs su ya bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭ sngags kyis brgyan: drag sngags me dpung 'bar ba'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: steng 'og phyogs mtshams dgra dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: lcags ri'i rtsang phur dzī bī tshin+dha'i shing : dgra bgegs dpung 'joms rtsang phur dmag g.yos tshul: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog par mnga' gsol nas: logs su thun bh+yo raṃ bh+yo sngags kyis brgyan: gzer nad snying rlung drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: mtha' 'khob bdud rigs dmag dpung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: zor bzlog rtsang phur ya ma tsit+ta'i shing : brlag bcom bsregs gtor rtsang phur spu gri ris: gnag pa'i byad ma sgrol bar mnga' gsol nas: logs su nṛ tri mā ra'i sngags kyis brgyan: gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: drag po'i pho nya bshan pa rtsang gi dmag: rno dbal mtshon cha sna tshogs zengs se zeng : gnam lcags rdo rje'i go khrab si li li: rdzu 'phrul rlung rta 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: dgra bo'i snying gzir zor rdzas sha ra ra: dgra la cho 'phrul ltas ngan nyi li li: chos shig rtsang phur bshan pa dmag la chos: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dpung tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtsang phur drag pos dgra sha ljib ljib za:

rtsang phur dgra bo'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur dgra bo'i rus 'cha' krigs se krig: rtsang phur myur mgyogs gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur bshan pa las byed khyugs se khyug: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu sgrub dgra la zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hom sbar dgra la zlog: zor kha rlung kha thams cad dgra la zlog: gtad khram ngag mnan thams cad dgra la zlog: mi kha phung sbyor thams cad dgra la zlog: tshe zad za 'grangs thebs pa dgra la zlog: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna dgra la zlog: mi rung than ltas sna dgu dgra la zlog: rkyen kha glo bur langs pa dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: spar sme dbang thang nyams pa dgra la zlog: dur sgo gshed sgo ral pa dgra la zlog: gri kha mtshon kha langs pa dgra la zlog: bsod nams sa bcud nyams pa dgra la zlog: lo skag zla skag zhag skag dgra la zlog: nad skag 'chi bdag ngan pa dgra la zlog: tshes grangs gza' skar ngan pa dgra la zlog: ma rungs bkra mi shis pa dgra la zlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya: ma tri rak+sha ya ma sha trum a mu ka tsit+ta nan: ru tra mā ra dzi bī tshin+dha tshin+dha bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: man+t+ra du nan bh+yo zlog: yaṇ+ṭa du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ti du nan bh+yo zlog: ru tra du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya du nan bh+yo zlog: rbad tshal pa sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: myog ti rmug ti sa ma ya zlog: smi sha ku ru sa ma ya zlog: tsit+ta rbad 'gas sa ma ya zlog: badz+ra ya tri ya tri zlog: ni lam bha ra zlog: dri mi hā re zlog: ma rtsa du tri zlog: sha ri hā ri zlog: khrag ti ya ma zlog: tsit+ta thum ril zlog: nā ga kha ra zlog: ya ma gzer nan zlog:

rak+sha trig nan zlog: yak+sha taṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra e thum zlog: ra tsa du ru zlog: khaṃ maṃ baṃ shag zlog: dmod pa'i rig sngags thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo zlog: sarba a mu kā tad+ya thā mā ra ya: e hur thum rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces spu gri nyer bdun gyi sngags yang mang du bzlas te thal mo brdab kyang rung : sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: rtsang bzlog spu gri 'khor lo bzhag: dgra bo reg chod las kyi mtshon: byad ma rtsad brlag rig sngags te: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las 'grub shog: sha 'ug stag sgor i thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags nag ral pa can o rgyan gter bdag gling pas/ me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: mdos rgyan dar tshon sna lnga'i bzlog pa bzhugs so: khrag 'thung rol pa'i nyams 'gyur can: he ru ka pa'i gzi byin 'khyug: ma 'gag rol rtsal che ba'i mchog: dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal byed 'dud: sa ma ya: de nas bca' gzhi mdos kyi cha lag mdzes rgyan gyi spyi chings srid pa'i dar rab chen mo 'di la don gsum ste: dang po dar gyi 'byung khungs bshad pa: gnyis pa dar gyi spyan gzigs bstan pa: gsum pa dar gyis rkyen ngan bzlog pa ste don gsum las: thog mar dar mthing gtor ma'i rtser gdugs bskyon kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gyi rgyan spras: 'og tu me long dang 'phan rtse gsum pa gnyis kyis brgyan: shar du zhi dar dkar po'i gdugs la rdo rje'i tog dang gong bzhin no: lho ru dar ser po'i gdugs la rin po che'i tog: nub tu dar dmar po'i gdugs la pad+ma kha 'bus kyi tog: byang du dar ljang khu'i gdugs la ral gri'i tog: de thams cad la rang rang mthun pa'i me long 'phan dar lce bcas gzugs: bzlog pa'i mdun du rin chen brdar phye'i gser skyems kyis skabs su mchod:
dang po ye nas thugs dam bskul ba ni:

hūm̐: ma 'gag dbyings kyi pho brang nas: skye med rang byung shar ba'i lha: gnyis med zhi ba rdo rje dbyings: rab khros khro bo ma lus dang : sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs 'dus bcas: kun kyang chos sku'i rol rtsal phyir: mngon spyod phrin las bsgrub pa'i slad: rang bzhin dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: phrin las dgongs phyir gshegs su gsol: mdzes pa'i rdzas dang dgyes pa'i phud: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: spyan gzigs dar gyis thugs dam bskul: brtan dang g.yo bas khyab pa yis: rang bzhin bsdus pa'i phrin las bcol: deng 'dir srid pa'i 'byung ba rnams: dmod de las su bskul bar 'tshal: de nas gser skyems sbreng ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas mkha' dbyings lhun gyis grub: chags med chags bral dang po'i don: stong gsal sgyu 'phrul rtsal snang las: ye shes rol pa'i 'khor lo shar: snang srid khams lnga so sor grub: kha dog brjod du ma nges kyang : kha dog dar tshon sna lnga bzhin: srid pa dang po nas gzhal ba'i: grangs med rnams kyi 'du tshan las: gcig brten gnyis su chags pa'i tshul: de yi brda la brten pa yi: deng 'dir phrin las dus la bab: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: zhi gar khro bo rol pa'i tshogs: rang bzhin mngon spyod mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ gnyis med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: rgyas 'debs yum dang khro bo bcu: phur 'debs nyi shu la sogs te: pho nya ging bdud nyer bzhi rnams: dgyes pa'i rdzas dang bzlog pa'i las: sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul ba dang : mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs su gsol: hūm̐: dang po ci yang mi snang rung : gnyis snang phra mor 'dzin pa la: las dang ye shes dbang gyur nas: kha dog rnam par grub pa ltar: dpe yi las su brda mtshon las: snang srid thig le'i rol rtsal shar: ma 'gag de bzhin cir snang ba: yang dag sngon gyi dgongs pa las:

'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: gzhi ni ma skyes mdog mi 'gyur: de yi mtshon pa'i las byed phyir: dpal chen pho brang rtse mo ru: mthing nag dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: sngon tshe chos dbyings ngang gis lha: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mthing nag dar gyi gdugs phub pas: zhi ba'i lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: ka dag ye shes sgom pa la: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags bdud: nyon mongs 'khri bas bcings pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: dge bcu'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: rtse la dug gsum gcod pa'i mtshon: 'bar ba'i stobs bcu khro bo'i lha: dgyes pa khrag 'thung 'khor bcas kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rtse gsum mtshon cha gzengs pa yis: khrag 'thung lha tshogs mnyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: smon lam log pa'i 'dre bdud rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: kun slong bdag 'dzin zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: mthing nag dar gyi cod pan brgyan: dbus kyi lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: rang byung ye shes sgrub pa la: dug lnga'i mun pa gtibs pa rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: rang rig mngon gyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang shar gyi rtse mo ru: dkar po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: dngul gyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe me long ngang gis lha: shar phyogs zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'jigs brgyad zhi bar brtsam pa la: ma rig lha yi bdud rnams dang : nyon mongs zhe sdang las gyur pa: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: mi mthun bgegs tshogs zhi bar mdzod:

hūm̐: pho brang lho yi rtse mo ru: ser po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: gser gyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe mnyam nyid ngang gis lha: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rin chen mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: tshe bsod rgyas par brtsam pa la: bdag 'dzin phung po'i bdud rnams dang : nyon mongs nga rgyal las gyur pa: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: tshe bsod bar gcod zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang nub kyi rtse mo ru: dmar po dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: zangs kyi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe sor rtog ngang gis lha: nub phyogs dbang gi lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: pad+mas mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: dbang gi las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dbang sdud las kun brtsam pa la: bag chags nyon mongs bdud rnams dang : 'dod pa de la chags pa rnams: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: bdag 'dzin 'ching brgyad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang byang gi rtse mo ru: ljang gu dar gyi rgyal mtshan phyar: mthing gi me long cod pan brgyan: sngon tshe bya grub ngang gis lha: byang phyogs drag po'i lha tshogs kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: ral gris mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis: drag po'i las kun 'grub pa dang : deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dgra bgegs bsgral bar brtsam pa la: 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde tshogs dang : sdang sems phrag dog 'dzin pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir mdos rgyan 'di yis zlog: bstan dgra sgos dgra zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: rang byung kha dog lnga yi dar: dang po chos kyi dbyings su grub: nyon mongs zhi bar brtsam pa la: ye shes lnga yi kha dog shar: 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa yis: de la srid pa'i gos dar grub: tshangs pa lha yi rgyan spyod bzhin:

deng 'dir dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du: legs par bkra bas mdzes pa 'dis: dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: ma rungs bdud srin bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen khro bo'i pho brang gi: rtse mor kha ṭ+wāṃ brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs bar chod bzlog tu gsol: mthing nag dar gyi rgyal mtshan gyis: bar phyogs dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: ye shes gsal ba'i me long gis: 'og phyogs bgegs srin bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan rtse gsum 'chang ba yis: mtshams kyi byur 'dre bzlog tu gsol: a nu bha wa'i srog shing gis: ma rungs sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang shar phyogs kyi: rtse mor rdo rjes mtshan pa yis: dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs dkar pos brgyan pa yis: grul bum gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan dkar po rtse gsum gyis: lha yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dz+wa la ka yi srog shing gis: btsan gyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang lho phyogs kyi: rtse mor rin chen mtshan pa yis: me lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs ser pos brgyan pa yis: gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan ser po rtse gsum gyis: rgyal po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ha ri dra yi srog shing gis: srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang nub phyogs kyi: rtse mor pad+mas mtshan pa yis: klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs dmar pos brgyan pa yis: ma mo'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar 'phan dmar po rtse gsum gyis: rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: kha di ra yi srog shing gis: gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen pho brang byang phyogs kyi: rtse mor ral gris mtshan pa yis: gza' yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dar gdugs ljang gus brgyan pa yis: dbang ldan gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol:

dar 'phan ljang gu rtse gsum gyis: bdud kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: tsan+da dan+ḍa'i srog shing gis: bgegs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dkar po dngul gyi me long gis: shar phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ser po gser gyi me long gis: lho phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dmar po zangs kyi me long gis: nub phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: sngon po mthing gi me long gis: byang phyogs yongs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bzlog go bsgyur ro phrin las mdzod: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: bar nas bdud kyis 'bod pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: mtshams nas gri sri langs pa zlog: lo dgra gshed bzhi langs pa zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skag dang phung sri langs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: mi rung bkra mi shis pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog: god kha gyod byur ngan pa zlog: than ltas rmi lam ngan pa zlog: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du na e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces gser skyems yongs rdzogs lhag med gong gi mtshams nas 'bul bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma lnga ldan legs phreng mdzes pa dbang po'i tog: phrin las rnam bzhi'i gnyan 'di dpung gcig go: ji snyed thabs kyis bsdus pa'i shes rab zung : ji ltar gu ru'i gsung bzhin bslad med du: dbyangs can bdag gis brda bzhi rgyas gdab bo: ma rig mtsho skem me 'od gdong gis srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing :

lug lor bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: yang bzlog rdo rje'i thog mda' dgu skor bzhugs so: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung ngas: yang bzlog gnam lcags thog mda' bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: mthu chen de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: yang bzlog bya ba'i rim pa ni: gri lag la sogs g.yab pa'i rdzas: 'bru nag la sogs gtor ma'i thun: rol mo la sogs rngam pa'i brjid: dmod pa drag sngags las su shes: dpa' bo rdo rje ting 'dzin bskyed: dgra bo'i g.yul ngo bzlog par bsam: sa ma ya: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: yang dag che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: sku mdog mthing nag mi bzad rab tu 'bar: khros pa'i zhal gyis srid gsum sngangs shing 'dar: rno dbal mtshon chas gdon tshogs dum bur gtub: dur khrod chas brgyad rtsal chen lhun gyis grub: rdo rje'i sgro ldan log 'dren thul gyis gzhom: 'jigs byed gar gyis snang srid g.yo zhing 'gul: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso mo pang du 'khyud: yab yum sku la ye shes me ri 'bar: ba spu'i gseb nas khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: 'jigs pa'i gad mo hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: drag sngags rbad bskul rdzu 'phrul glog ltar 'khyug: ye shes 'jig rten khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nya las la 'gyed: bzlog pa'i mtshon cha ngan sngags sha ra ra: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dgra bgegs bsgral zhing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: 4 hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : gsang chen khro bo rol pa ru: ye shes 'jig rten 'khrugs pa'i tshe: dpal chen yang dag he ru kas: gsang sngags 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rig sngags 'dus pa'i gtor chen bshams:

gzungs sngags 'dus pa'i zor chen bsgril: ye shes pho nya rtsang gis brgyan: ngan sngags dmod pa'i zor 'phang tshe: 'jig rten lha rnams srog snying blangs: ma rungs dregs pa rdul du brlags: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ras: byin rlabs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: nus mthu 'dus pa'i gtor chen bshams: man ngag stobs kyis zor chen bsgril: rdzu 'phrul thogs med rtsang gis brgyan: reg chod rtsal gyis zor 'phang tshe: lha min g.yul dang dpung tshogs bcom: 'byung po'i gdon tshogs phye mar brlags: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub tu: chos rgyal mu stegs 'thab pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje yis: bskyed rim dri med dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rdzogs rim gnyug ma'i gtor chen bshams: gnyis med gcig 'dus zor chen bsgril: rol rtsal zang thal rtsang gis brgyan: rdo rje thog 'bebs zor kyang 'phangs: mu stegs dmag tshogs khrag bskyugs gum: zhang zhung phyi pa'i bstan pa nub: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang du: phyi nang bden gnyis rtsod pa'i tshe: slob dpon seṅge sgra sgrogs kyis: snying rje khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: thogs med mthu yi gtor chen bshams: dmod pa reg chod zor chen bsgril: las stobs rlung gi rtsang phur brgyan: 'byung lnga go ldog zor 'phang tshe: gnam lcags thog lhungs mu stegs brlags: nam yang mi ldang rgya yis btab: sngon tshe myur mgyogs rbad pa'i lha: deng 'dir dgra bgegs bzlog par mdzod: hūm̐:

de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: yang phur 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bden gnyis rdzas kyi gtor chen bshams: sna tshogs dug gi zor chen bsgril: drag po las mkhan rtsang gis brgyan: deng 'dir log 'dren bgegs la 'phen: rbad pa'i lha srung las la chos: dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs kyis: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: dmag dpung bskyed la zor sna drongs: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: 6 hūm̐ dzaḥ pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'khor tshogs pho nya'i rbod gtong yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu gtad yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hom sbar yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: rgya gar rgya nag bsgyur gto rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yi byad zor yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi gnod pa yang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha rtsub pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: byad kha phur kha bskrad gzir rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: na sri 'chi sri dur sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: god sri phung sri gyod sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: gleng gzhi'i mi kha gtam ngan rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: tshe nyams dbang thang rgud pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog:

dgra sgo gyod sgo bye ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: gri sri mtshon sri langs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: ma nyes las kyi kha yog rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: lo bcud 'bras bu nyams pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: 'gong po'i za kha rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: god 'dre dbul sri bse rag rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: chung sri rmug 'dre lan chags rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: sgab 'dre rgyal 'gong 'byung po rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi min 'byung po'i cho 'phrul rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: rmi ltas pra rtags ngan pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: na tsha 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi min 'byung po'i cho 'phrul rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: pho nyas bla tshe rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: than dang ltas ngan thams cad kyang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: bar chod glo bur ye 'drog rnams: dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: mi rung mi 'dod thams cad kyang : dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ro mā ra ya: ru tra nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thuṃ bh+yoḥ ru tra ya ma tsit+ta srog la rbad: ru tra mā ra bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭḥ ru tra gzer thuṃ bigh+nān trig nan zlog: ru tra kha thaṃ myog nan tri tri zlog: ru tra hur thuṃ sham lang pur thuṃ zlog: ru tra thun dza dzī bi rbad nan zlog: ru tra shag 'gas hu lu khroṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra kā wāka tsit+ta myag thuṃ zlog: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog mā ra ya rbad nan nan:

zhes zlog sngags lan dgu las ma nyung bar bzlas shing thal mo brdab: sa ma ya: yang bzlog dug gi 'khor lo cha dgu ni: dgra dpung cham la 'bebs pa'i zor po che: gang la btab kyang thogs med gnam lcags thun: dam nyams log 'dren bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo'i brag nas gdan drangs shing*/ glang lor sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bla med yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag las: bzlog pa dug mda' reg chod nag po bzhugs so: ྀatsha rgya: yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra drag sngags thod phreng gis: bzlog pa dug mda' reg chod bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: mthu chen de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: bzlog pa bya ba'i rim pa ni: dmag bskul las bcol rol mo bsgrag: bskyed pa'i lha dang srung ma rnams: go gyon mtshon thogs dgra la chas: bzlog pa'i sngags sgra bsgrags par bsam: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma bsham: skabs su 'gugs shing yang yang bsgral: rim par bzlog pa'i nang du 'bul: dang po las kyi rim pa ni: 3 hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen yang dag che mchog he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed stobs ldan badz+ra kī la ya: zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bka' sdod dam can chos skyong ma lus kun: dbang drag rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpung bskyed cing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: dang po hom bskyed pa ni: 2 hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: las mkhan pho nyas bzung ste mi shor bar: mnan cing bsdams nas myos pa'i rang bzhin gyur: gnyis pa 'gugs bstim ni:

phaṭḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: dpal chen che mchog lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: byad ma dgra bgegs log 'dren gnod byed rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gsum pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: rno dbal 'debs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sgrol cing gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dzi bī nṛ tri mā ra tshin+dha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces dgra bgegs rnams tshal par gtub: bsgral las 'di las mtshams su skabs su sbyar: 5 hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam pa'i gtum zhal bgrad: zhe gnyis phyag gis zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: dbyings kyi yum chen kro ti shwa rī 'khyud: rab tu 'bar ba'i me dpung dbus su 'gyings: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang yab yum rigs lnga'i tshogs: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i dar dang cod pan 'dzin: 'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: kun tu bzang po chos dbyings ye shes sku: ma rig 'khrul pa'i gti mug bzlog tu gsol: dbyings phyug bzang mo dus gsum skyed pa'i yum: nga bdag gces 'dzin ru tra bzlog tu gsol: rdor sems yab yum zhe sdang bag chags zlog: rin 'byung yab yum nga rgyal shes bya zlog: snang mtha' yab yum 'dod chags srid pa zlog: don grub yab yum phrag dog khong khro zlog: hūm̐: zhi ba yab yum rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis: dug lnga bsgral ba'i khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: ngan 'gror ltung ba'i skye sgo bzlog tu gsol:

hūm̐: sa snying la sogs sems dpa' yab yum brgyad: zhi ba'i tshul dgu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: byang chub sems dpa' sa snying po yab yum gyis: ma dag skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' byams pa yab yum gyis: sdug bsngal nad kyis mnar ba bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' kun bzang yab yum gyis: sdug bsngal tshe ring rgan pa bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sem dpa' nam snying yab yum gyis: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal yab yum gyis: ma dag mngal du skye ba bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' spyan gzigs yab yum gyis: sgo ngar skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' sgrib sel yab yum gyis: drod gsher skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: byang chub sems dpa' phyag rdor yab yum gyis: mi min 'byung por skye ba'i sdug bsngal zlog: hūm̐: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad brgyad: nyon mongs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: ma dag srid par 'khyams pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: brgya byin la sogs sbyong byed thub pa drug: bslab gsum rnam dag byang sems chas kyis brgyan: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa brgya byin chen po yis: lha ru skye ba'i 'pho ltung sdug bsngal zlog: bcom ldan thub pa thag bzang chen po yis: lha min skye ba'i 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zlog: bcom ldan thub pa shākya seṅge yis: mi ru skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa seṅge rab brtan gyis:

dud 'gror skye ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa kha 'bar sgrom bu yis: yi dwags skye ba'i bkres skom bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan thub pa chos kyi rgyal po yis: dmyal bar skye ba'i btso bsreg sdug bsngal zlog: hūm̐: sdug bsngal skyob pa'i bcom ldan thub pa drug: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: gnas ngan len pa'i skye sgo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rnam par smin sogs rig 'dzin chen po lnga: sgeg bzhad dgyes la mdzes pa'i cha lugs ldan: dag pa rang byung gnas nas skur bzhengs la: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: lha bu bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: phung po bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: nyon mongs bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: 'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bar chad bzlog pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum gyis: bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs rigs lnga'i tshogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem yid 'ong lang tsho ldan: mkha' spyod klong nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: chos dbyings sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: me long rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: srog lus dbang thang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: mnyam nyid rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams pa bzlog tu gsol:

sor rtog pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: tshe chos snyan grags nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: bya grub las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: ma sring mkha' 'gro rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis: mkha' dbyings rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi mthun sna tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: badz+ra he ru ka sogs khro bo bzhi: bzhad gshe rngam pa'i dpal gyi chas brgyad brgyan: dur khrod klong yangs 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan rat+na khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: mu stegs zhang zhung byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan pad+ma khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: sde brgyad pho nya'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bcom ldan karma khrag 'thung yab yum gyis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po rigs bzhi 'khor bcas kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: kau rī ma sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: sna tshogs rgyan ldan sgeg pa'i gar stabs can: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: kau rī ma mo tsau ri ma mo yis: dri za grul bum gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: pra mo ha dang bai ta nag mo yis: gshin rje me lha'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: puk+ka sī dang ghasma ljang nag gis: srin po klu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang sme sha mthing nag gis: rlung lha bgegs kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: añdza rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnon pa bzlog tu gsol:

hūm̐: siṃ ha la sogs phra men brgyad rnams kyis: rngam pa'i skur ston dur khrod bdag mo'i tshul: rab tu rgyu ba me dpung klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: siṃ ha smug nag byā gṛ dmar mo yis: gza' dang the'u rang gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: sri la nag mo shwa na mthing nag gis: lha dang lha min gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: kri ta dkar ser kaṅka dmar nag gis: rgyal po gshin rje'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: khā kha nag mo hu lu mthing skya yis: btsan dang klu yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: du na rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sgo skyong khro bo khro mo chen po'i tshogs: rngam gshe gtum dang 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: phyogs bzhi rang rang gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed po yab yum gyis: ma mo gnod sbyin gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gyis: bdud dang srin po'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: stag gdong dkar mo phag gdong ser mo yis: gnam thel bar thel sa thel bzlog tu gsol: seng gdong dmar mo sbrul gdong ljang gu yis: gson 'dre pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: khu byug dkar mo ra gdong ser mo yis: 'byung po mi min gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: seng gdong dmar mo sbrul gdong ljang gu yis: sman mo sha za'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sgo skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa yis: pad+ma rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nad gdon bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs skyong 'dul byed srid pa chen po'i bdag: rab khros 'jigs pa'i chas kyis dpa' bar brgyan:

steng 'og phyogs bcu'i gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dri za 'dul byed me lha 'dul byed kyis: shar dang shar lho'i dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje 'dul byed srin po 'dul byed kyis: lho dang lho nub dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: klu rnams 'dul byed rlung lha 'dul byed kyis: nub dang nub byang dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: gnod sbyin 'dul byed dbang ldan 'dul byed kyis: byang dang byang shar dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: lha rnams 'dul byed sa bdag 'dul byed kyis: steng dang 'og gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: phyogs skyong 'dul byed chen po 'khor bcas kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: gnod byed dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ce spyang chen mo ma mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mi bzad gar bsgyur rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: myur mgyogs rtsal shugs klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: ce spyang seng gdong ce spyang stag gdong gis: lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang gzig mgo ce spyang dom mgo yis: klu dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang spyang mgo ce spyang kang mgo yis: btsan dang rgyal po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang dur bya ce spyang dred mgo yis: bdud dang ma mo 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: ce spyang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams kyis: gza' dang gnod sbyin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs zlog: hūm̐: ce spyang chen mo ma mo 'khor bcas kyis: byad ma bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi kha rlangs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra: sku mdog mthing nag rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo:

dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog 'od kyis 'gengs: dur khrod chas brgyad snang srid zil gyis gnon: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum byad ma ru tra brdzis: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: sku las skyes pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: khro bo rol pa'i gnas nas skur bzhengs shig: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khrag 'thung chen po rigs bzhi he ru kaḥ dpal gyi chas ldan hūm̐ dang phaṭ sgra sgrogs: dur khrod lhun grub bde chen gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: shar gyi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: pho rgyud khro bo'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: lho yi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: nub kyi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: yi dam yongs kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: byang gi khrag 'thung kī la yab yum gyis: chos skyong dam can dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rigs bzhi khro bo khro mo 'khor bcas kyis: dam nyams bsgral ba'i klad khrag 'di bzhes la: snang srid yongs kyi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen khro bcu 'bar ba lha yi tshogs: dur khrod chas ldan sha khrag snying la dgyes: rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal rang rang gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: khro bo chen po hūm̐ kar yab yum gyis: rgya gar yi ge'i dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen rnam par rgyal ba yab yum gyis: rgya nag bsgyur gto byed pa dgra la zlog: khro chen dbyug pa sngon po yab yum gyis: zhang zhung ju thig dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen gshin rje gshed po yab yum gyis: me nyag tsa dur 'bod pa dgra la zlog:

khro chen mi g.yo mgon po yab yum gyis: sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: khro chen rta mgrin rgyal po yab yum gyis: stag gzig zor mda' zug pa dgra la zlog: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gyis: snang srid dal kha dmod pa dgra la zlog: khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po yab yum gyis: li yi spar sme gdan bgos dgra la zlog: khro chen khams gsum rgyal ba yab yum gyis: ban bon sngags pa'i zor mda' dgra la zlog: khro bo chen po stobs chen yab yum gyis: skyes pa'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor zlog: hūm̐: ye shes khro bcu 'khor dang bcas pa yis: log 'dren bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: snang srid yongs kyi byad zor bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: phra men chen mo khra thabs phur 'debs tshogs: za byed gsod byed rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'byung ba 'khrug pa yul lha'i ltas: phur 'debs phag mgo can gyis zlog: gnam la sprin dmar lo nyes ltas: phur 'debs rmigs bu mgo yis zlog: sa gzhi g.yo 'gul dus 'khrugs ltas: phur 'debs stag mgo can gyis zlog: bya dkar sder 'dzing ye 'drog ltas: phur 'debs bya rgod mgo yis zlog: glag nag sder 'dzing ya bdud ltas: phur 'debs g.yag mgos bzlog tu gsol: dur byas bshugs glu dur sri'i ltas: phur 'debs bya rog mgo yis zlog: sreg pa khyim zhugs 'dre srin ltas: phur 'debs shwa ba mgo yis zlog: chu glang rkan sgra ma bdud ltas: phur 'debs 'ug pa mgo yis zlog: 'ug pa nyin dgod srin po'i ltas: phur 'debs gzig mgo can gyis zlog: lcung khra khyim zhugs gnyan gyi ltas: phur 'debs khwa ta mgo yis zlog: bya rog sha 'thab god kha'i ltas: phur 'debs byi la mgo yis zlog:

shwa pho ru 'dzing gnam lha'i ltas: phur 'debs pu shud mgo yis zlog: khang par bya than khyim phung ltas: phur 'debs spyang ki mgo yis zlog: brag dmar gla ro brag srin ltas: phur 'debs chen mo khra mgos zlog: spang dkar dgo ro gangs btsan ltas: phur 'debs seṅge mgo yis zlog: kha sha 'thab rgyug btsan rgod ltas: phur 'debs pha waṃ mgo yis zlog: gtsod pho ru 'dzing 'brog srin ltas: phur 'debs dom mgo can gyis zlog: srod la wa brgyal mo 'dre'i ltas: phur 'debs sre mong mgo yis zlog: sre mong byi ro chung sri'i ltas: phur 'debs chen mo dred mgos zlog: khu ling khyim zhugs shi chad ltas: phur 'debs byi la mgo yis zlog: hūm̐: phur 'debs chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa yis: ltas ngan bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: mi rung sna tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad tshogs: mi bzad gtum zhing gdug pa'i gar stabs bsgyur: rtsub 'gyur me ri 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nya mo rnga 'dzing klu bdud ltas: srin mo g.yag gdong ma yis zlog: sbal pa sder 'dzing sa bdag ltas: tshangs pa sbrul gdong ma yis zlog: sbal sbrul 'thab pa gnyan gyi ltas: lha chen gzig gdong ma yis zlog: sbrul gyi byi za klu srin ltas: rtog 'dod sre mong gdong gis zlog: bal khur byi tshang ma bdud ltas: gzhon nu dred gdong ma yis zlog: stag dong sbrang tshang pho lha'i ltas: brgya byin dom mgo ma yis zlog: srod la bya 'tsher shi bla'i ltas: rdo rje pha waṃ gdong gis zlog: tho rangs khyi ngu grong rgyun ltas: zhi ba chu srin gdong gis zlog: khang pa tshag sgra dpe dkar ltas: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ma yis zlog: sgo them khyis slog the'u rang ltas: zla ba khra gdong ma yis zlog:

gong shing chag pa na tsha'i ltas: be con wa gdong ma yis zlog: chon thag rgyug pa btsan shwa'i ltas: srin mo stag gdong ma yis zlog: khyim nang 'od 'khyil brgya byin ltas: za ba rgod mgo ma yis zlog: sprel gyis gla zhon dge bsnyen ltas: dga' ba rta gdong ma yis zlog: rta drel rngog 'cha' mtshon 'khrugs ltas: stobs chen khyung gdong ma yis zlog: gnam rdo lhung ba dmu yi ltas: srin mo khyi gdong ma yis zlog: 'o bshigs mar med sman mo'i ltas: 'dod pa pu shud gdong gis zlog: 'o ma khrag babs gshin rje'i ltas: nor srung shwa mgo ma yis zlog: yos 'thag ram phye sde brgyad ltas: rlung lha spyang gdong ma yis zlog: 'od khyim 'khyil ba byad kha'i ltas: mi mo skyin mgo ma yis zlog: me 'bud ran 'khor mgar nag ltas: phag mo phag gdong ma yis zlog: sbra la gzugs brnyan god kha'i ltas: dga' byed glang chen gdong gis zlog: rtsigs par bung tshang sgo stong ltas: ba glang gdong gis bzlog tu gsol: gzugs med ku sgra yul 'dre'i ltas: chu lha sbrul gdong ljang gus zlog: hūm̐: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor bcas kyis: ma rungs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan brgyad cu bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐/ dpal chen pho brang sgo skyong las byed bzhi/ /rang rtags phyag rgya rngam pa'i skur ston ma/ /las bzhi lhun grub gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐/ shar sgo skyong byed pu shud mgo can gyis/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /lho sgo skyong byed skya ga'i mgo can gyis/ /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /nub sgo skyong byed srin bya'i mgo can gyis/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog /byang sgo skyong byed khra yi mgo can gyis/

/drag po'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog hūm̐/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgo ma rigs bzhi yis/ /sgab 'dre bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la/ /skal med the tshom log lta bdud rigs zlog/ // hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan ma mo bcu gnyis tshogs: za gsod dbugs la rngam zhing nga ro sgrogs: shin tu 'jigs pa'i dug rlangs dbus nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes shig: deng 'dir zlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thog ser 'bebs rmis byad kha'i ltas: shwa na mthing nag ma mos zlog: ri nyil rmis pa yul lha'i ltas: shwa na dmar nag ma mos zlog: btson la 'jug rmis mthu yi ltas: shwa na ser nag ma mos zlog: bud med ngu rmis ma mo'i ltas: shwa na sngo nag ma mos zlog: nag mo ded rmis srin mo'i ltas: mthing nag re ma ti yis zlog: drel zhon rmis pa lha mo'i ltas: ser nag re ma dza yis zlog: bong zhon rmis pa ma mo'i ltas: dmar nag re ma dzu yis zlog: lha khang mang rmis ber nag ltas: ljang nag re ma bh+yo yis zlog: gcer bu byis pa the'u rang ltas: ma mo ya byin ma yis zlog: mun nag 'thib rmis grib kyi ltas: ma mo de byin ma yis zlog: mya ngan mang rmis na ba'i ltas: ma mo bswe byin ma yis zlog: thur du 'gro rmis ngan 'gro'i ltas: ma mo phag byin ma yis zlog: hūm̐: bka' skyong ma mo bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: ma rungs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: rmis ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan ging chen bcu gnyis tshogs: sha khrag srog la rngam zhing stong khams nyul: me rlung khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dud 'gro mgo gsum klu bdud ltas: ging chen dkar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro zo lag ma mo'i ltas: ging chen ser pos bzlog tu gsol:
