dud 'gro rgyu bshal btsan 'gong ltas: ging chen dmar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro rkang brgyad gnod sbyin ltas: ging chen nag pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro kha bzhi brag btsan ltas: shar bdud dkar pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mig dgu gza' yi ltas: lho bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro lto sbyor gshin rje'i ltas: nub bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro 'phrag ral byad kha'i ltas: byang bdud chen pos bzlog tu gsol: bya mchu ltag kha gnod sbyin than: shar btsan bshan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro sgal 'byar phung bdud than: lho btsan shan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mig med dmu yi than: nub btsan bshan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro mche can srin po'i than: byang btsan shan pas bzlog tu gsol: dud 'gro chad lhag mi sdug than: yang 'khor sprul pas bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sde dpon bshan pa myur mgyogs bcu gnyis tshogs: than ltas bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la: than dang ltas ngan sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: 7 hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnam nas thog rgod lhung ba zlog: sa nas dug gzer langs pa zlog: bar nas dgra sdang 'gyu ba zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa zlog: mtshams nas byur 'dre langs pa zlog: mi kha phung sbyor ngan pa zlog: phug gi lha la gnod pa zlog: bar gyi mi la gnod pa zlog: sgo yi nor la gnod pa zlog: mchan gyi bu la gnod pa zlog: gtan gyi grogs la gnod pa zlog: yul mkhar zhing la gnod pa zlog: srid dang g.yang la gnod pa zlog: mi 'dod rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha ngan pa zlog: sme ba klung rta nyams pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur:

bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog phrin las mdzod: oṃ e ka du nan zlog: ya ma du nan zlog: ra tsa du nan zlog: yak+sha rbad nan zlog: ma tri bh+yo nan zlog: du ru du nan ya zlog: ha la tsakra ya zlog: rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yo ya zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: bzlog bzlog:

ces zlog sngags lan gsum mam bdun bklag go: khyad par byad stems than dang ltas ngan la sogs gang byung la dmigs gtad bcas te bzlog: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: dug mda' 'khor lo nag po bzhag: ma 'ongs nyi shu'i yang mtha' la: bar chad bzlog pa'i gnyen por shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs te/ glang lor sbas yul gnas mchog gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas dag par bod yig tu phab pa 'dis mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i mtshon char gyur cig/ // ༈ dang po hoṃ bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: las mkhan pho nyas bzung ste mi shor bar: mnan cing bsdams nas myos pa'i rang bzhin gyur: gnyis pa 'gugs bstim ni: phaṭḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: dpal chen che mchog lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: byad ma dgra bgegs log 'dren gnod byed rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: oṃ ru tra nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gsum pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: rno dbal 'debs pa'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sgrol cing gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma dzi bī nṛ tri mā ra tshin+dha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces dgra bgegs rnams tshal par gtub: bsgral las 'di las mtshams su skabs su sbyar: rgyas pa phur so gar 'dug 'di bzhin bsgral nas mchod: liṅga lha grangs bcas nas bsgral mchod bya// bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: g.yul bzlog dregs dpung gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: g.yul bzlog dregs dpung gnam lcags thog mda' yi: mtha' bskor dmod pa drag po'i zor rdzas ni:

'phang ba'i kong zor tshe yungs dmar nag rtsang : dug khrag rbab rdo dang ni tsit+ta'i zor: skyer phur thod zor dug mda' gshin rje'i khram: mda' mdung ral gri lcags sgrog tho ba sogs: ke tshe shang tshe kong bu kha khyer la: byad thag sna lngas dkris la zur du bsham: dug khrag sbreng zhing rtsa sngags bklag: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ spu gri'i drag sngags so bdun dang : oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sarba bigh+nān sogs rtsa sngags sham bu bcas: de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha kī la ya: mā ra ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bh+yoḥ drag po khros pa'i ngang las bzhengs pa'i mtshon: srid pa las kyi zor rdzas zor thun la: mtshon 'khrugs yams nad 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can: bsam gcod reg gcod gdeng gcod dregs pa'i mtshon: gang la btab kyang thogs med sgrub rdzas 'di: rig 'dzin grub thob bla ma rgya mtsho dang : yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs bcas: chos skyong dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sde dpon gyis: zor rdzas gdug pa'i mtshon char byin gyis rlobs: drag rtsal thogs med rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: do nub drag po'i zor rdzas bsgral chas 'di: gang la phog kyang myur du sgrol mdzad pa'i: dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri 'byung gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya: ma tri rak+sha ya ma sha trum a mu ka tsit+ta nan: ru tra mā ra dzi bī tshin+dha tshin+dha bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: man+t+ra du nan bh+yo zlog: yaṇ+ṭa du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ti du nan bh+yo zlog: ru tra du nan bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya du nan bh+yo zlog: rbad tshal pa sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: myog ti rmug ti sa ma ya zlog: smi sha ku ru sa ma ya zlog: tsi tri ru tri sa ma ya zlog: tsit+ta rbad 'gas sa ma ya zlog: badz+ra ya tri ya tri zlog: ni lam bha ra zlog: dri mi hā re zlog: ma rtsa du tri zlog: sha ri hā ri zlog:

khrag ti ya ma zlog: tsit+ta thum ril zlog: nā ga kha ra zlog: ya ma gzer nan zlog: rak+sha trig nan zlog: yak+sha taṃ bh+yo zlog: ru tra e thum zlog: ra tsa du ru zlog: khaṃ maṃ baṃ shag zlog: dmod pa'i rig sngags thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo zlog: sarba a mu kā tad+ya thā mā ra ya: e hur thum rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing rab byung bcu gnyis pa sa glang lor o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mnyam pa'i 'dzam gling snyan grags sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling der shog ser nas dag par phab pa'o// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: zhi drag bskul pa bzhugs so: bzlog rdzongs nyin par bzlog pa tshar nas: zhi drag bskul pa gtong ba ni: hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi mtha': ma rungs gdug pa'i 'dre rgod kha dar nas: gsang sngags bstan la bdud kyi 'tshe lags pas: khro rgyal chen pos mngon spyod mi mdzad na: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin yi chad mi 'gyur ram: gsang sngags gnyan la 'bras bu cang med dam: yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas ma dgyes sam: phyag rgya sngags kyi nus pa nyams lags sam: rig 'dzin gong mas thugs kyis mi khrel lam: de bas dpal chen lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: log 'dren bar chad rtsom pa'i 'byung po la: dpal chen mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar phob: bsgral zhing bzhes nas ming shul med par mdzod: hūm̐: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ sems dpa' sems ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ thub drug sgo bzhi'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ

rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ yang dag dpal chen lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ye shes khro bcu'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ kau sing ma mo'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug sgo ma'i lha tshogs las la bh+yoḥ ce spyang la sogs srung ma las la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bzlog drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi las la bh+yoḥ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa'i phra men khra thabs las la bh+yoḥ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad las la bh+yoḥ sgo skyong ma mo rigs bzhi las la bh+yoḥ pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis las la bh+yoḥ ging chen bdud po sde brgyad las la bh+yoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra pra bha swa ra ma hā karma tso dā na kī la rak+sha lak+ṣa sri ka nā na a mu ka ru tra mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gser skyems gling bzhi'i dmag bskul bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: gser skyems gtong ba'i rim pa ni: shin tu gtsang ba'i gzhi steng du: sngon mo nas 'bras tshom bu bkod: de dbus rin chen snod mchog dang : dza gad gser skyems legs par bsham: rmad byung zan gyi ril bu bsgril: gtsang ma'i phud phor nang du spung : dkar gtor bsngo zhing gser skyems bya: rngam pa'i rol mo dbyangs bcas nas: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: nga ni yang dag dpal chen he ru kaḥ nga ni khro rgyal badz+ra ku mā ra: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung : nga ni 'jam dpal rdo rje grub pa rtsal: nga ni drag po gnam lcags thog rgod rtsal: nga yi bka' la snang srid kun gyis nyon: don gnyis dkon mchog bka' la legs par soms:

ye shes dbyings kyis mi khyab gang yang med: rnam shes rlung gis mi zin gang yang med: sgra gcan zom du mi gnas gang yang med: rang bzhin 'byung lngas ma bsdus gang yang med: tshogs drug 'dod yon mi zhen gang yang med: chos sku'i zil gyis mi non gang yang med: thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi zin gang yang med: ka dag snying pos mi gsal gang yang med: 'khor 'das sangs rgyas mi dmigs gang yang med: rnam rtog chos skur ma skyes gang yang med: lha 'dre sems su ma grub gang yang med: bsdu bya stong par ma gyur gang yang med: bzang ngan rgyu 'bras ma gtogs gang yang med: cho 'phrul bden par gnas pa gang yang med: sde brgyad mtshan mar grub pa gang yang med: steng 'og phyogs bcu ris su phyes pa med: ye shes 'jig rten gnas la nges pa med: kun rdzob thugs rje'i las la mtha' dbus med: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i mkha' la yangs dog med: zhi khro'i lha tshogs don la skye 'chi med: yang dag che mchog bka' la 'gyur ldog med: dmod pa'i las kyi zor 'di phyir mi ldog: de bas ye shes 'jig rten tshogs rnams kun: chos nyid rgyu 'bras bden pa'i tshig la nyon: deng nas tha mal zhen pa bcom pa'i phyir: rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i zor chen 'di: phyogs med phyogs bcur bar mtshams dgra la 'phen: gzugs med lha 'dre kun la 'phog srid pas: rtog med dbu chum 'dzin med zhabs skums shig: mdun du yod pa g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzur: gal te zor 'phros sku la reg srid na: bdag ni ma nyes dam nyams dgra bo nyes: dgra bgegs ma sdang bdag gis zor 'phen ci: de bas ngan lan dam nyams dgra la phob: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir myur mgyogs zor sna dgra la drongs: mthu ldan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: thogs med drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐: steng phyogs mkha' spyod 'og phyogs sa spyod la: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dpal chen dbyings kyi lha tshogs ma lus kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs dang ni shar lho'i mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: dri za me lha la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho phyogs dang ni lho nub mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: gshin rje srin po la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub phyogs dang ni nub byang mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: klu dbang rlung lha la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs dang ni byang shar mtshams dag la: gnas pa'i lha srin gzhi bdag mthu bo che: gnod sbyin dbang ldan la sogs phyogs skyong rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir skur bzhengs zor sna dgra la drongs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lo zla zhag dus chu tshod la: gnas pa'i gza' skar 'gyu ba dang : sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus pa: gdong la gnas pa'i dregs can rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: g.yas g.yon phyogs su sku bzur 'tshal: bdag ni ma lan snyan gsan tshig: gal te lan par byung gyur na:

la yog dam nyams dgra la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems phyogs bcur gtong : de nas sgo dbye ba ni: phyogs kyi sgo chas thogs la gser skyems mchod cing : hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang shar phyogs gling : bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod sa gzhi khrag mtsho 'khyil: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: srin mo zangs mche pu shud mgo: lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dngul sgo dkar po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang lho phyogs gling : srin po'i thod pa brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod mun pa sprin ltar gtibs: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: gshin rje ma mo skya ga'i mgo: zhags pas mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang nub phyogs gling : ru tra'i bhan+dha brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod me ri smug nag 'khrigs: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: bshan pa ma mo srin bya'i mgo: lcags sgrog mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phyes: drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: dpal chen pho brang byang phyogs gling : 'byung po'i bhan+dha brtsegs pa'i mkhar: dur khrod rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil: de nang pho brang sgo skyong ma: las kyi ma mo khra yi mgo: dril bus mtshan pa'i lde'u mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs lcags sgo nag po phyes:

drag po'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba lha yi tshogs: ye shes 'jig rten ma lus kun: mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: dmag dpung bskyed phyir nam mkhar bzhugs: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: zor dpung dgra la drang du gsol: oṃ sarba swa bha e kham ga gā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes gser skyems gtor zhing sgo dbye 'tshal: bzlog bskul byed cing mdos gzhi dpag: gang gi phyogs su zhal bstan nas: slar yang byin brlabs yang bzlog bya: gzhung gi lag len spyi dang mtshungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing rab byung bcu gnyis pa sa glang lor o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mnyam pa'i 'dzam gling snyan grags sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling der shog ser nas dag par phab pa'o// // ༈ bla med yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag las: btsan rgod kyi zor chen spu gri ngar ma bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: ma 'ongs bdud rigs bsgral ba'i phyir: las zor spu gri ngar ma bstan: 'di nyid dgos ched rnam pa gsum: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa dang : rnal 'byor khyad du gsod pa dang : chos skyong mthu med zer rnams la: zor mda' 'di nyid 'debs par bya: gal che gnad 'gag ma thug par: 'di nyid shin tu bka' gnyan zhing : 'phang na 'dzam gling phung nyes che: de phyir gsang rgya dam po gyis: thun mong las mtha' ma yin pas: dpe dang gdams pa mi bstan no: de nas kha th-iṃ atsha rgya:

dang po bca' gzhi bstan pa ni: thod ngan nam ni lcags snod du: chos 'byung bang rim sum brtsegs bya: de steng ru tra bsgral ba'i snying : zor dgu dbal dang bcas pa bkod: gzhi ni dmar nag 'bar ba la: lnga ldan tshon gyi khra yang gdab: nang du spu gri 'khor lo bzhag: rtse la mtshon cha 'khor lo btsugs: rtsang dmar brgya dang brgyad kyis brgyan: gdug pa'i zor rdzas dgu yis bskor: drag bstim byin gyis yang yang brlab: rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur bsgom: btsan dmag las la 'gyed par bsam: sa ma ya: dang po zor rdzas byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i tsit+ta dmar po 'di: gnam lcags khro chu khol ma'i snying gi sgrom: phyi nang mtshon cha spu gri las grub pa'i: gang la btab kyang reg chod 'khor lo gzugs: skam thun rnams ni bsam chod reg chod dang : rlon thun rnams ni khrag nad rgyu gzer 'thibs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs gyur: oṃ ya ma du tri khaḍ+ga bhi shwa ha la ha la ru tra trig nan mā ra mā ra raṃ bh+yoḥ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gam bdun nam gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: dmigs pa la sogs gzhung du gsal: de nas gtor 'bul gcig la dgra bo lan gsum 'gugs: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: zangs brag dmar po 'od ldan pa: zangs ri dmar po 'jigs la rngam: khrag mtsho khol ma lbu ba 'khrigs: de dbus pho brang zangs mkhar dbus: srog bdag btsan gyi sde dpon bzhugs: yang 'khor btsan rgod bye bas bskor: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: gnas mchog dam pa gar bzhugs kyang : skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ shu la tsa tri badz+ra sa ma ya sarba dharma pā la dza dzaḥ hūm̐: btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor bcas la: dam nyams bsgral ba'i tsit+ta dang : sha sna khrag sna'i gtor ma 'bul: bzhes shig dgra bgegs bsgral bar mdzod: oṃ ma hā shu la tsa tri sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

dgra bo'i māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor bcas kyis: zor rdzas 'di la byin gyis rlobs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char spel: gang la btab kyang thogs med pa'i: gnam lcags thog rgod 'bar bar gyur: oṃ sarba ya ma ma rak+sha lo ha tsaṇ+ḍa ka ra ti ka khaḍ+ga dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags nyer gcig gam bdun gyis byin rlabs bya: de nas btsan rgod bskul ba ni: zor chen thogs la: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: mkhyen du gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: hoḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dam la gnas pa: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra chen po: 'bar ba khrag 'thung gi rgyal po: srog gcod bshan pa las la mngags pa'i khrag 'thung gi sde tshogs: 'bar ba khrag 'thung gi sde tshogs rnams snyan gsan cing phrin las bcol ba ni: hoḥ rgya gar bid+yot+ta ma'i btsan rgod har len chen po: yang le shod kyi btsan rgod ber ma chen po: chu mig byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog: sha 'ug brag gi btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab: sham+bha la yi btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan: ti se gangs kyi lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs: mchims phu brag gi btsan rgod bshan pa mig dmar: yang rdzong brag gi btsan rgod gnyan stag dmar po: mkha' spyod tsā ri'i btsan rgod gha ya dha ra: gzho stod ti sgro'i btsan rgod sog ra chen po: dbu ru zangs ri'i btsan rgod drag po zla skyong : sham po'i btsan rgod myur len har ting : sbas lung btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung : gze rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba: sku rgyal shen ne'i zangs btsan beg rtse: rong btsan gangs kyi btsan rgod bshan pa rlung dmar: gtsug lag btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa: dkor skyong btsan rgod shel ging smug po: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul btsan rgod kyi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum sde: 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs ru tra ming yig byang bur btab pa 'di rnams kyi:

bu pho rgyud dang bcas pa: bu mo mo rgyud dang bcas pa: pha tsho nye 'khor dang bcas pa: grong mi mthun grogs dang bcas pa: yul mkhar phyugs zhing dang bcas pa: srung skyob ban bon dang bcas pa: lo dang zla bar ma bzhag: zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang : dus tshod tshes grangs ma 'da' bar: dgra bo kho rang gi lha srung kho rang gi bdud du phob cig: gshed du phob cig: byad du phob cig: bshan par phob cig: dgra bo'i ngu 'bod yul ljongs khyab par ldir du chug cig: dgra bo pho rgyud smyo ru chug: mo rgyud 'bog tu chug: bu rgyud brgyal du chug: dgra bo gri ru sod la snying khrag thang du phos: dgra bo la gzer nad bco brgyad thongs/ pho rgyud sa bon me la bsregs pa bzhin du thongs: mo rgyud thams cad me dong chu yis bkang ba ltar du thongs: byis pa rigs rgyud thams cad ston ser kyis me tog bskams pa bzhin du thongs: phyugs nor zhing khang thams cad lcags dbyug gis byi'u sgong brdungs pa lta bur thongs shig: dgra bo mgo 'khor zhing snying rlung ldang bar gyis shig: dgra bo yid 'khrugs shing dran pa gtor bar gyis shig: dgra bo lus rmug cing bla 'phrog par gyis shig: dgra bo pho rgyud kyi sha la zo zhig: dgra bo mo rgyud kyi khrag la 'thungs shig: hoḥ btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis: bcol ba'i phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub par mdzod cig: ci ste las 'di ma 'grub na chos skyong khyed rnams kyis dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' bcag: rig 'dzin kun gyis zhe khrel: rdo rje theg pa'i dam nyams: mtha' med pa rdo rje theg pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro: de bas bcol ba'i phrin las 'di nam mkha'i thog ltar myur bar 'grub par mdzod cig: hoḥ phrin las bcol ba'i rten du: gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems 'bul lo: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul lo: rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'bul lo:

btsan bshos dgra snying dmar po 'bul lo: btsan mkhar btsan bshos sna tshogs 'bul lo: dar dmar la thod dmar po 'bul lo: btsan dar rnga thug sna tshogs 'bul lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bshan pa ru mnga' gsol lo: drag po zor 'debs kyi las chen po mdzod cig: de nas zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ tsā ri rgya gar byang shar mtshams: ma ru rtse yi dur khrod nas: phu na zangs brag gnam du gzengs: mtha' rnams khrag mtsho lbu ba 'khrigs: bar na btsan shing mtshon cha gzengs: logs rnams zangs ri rngam la 'jigs: 'khor yug zangs thang gya ma gyu: zangs lam stong gi sna yang zug: de dbus zangs mkhar dgu stong dbus: rngam byed btsan gyi rgyal po che: bshan pa yab yum sum cu drug: 'khor du gri thogs 'bum gyis bskor: sprul pa mtshal stag zangs 'phar 'gyed: rdzu 'phrul rlung dmar rta la zhon: bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum bskor: skye 'gro kun gyi srog dbugs bdag: zangs ral btsan mda' thog ltar 'phen: btsan rgod sde dpon 'khor bcas rnams: myur mgyogs drag rtsal klong nas bzhengs: srog bdag dmag sna dgra la drongs: zor mda' dgra bo'i snying la thob: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer: las la chos shig 'bar ba rtsal: dgra la chos shig ma ru rtse: mthu rtsal phyungs shig ma ru rtse: dgra sha zo zhig ma ru rtse: dgra khrag 'thungs shig ma ru rtse: dgra mkhar snubs shig ma ru rtse: dgra nor stor cig ma ru rtse: dgra dmag zlog cig ma ru rtse: btsan rgod dmag tshogs dus la bab: dgra bo'i snying la zor mda' bh+yoḥ har len chen po dgra la bh+yoḥ ber ma chen po dgra la bh+yoḥ dmar po dpon g.yog dgra la bh+yoḥ beng smug bswe khrab dgra la bh+yoḥ rol pa mi gzan dgra la bh+yoḥ lha btsan thog 'bebs dgra la bh+yoḥ bshan pa mig dmar dgra la bh+yoḥ mtshal stag dmar po dgra la bh+yoḥ lho btsan nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ

sog ra btsan rgod dgra la bh+yoḥ drag po zla skyong dgra la bh+yoḥ myur len har ting dgra la bh+yoḥ 'bar ba khrag 'thung dgra la bh+yoḥ rdo rje 'bar ba dgra la bh+yoḥ zangs btsan beg rtse dgra la bh+yoḥ bshan pa rlung dmar dgra la bh+yoḥ rdo rje legs pa dgra la bh+yoḥ shel ging smug po dgra la bh+yoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dgra la bh+yoḥ zor dpung btsan rgod drag pos bskyed: zor sna btsan rgod 'bum gyis drongs: zor 'debs bshan pa dmar nag bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya: oṃ shu la tsa tri ya dgra bo'i snying la rbad rbad: oṃ ma ru ghu na hṛ da ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: oṃ prañdza rak+mo dzaḥk+ṣiṃ ru phu lu ya dgra bo'i sha la rbad: oṃ rak+mo kha lu hi ta dgra bo'i khrag la rbad rbad: oṃ rak+sha shu la ya dgra bo'i rus la rbad rbad: oṃ rak+mo ya ma dz+wa la dgra bo'i dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: oṃ du tri du tri dgra bo'i yul mkhar la rbad rbad: oṃ shag thun raṃ bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i 'khor dang bcas pa la rbad rbad: zor bh+yo mā ra ya: thun bh+yo mā ra ya: rbad bh+yo mā ra ya: raṃ bh+yo mā ra ya: trig bh+yo mā ra ya: trig nan mā ra ya: sarba a mu ka mā ra ya zlog zlog: ces dmod pa drag po dang bcas te 'phangs pas dgra bo phye ma rdul phran bzhin du brlags te ming yang med par bsam: las sbyor rtags tshad ldan pa thon na dgra bo rtsa brlag 'byung par the tshom med: ma byung na btsan gsol yang yang bskyar la 'phang : lan gsum 'phang na sngags pa phur thog stong yin kyang brlag par 'gyur: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra rnal 'byor pa la ma nyes pa'i kha yog sogs byung na 'debs: de bas drin can pha ma'i ched du'ang mi 'phang : khyad par 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung yin pas: snod ldan re re tsam yina'ang lo gsum la ma brtag na mi sbyin: dpe dang gdams pa mi la mi bstan:

shin tu dam par 'chang : sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rtsa tri rgya: ྀatsha rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: za lam srin mo'i las zor bzlog pa mdos las dmar po bzhugs so: bla med rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: za lam srin mo'i bzlog pa ni: lcags snod dam ni gang rung du: gtor chen gcig la 'khor brgyad bya: rtsang dmar nyi shus legs par brgyan: byung na bud med khros ma'i gzugs: dmar gtor brgyad dang kong zor brgyad: legs par bskor zhing rtsang gis brgyan: rak+ta mchod cing mdos rdzongs bya: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis lan gsum brlab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ stong pa'i ngang las gnam lcags 'khor yug steng : de dbus dmar chen gtor ma khro mo'i mkhar: phyi ni mtshon cha nang ni thod pa'i dal: de dbus ma mo 'khor bcas gsal bar gyur: oṃ rak+mo ma tri bh+yo bh+yo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sa mā ya dzaḥ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo 'khor dang bcas pas rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ces gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs te rak+tas bran: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: zangs ri zangs thang dmar po rngam la 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sha za srog bdud las kyi ma mo chen po bzhugs pa ni: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i gzugs 'chang ma mo 'bum gyis bskor: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin zhing zangs mche dmar po gtsigs: mdos zor stong gi sna 'dren mdzad cing dgra dpung phye mar rlog: srog bdag stong gi gtso mos dgra la dmag dpung zor sna drongs:

deng 'dir ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo shugs 'chang rdo rje mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang rin chen mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang pad+ma mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang las kyi mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+mo ma tri rak+sha ya dgra la zlog: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang mtshams bzhi mo yi lcam rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+mo ma tri rak+sha ya dgra la zlog: de nas zor btegs la bzlog pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad kun: bkug cing bsgral nas lhag ma med par bzhes: zor mda' dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la rgyob: dus la bab bo ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: phyogs skyong yongs kyi sun ma zlog: ma mo yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sha za sman mo'i sun ma zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur ro mā ra ya:

ma tri ma mo ya tri zlog: zor ltar 'phen na: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: steng 'og phyogs bcu yi: dgra bgegs cham la phob: khro bo khro mo yi: drag sngags dgra la zlog: snang srid sde brgyad kyi: byad kha dgra la zlog: phyogs skyong bcu po yi: bsam sbyor dgra la zlog: ban bon sngags pa yi: phur kha dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug lo nyes kyi: chad pa dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba yi: phur kha dgra la zlog: lo zla zhag dus kyi: skag rigs dgra la zlog: mi kha dmod tshig gi: sdang sems dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan tshogs: bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: zor bh+yo ya: rbad bh+yo yaḥ raṃ bh+yo ya: dā bh+yo ya: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma mo dgra la chos: sha za dgra la chos: zor mda' dgra la ya: dgra srog myur du chod: raṃ zor ya: bh+yo zor ya: rbad zor ya: mā ra ya bzlog ya: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces zor ltar 'phen na gtor ma bya: mdos ltar rdzong na ma mo bya: 'di nyid snang srid kun gyi bdag mo phyir: bzlog pa kun la 'di nyid gtso: sa bdag brgya la gdong thug kyang : ma mo 'di yis bzlog par 'gyur: de bas zor sna kun la gces:

sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: ka ma la gar+bhi pā ris bya ka ra sha ma kum sa t+ya tha brti nan: ram markaṭa rā dza phaiṃ phaiṃ gu h+ya kha thaṃ kha th-iṃ atsha: maṅga laṃ// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las zor dgra snying dmar 'byin bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: zor mda' dgra snying dmar 'byin bstan: btab la lan med sa ma ya: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po zor las bya ba ni: rnal 'byor zhwa gos dmod pa'i chas: gdong la khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan: g.yab dar ru dar sna tshogs gzengs: rol mo rnga gshang bon thabs brdung : bskyed rdzogs dmigs pa brtan par bya: gong gnon sngags bsnyen sgrub pa gtso: mdun du liṅgar dgra bo dgug: zor thun lag len bzhin du shes: sa ma ya: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin che mchog ku mā ra: dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir dam nyams dgra la zor 'phen na: sgrub pa'i lha srung gnyan pos rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mas gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla mas rgyab rten mdzod: gang zag snyan brgyud bla mas dpung grogs mdzod: bka' lung shog ser brgyud pas nus mthu phyungs: bka' bab lung bstan brgyud pas byin rlabs 'bungs: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis dmag dpung skyed: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis ru mtshon phyor: dam can gter bdag rnams kyis mtshon char phob: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis zor sna drongs: srog bdag bshan pa 'bum gyis bla rten phrol: dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: dmod pa'i zor thun drag pos sgrol bar mdzod: de nas dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ me rlung thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas:

sha za ma mo shar gyi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: g.yag gdong sbrul gdong gzig gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ sre gdong dred gdong dom gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ dkar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying du zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: lho yi ma mo'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ bam ri khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: khrag 'thung ma mo lho yi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: pha waṃ chu srin sdig gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ khra mgo wa gdong stag gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ ser mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying du zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: nub kyi ma mo'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ dur khrod me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: srog gcod ma mo nub kyi dbang phyug bdun: srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: rgod mgo rta mgo khyung gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ khyi mgo pu shud shwa gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ dmar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: byang gi ma mo'i zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yoḥ dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang nas: dbugs len ma mo byang gi dbang phyug bdun:

srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa bsigs: lag na gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag thogs: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo dam nyams dgra la ya: dmigs pa'i byad ma ru tra shor ra re: spyang gdong skyin mgo phag gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ glang chen chu glang sbrul gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ ljang mo 'bum gyi gtso mo'i dus la bab: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la zor mda' ya: oṃ ma tri shwa rī maṣ+ṭa ya ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas ma mo bcu gnyis kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo: dur khrod chen po rab rgyu'i pho brang nas: gnas kyi srin mo 'bar ba bcu gnyis tshogs: gcer bu mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: dmar nag ral pa stong khams yengs se yeng : yams nad dug gi kha phru chi li li: dam nyams dgra la zor mda' sha ra ra: zor bh+yo thun bh+yo ma mo dgra la chos: re ti ya ma mched bzhi dgra la chos: myur mgyogs sa bdag ma bzhi las la chos: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: byad ma gdugs pa'i snying la mā ra ya: bh+yo bh+yo rak+mo tri ma tri du na rak+sha ya ma thun bh+yoḥ e hur thum rbad ya: de nas ging bdud bshan pa bcu gnyis kyi zor thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: 'chi bdag 'khrugs pa gshin rje'i pho brang nas: phur 'debs chen po las mkhan bcu gnyis tshogs: rngam phyir dgra bo'i srog len nyi li li: gtum phyir ru mtshon sna tshogs lhabs se lhab: spu gri mtshon cha dgra la thog ltar 'bebs: bshan pa 'bum gyi las byed khyugs se khyug: sde dpon las byed bcu gnyis dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra shor ra re: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ bdud po las byed sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ bshan pa gri thogs sde bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ byad ma dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ du pra ma ya mā ra tsa tri shu la rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas zor sna dgu 'phen pa ni:

nyungs zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen rnam par rgyal: yungs dkar zor mda' dgra la 'phen: myur mgyogs ser ba hri li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ti bi dza yā hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra ti la ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas dug zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen dbyug sngon can: dug gi zor mda' dgra la 'phen: smyo 'bog dug rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ni laṃ daṇ+ṭa mu ka ra hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra ha la dgra bo srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas khrag zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen gshin rje'i gshed: khrag zor dmar po dgra la 'phen: gzer nad lhog yams chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra rak+ta dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas rdo zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen mi g.yo mgon: rdo zor drag po dgra la 'phen: gzir 'debs rbab rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra she la dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas mtshe zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: mtshe mda' drag po dgra la 'phen: ke tshe shang tshe tshubs se tshub: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra khaḍ+ga ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas me zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal: me zor dbal kha dgra la 'phen: sreg byed me sgra 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs srog la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas chu zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: dug chu'i zor mda' dgra la 'phen: nad yams dal kha chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

badz+ra na ra ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas thod zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen khams gsum rgyal: thod zor skya bo dgra la 'phen: bhan+dha ya kha shams se sham: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra bhan+dha ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas khram zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni khro chen stobs po che: khram zor nag po dgra la 'phen: 'chi bdag las la sha ra ra: dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra sha truṃ ya dgra bgegs srog la hur thum rbad ya: de nas mda' zor thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni khro chen hūm̐ ka ra: gzhu ni rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: mda' ni phra thabs sprul pa'i sras: rbad do dgra bo'i srog la ya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra kro ti baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra nā ra ṇa mā ra ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: zhes dgra bgegs dpung tshogs thams cad rdul du brlags par bsgom: dmigs pa rnams ni spyi gzhung ltar bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling nas shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // bla med yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag las: dgongs gsol khro rgyal rngam sgra bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dgongs gsol khro rgyal rngam sgra bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: mthu chen de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dgongs gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni: las zor bya'am gtor chen brdeg: rnga rdung dung 'bud rak+ta bran: g.yab pa'i dar nag dang bcas shing : me chu gang rung dag la 'phang : dgra dpung zhal du bzhes par bsam: bzlog med dbyings su stims shig hoḥ

sa ma ya: dang po dgongs gsol rim pa ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ gsan du gsol lo: hoḥ gzigs su gsol lo: hoḥ 'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: dpal chen yang dag zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs gsan du gsol lo: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: bka' sdod chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs gsan du gsol lo: mthu ldan las la chas pa'i pho brang nas: dam can gter bdag pho nya dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi srung ma mthu me dpung las tsha ba: stobs thog rgod las myur ba: rtsal spu gri las rno ba: 'bebs dug mda' las gzir ba: gting rgya mtsho las zab pa: tshad ri bo las mtho ba: grangs rtsi shing las mang ba: bang glog dmar las mgyogs pa: rngam gshin rje las drag pa khyed rnams dgongs su gsol: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dmod pa ni: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: bstan pa'i chos skyong la phod btsugs pa: ya bo bzung ba: do bsdo ba: 'gras btsal ba: kha 'o ma las 'jam zhing snying tsher ma las rtsub pa: bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog snying rengs: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grul ba'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: nyos pa'i chung ma snying rangs: bsrungs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan: bskyabs pa'i le'u lha log: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: rang srog phung ba'i nor rdzas: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bo: bsam ngan log par shom nas mdun sgug rgyab 'ded byed pa: khyad par du yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra:

gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen: tshe la rku zhing srog la 'jab pa: bla la 'khyer zhing yid la rlom pa: che sri chung sri rgan sri: nad bdag yams bdag: khyad par dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: byad zor 'debs par byed pa'i gdug sems can: ngo log rgyab ston byed cing bka' la mi brtsi zhing dam la mi gnas pa rnams: mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: dma' mnar med dmyal khams yan chad gang du gnas kyang : che btsan khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i dgra bo thams cad bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: gsol zhig rol cig: ces 'phangs te gtor kha brdeg: de nas bzlog pa che ba yin na 'gugs gzhug bya ste 'phang yang rung : rta bro bya zhing sgab 'dre mnan: bkra shis sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab: gtang rag bya zhing dngos grub blang : tshe 'gugs rgyas btab bsngo smon bya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: yang zab kun gyi snying thig las: las mtha' bzlog bsad zab mo bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: mthu chen bud+dha dzñā na yi: sprul pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling : las can thugs sras de la sprod: 'bar ba btsan gyi sde dpon tshogs: zab chos 'di yi mel tshe mdzod: bdud rigs lag tu ma shor cig: sha 'ug stag sgor a thaṃ rgya: sgra gcan me rlung gwa'u dmar nag rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ྀatsha rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing*/ lcags lor gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ༈ bla med yang gsang gwa'u dmar nag las: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnam lcags rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so: bla med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma: gdams ngag bcud bsdus snying po bdud rtsi 'di: man ngag rin chen gsang ba ti ka'i chos: gnyis med zung 'jug ma ning thig le can: phyi nang 'khor 'das kun gyi ris mi phyed: rol pas rtsol med zab p-i atsha rgya: de yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: las mtha' go rim sbyin sreg brtsam pa ni: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi yi: gzhung gcig bsrangs nas dngos gzhi bstan pa la: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad mi mthun zhi ba dang : khams gsum dbang sdud tshe bsod rgyas pa'i phyir: dang po zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: lte ba zlum po oṃ gyis mtshan pa bya: mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng ba rim gcig bskor: phyi rol 'dab bzhi zur gyi rtsibs bcu dang : nyi shu'i rtsibs dang sgo bzhi tshom bu bzhi: mtshams su be con dgra satwa mdung thung dang : ral gri gsal shing mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng : phyi rol me ri 'tshub ma ris su bya: mtshams bzhi gong 'og zla phyed rdo rje'o: gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg brtsams pa la: lte ba gru bzhi dbus su yi ge hūm̐: 'dab bzhi nor bu mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng : lha grangs rtsibs ni gong bzhin 'dra ba la: rtsibs mchan nor bu dpal be'u 'khor lo dang : rgyal mtshan bca' gzhi phyi rol gong bzhin no: gsum pa dbang gi sbyin sreg brtsams pa ni: lte ba g.yung drung dbus su yi ge āḥ phyi rol pad 'dab mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng : rtsibs ni gong bzhin rtsibs mchan rdo rje dang : tshe bum pad+ma lcags kyu phyag mtshan bcas: phyi rol dag ni gong dang 'dra ba'o: bzhi pa drag po'i sbyin sreg bca' ba ni: lte ba gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad dbus su ram̐: 'dab bzhi rtsibs ldan mu khyud spu gri'i phreng : rtsibs ni gong bzhin rtsibs mchan ral gri dang :

phur bu sogs le chu gri 'phreng du 'dod: mu khyud gri gug phreng ba tshal du bsgreng : phyi rim rnams ni gong bzhin shes par bya: rgyas pa ltar na dkyil 'khor lha gzhung bzhin: rtsig pa'i shing yang rnam pa bzhi 'dod ste: ba lu lcang ma tsan+dan skyer pa'o: drag po la ni tsher ma sna tshogs can: rtsig pa'i shing tshad gtub pa zhal las shes: yam shing 'om bu'am ni las gzhung bstun: mchod pa la yang phyi nang rnam pa gsum: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod rnam pa lnga: gsang mchod bzhi dang rdzas kyi go rim ni: mar khu phye mar yam shing dūrba dang : ram dang bcas pa'i shing 'bras sna tshogs dang : sman sna 'bru sna rdzas lnga sha lnga dang : khol bcud rin chen sna lnga dar sna lnga: phrom dang zhun sogs khur ba'i bye brag bcas: me dar g.yab dar gong gtor mchod gtor bcas: gzhan yang phrin las so so'i rdzas phran ni: zhi bar sman sna zhal zas sna tshogs dang : rgyas par rin chen tshogs kyi pū dza dang : dbang la mngar bcud ril bu tam+bu ra: drag por sha sna khrag sna liṅga dang : dpal gtor dang bcas phyag len bzhin tu shes: phra mo zur gsal 'don cha'i tshig dang bstun:

sa ma ya: de nas mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: rdzas rnams mang nyung cha snyoms lhag chad spang : 'di lugs rgyas pa byas na: sbyin sreg gi phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mchod pa so sor bkram: rnal 'byor pas kyang de bzhin 'bul lugs bya: de la las bzhi lhun grub phyag bzhes zer ba'o: phrin las dang gzhung yang zer : rgyas par bkram na: phyi mchod shar: gzugs sgra dri ro lho: sman raka nub: dbang po rnam lnga byang : yam shing shar lho: ku sha lho nub: dūrba nub byang : tam+bu ra byang shar: de yi phyi rol shar du sman lnga: shar lho 'bru lnga: lhor rin chen lnga: lho nub sha lnga: nub tu bcud lnga: nub byang du dar sna lnga: byang du rdzas lnga: byang shar du rdzas zas mchog rigs sna tshogs: de yi phyi rol du: shar du zhi ba'am phrin las rten zhal zas brgyad: lhor rgyas pa'i tshogs brgyad: nub tu dbang gi ril bu brgyad: byang du drag po'i liṅga brgyad dam dpal gtor: mtshams bzhir me lha'i gtor ma bzhi: phyi rol mda' dar sna lnga phyogs mthun: sa ma ya: de nas bkram pa'i sngags ni: thog mar rdo rje slob dpon he ru ka pa'i chas su zhugs nas: hūm̐: badz+ra he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes rang nyid ngar bskyed: g.yas pas thabs kyi gzar bu thogs la: oṃ e shrī traṃ tra ti shu swā hā: g.yon shes rab kyi blugs snod thogs la: oṃ waṃ shrī rod bi shu ta ye swā hā: zhes thabs shes kyis bsnol: sngags 'di bzlas shing rdzas rnams reg par bya: oṃ badz+ra shrī la ku ta ku ta pra bi ra ma hā ku la ko swā hā: zhes thams cad la reg: shar gyi rdzas la: oṃ badz+ra a pī sha swā hā: dbus su pad kor bcas: oṃ badz+ra shrī bh+ya bh+rūm̐ bh+ya hūm̐ bh+ya trām̐ bh+ya a bh+ya hrīḥbh+ya swā bh+ya hā bh+ya ko la k+ṣa traṃ: zhes me sne gnon byed dūrba rgya gram lnga'i sngags ni: oṃ raṃ su ra k+ṣa: oṃ raṃ su pa k+ṣa: oṃ raṃ na ti k+ṣa:

oṃ raṃ shi k+ṣa: oṃ raṃ bhi wa k+ṣa: zhes dang me dar 'dzugs mtshams su tiṣ+ṭha bya: thab bsang sbyang sngags ni: oṃ tam+bu la shū ti bi su ki ri na ra ko sa a tsa k+ṣa mu te e pa pa du sha traṃ: hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i klong : āḥ ma 'gags shar ba snod bcud sgyu ma 'di: oṃ: rgyu yi gzugs kyang rkyen gyis 'phros med sangs: bh+rūm̐: 'khor 'das ma 'gags thab khung stong par sbyangs: ram̐: ke tra ru ni las bzhi lhun gyis grub: yam̐: su wa ra yi rgyud kyis rab bskul nas: kham̐: 'di yi dwangs bcud sna tshogs rgyas pa'i hoḥ hrīḥ mtshan 'dzin mi dmigs de bzhin ka nas dag: oṃ badz+ra dharma e ga ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ: zhes pas ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyis dag gtsang dang brda gsum gyis thab bskyed: gzhung bzhin las sngags dang ḍāk+ki'i gsang skad rnams ci bzhin dag par bzla: rtsa sngags rnams la gzhung bzhin saṃ skṛ ta phyi 'gyur gyi skad ltar bzlas: sa ma ya: de nas dkyil 'khor gzhung du 'jug pa la: 'bags pa bsal zhing byin gyis rlob pa'i yig 'brus sbyangs: dam tshig me lha'i pho brang bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kro dha he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs nas: stong pa'i ngang las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: zur bzhi zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sgo dang gru chad mtshan nyid du ma dang ldan pa'o: de'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ smug nag yongs su gyur pa las: me lha'i pho brang 'byung lnga rab tu 'bar zhing ngad tsha ba mched pa'i steng du: ram̐ las me lha sku mdog dmar ser g.yo ba ra skyes kham nag la zhon pa: g.yas rtse lnga dang g.yon rtse gsum 'dzin pa: he ru ka gyad rngam gdong gi cha lugs can: yum gsal byed ma nyi zla thogs pas mgul nas 'khyud pa: yab yum gyi gnas lnga ru me lha yab yum sbyor ba mtshams su 'byung ba me'i lha mo bzhi bcas gsal ba'o: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rlung gi dal la phog:

snod kyi rlung chen g.yos: snang bzhi skyed pa'i me la tsha ba'i ngar thon: des me lha'i 'khor gyi lha mo gsal byed bzhi la phog pas 'byung bzhi khams lnga me sgron rang bzhin du 'bar bar gyur: zhes me sgron rlung g.yab thogs la: hūm̐: shar nas nad gdon zhi ba'i me: me long ye shes ngang du sbar: lho nas tshe bsod rgyas pa'i me: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du sbar: nub nas khams gsum dbang sdud me: sor rtog ye shes ngang du sbar: byang du dgra bgegs tshar gcod me: bya grub ye shes ngang du sbar: dbus nas chos dbyings rang byung me: ka dag zang thal ngang du sbar: sku lnga rang byung lhun grub me: de bzhin ngang gis me sbar ro: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma dzñā na sa ma ye swā hā: ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐: de nas rlung g.yab ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo g.yo ba mo: byams pa chen po'i rlung g.yobs shig: lho phyogs bde ba spel ba mo: snying rje chen po'i rlung g.yobs shig: byang phyogs thogs med g.yo ba mo: stong nyid chen po'i rlung g.yobs shig: dbus phyogs skye med stong pa mo: ye shes chen po'i rlung g.yobs shig: oṃ yam̐ yam̐ u pa ta dzñā na yam̐ yam̐ swā hā: de nas me mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brtsam pa la: shar phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs: badz+ra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg brtsam pa la: lho phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs: oṃ rat+na tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: dbang gi sbyin sreg brtsam pa la: nub phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs: oṃ pad+ma tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: drag po'i sbyin sreg brtsam pa la: byang phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs: oṃ karma tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: kun 'dus dkyil 'khor brtsam pa la:

dbyings kyi sgo mas me mtshams srungs: oṃ dharma tsakra ye swā hā: thabs shes ltar me sbar rlung g.yab mda' dar 'dzugs so: de nas ye shes me lha spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i dbyings nas rang bzhin sprul pa'i lha: skye med ngang nas 'bar ba'i gzi brjid bskyed: dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags bsreg pa'i phyir: ye shes me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dam tshig byin za'i lha dang dbyer med du: mchod cing mched phyir gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka dzñā na ag+ne ye sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer ma mchis par gyur: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: snod kyis bsdus nas snang ba'i rol gar du: dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: mtshan 'dzin bud shing sreg mdzad brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: de nas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings kyi ngo bo dpal chen gar dgu can: rig pa'i dpa' bo shes rab tsaṇ+ḍa lī: dug lnga sgrol mdzad sku lnga'i rang mdangs bskyed: tshad med bzhi yi phrin las lhun grub phyir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: snod kyi khyon yangs 'geng ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams: 'bar ba'i rdo rje drang srong lha tshogs la: las bzhi don lnga gnyer phyir 'bul lags na: bag sgrib a 'thas gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ raṃ he ru ka a haṃ dhe wa ma hā ri dhi ri dhi dzñā na sa ma dz+wa la a hu ti pū dza ye sarba sa mu dra kha kha khā hi: zhes pas bsreg rdzas mar khu bcas mtshams su 'bul: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes khro bo rab 'bar dpa' bo'i sku: rdo rje gnam lcags shugs 'chang shin tu 'khyugs: mi bzad tsha ba'i ngar ldan gtum pa mo: bzhin gyi bzhad pas dug lnga thabs kyis 'dul: srid gsum 'dar zhing snang byed 'od po che: ye shes me lha 'khor dang bcas la bstod: oṃ badz+ra u ta k+ṣa ko ta k+ṣa ko la ka ri waṃ shud+dha ri ta ye swā hā:

zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags 'phreng ko la ta yi skad du bsgyur ba'o: de nas me lha bskyed cing gzhung la 'jug pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs: stong pa'i ngang las dam tshig gi me thab las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa snod kyi khyon dang mnyam pa shin tu ngad tsha ba ram̐ lnga dang ldan pa: de'i ngang las ye shes kyi me lha he ru ka chen po byin za rdo rje 'bar ba khro bo thabs shes zung ldan gyi ngang las stong nyid bcu drug rgyu rtsal ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo me lha de yi lto ba rgya che zhing yangs pa'i dbus su skyon bral pad+ma gsal byed nyi ma dri med zla ba: de'i steng du dbyings rig drug ldan gyi dbus su hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa khro bo yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'o: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ badz+ra ko la shrī shu ye swā hā: 'di skad du gzhung gi phrin las btang ba mchod pa'i tshul mtshams su bskyar: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mar khu: rtsa sngags sham bur: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra raṃ a hu ti ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a dhi bh+ya a dhi bh+ya ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya swā hā: zhes lnga bdun gang rung du bzlas pa'i sham bu la: zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phrin las: hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag sgrub pa po dang : rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di yi nad gdon bgegs rigs 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag sgrub pa po dang : rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod dpal dang grags pa la sogs 'byor drug thams cad rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

dbang la: hoḥ dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag sgrub pa po dang : rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis: khams gsum snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum spyi dang bye brag 'dzam bu gling 'di yi 'gro ba mtha' dag dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: oṃ pā shaṃ ma ma thun thun ye swā hā: drag po la: hoḥ dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag sgrub pa po dang : rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i tshogs rno ba'i dbal sbyor ba'i dug bstan dang sgos dgra la sogs zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ dgra bgegs a mu ka mā ra ya rbad: kho na nyid la: hoḥ dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag sgrub pa po dang : rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad las grol zhing dal brgyad 'byor pa bcu thob rang snang dbang 'du gzhan snang zil gyis gnon ste chos nyid mngon sum mthong nyams rtogs gong du 'phel rig pa tshad la phebs: chos nyid zad sar 'khyol nas gdod ma'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur pa'i rgyal sa zin par gyur cig: āḥdharma dhā tu dzñā na ho hūm̐: zhes pa'i 'dod gsol kun la 'gre'o: de nas phyi mchod la: hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon: blo yis bzung dang ma bzung du ma'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: me tog go: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: bdug spos so: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: mar me'o: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: dri chab bo: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: zhal zas so: oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: rol mo'o: de nas nang mchod la: hūm̐:

sgeg mo glu mo gar mo bzhad pa mo: zla 'byin la sogs gsang ba rig ma'i tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ rū pa swā hā: gzugs mdzes so: oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: sgra snyan no: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: zhal chab bo: oṃ badz+ra rā sa swā hā: ro mchog go: oṃ badz+ra par+she swā hā: reg bya'o: gsang mchod la: hūm̐: rang byung skye med chos dbyings bde ba'i snod: sman gtor rak+ta bcud mchog du mas gtams: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta swā hā: bdud rtsi'o: oṃ badz+ra a haṃ ti swā hā: bde chen no: oṃ badz+ra rak+ta ho swā hā: rak+ta'o: oṃ bha ling+ta swā hā: gtor ma'o: de nas bsgral mchod la: hūm̐: bhan+dha yangs pa gling bzhi'i snod mchog tu: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga spungs: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ne tra ye swā hā: mig go: oṃ badz+ra gh+raṃ swā hā: rna ba'o: oṃ badz+ra ko pa ta swā hā: sna'o: oṃ badz+ra dzi hā k+ṣa swā hā: lce la'o: oṃ badz+ra kim tsa te swā hā: snying ngo : rdzas bzhi la: brda'i skad do: hūm̐: phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i rdzas bzhi po: rten 'brel las byung kun kyang 'di ltar snang : dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ kaṇ+ṭa k+ṣa swā hā: yam shing ngo : oṃ pa shu ta swā hā: ku sha'o: oṃ pu ki' sī swā hā: dūrba'o: oṃ te la k+ṣa swā hā: mar zan la'o: rdzas sna tshogs la: hūm̐: yid 'ong 'dod rgu longs spyod sna tshogs rdzas: kun nas tshang zhing blos blangs 'di dag kun: dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ e ma u swā hā:

a ru ra'o: oṃ bhi wa shu swā hā: dzā ti'o: oṃ bha san+t+ra swā hā: gur gum mo: oṃ gh+raṃ ka ta swā hā: li shi'o: oṃ mu la k+ṣaṃ swā hā: tsan+dan no: oṃ ni tha ta swā hā: nas la'o: so ba la yang zer: oṃ pi shi shu swā hā: 'bras la'o: oṃ ka sha raṃ swā hā: gro'o: oṃ ri ka su swā hā: khre'o: om̐ bi wa shu swā hā: sran ma'o: oṃ swa pa ri swā hā: gser ro: oṃ ri shwa bi swā hā: dngul lo: oṃ ka shu han swā hā: zangs so: oṃ dzu mu ka swā hā: lcags so: oṃ mu ku su k+ṣa swā hā: mu tig go: sha lnga ni: oṃ nā ga traṃ swā hā: mi sha'o: oṃ gha ri shu swā hā: rta sha'o: oṃ bha bī su swā hā: glang po che'i sha'o: oṃ ka ki ra swā hā: khyi sha'o: oṃ bh+ya shu ta swā hā: 'dab chags mche ba can no: oṃ ta shu ka swā hā: bu ram mo: oṃ mri ga k+ṣu swā hā: sbrang ngo : oṃ smi pa k+ṣu swā hā: ka ra 'o: oṃ dha hī k+ṣu swā hā: 'o zho'o:

oṃ pa ti k+ṣu swā hā: mar thud khrum mo: oṃ pa ti ta swā hā: dar dkar ro: oṃ swa ti ta swā hā: dar ser ro: oṃ pa shu tsa swā hā: dar dmar po'o: oṃ pa yaṃ k+ṣa swā hā: dar ljang ngo : oṃ sa maṃ ka swā hā: dar mthing ngo : oṃ kro ta ti swā hā: til dkar ro: oṃ kri ta si swā hā: til nag go: oṃ sa sha ra swā hā: yungs dkar ro: oṃ pa shu ra swā hā: yungs nag go: oṃ bhe wu kha swā hā: ke tshe la'o: oṃ bha ti ku la dha hu k+ṣa swā hā: zas mchog zhun dang shing 'bras sna tshogs la'o: de ltar so so'i rdzas dang dmigs pa kha bsgyur gong 'og skabs dang bstun: sa ma ya: de nas phrin las bzhi'i bstod bskul du 'jug pa ni: zhi ba la: hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang : dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba'i dus la bab: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab: 'byung po'i drag rtsub zhi ba'i dus la bab:: dam sri'i kha rlangs zhi ba'i dus la bab:: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma rungs bdud dgra zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de yis zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyas pa la: hūm̐: rin chen 'bar ba'i pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang : dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i dus la bab: gsang sngags theg chen rgyas pa'i dus la bab: chos dang snyan grags rgyas pa'i dus la bab: tshe bsod 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rgyal bstan 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: de yis rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med:

rgyas mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang la: hūm̐: pad+ma 'khyil pa'i pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang : dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dus la bab: khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i dus la bab: tshe chos zas nor sdud pa'i dus la bab: bsod nams phywa g.yang sdud pa'i dus la bab: longs spyod mnga' thang sdud pa'i dus la bab: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: skye 'gro dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: de yis dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: dbang sdud lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: drag po la: hūm̐: phrin las drag po e yi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang : dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgrol ba'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sgrol ba'i dus la bab: bla ma'i sku dgra sgrol ba'i dus la bab: sdig can dam nyams sgrol ba'i dus la bab: ma rungs dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: skeg dang phung sri sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: zhing bcu dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: de yis bsgral bar ma gyur gang yang med: sgrol mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di yi skabs su bskul gtor 'bul kyang rung : de nas me lha'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs zhi ba'i phrin las sku: me long ye shes me lha la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: zhe sdang me dpung dbyings su sdud: shar gyi sgo mas phrin las mdzod: shar gyi mda' dar sdud: hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i phrin las sku: mnyam nyid ye shes me lha la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'bul:

nga rgyal me dpung dbyings su sdud: lho yi sgo mas phrin las mdzod: lho yi mda' dar sdud: hūm̐: nub phyogs dbang gi phrin las sku: sor rtog ye shes me lha la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: 'dod chags me dpung dbyings su sdud: nub kyi sgo mas phrin las mdzod: nub gyi mda' dar sdud: hūm̐: byang phyogs drag po'i phrin las sku: bya grub ye shes me lha la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: phrag dog me dpung dbyings su sdud: byang gi sgo mas phrin las mdzod: byang gi mda' dar sdud: hūm̐: dbus phyogs chos dbyings phrin las sku: he ru ka dpal me lha la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: gti mug me dpung dbyings su sdud: dbus phyogs bdag mos phrin las mdzod: steng phyogs mda' dar sdud: de nas me zhags phra mo ni las kyi rtsa sngags kyis me rdzas sngags: bskul gzhung nas blangs te dmigs pa dang bcas sreg par bya: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ rang byung rol pas bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: byin za 'ja' tshon sgyu ma bzhin du lta: ye shes sems dpa' dbyings rig stong pa āḥ dam tshig sems dpa' snang stong gnyis med oṃ: ting 'dzin sems dpa' skye med ka dag hūm̐: gdod ma'i gshis lugs ngo bo de ltar ldang : zhes dmigs bral ngang du dkyil 'khor bsdu: dal gyi sa stegs gtsang sar bskyal: bkra shis bsngo smon las rim gzhung rnams bsrangs: de ltar bgyis pa'i dgos ched ni: yi dam lha yi bka' chad zhi: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog grol: chos skyong rnams kyis phrin las sgrub: gter bdag srung ma las la khol: tshe yi bar chad bdud las grol: phyi ma dge ba rlabs chen 'phel: dkyil 'khor bsnyen sgrub thams cad kyi: las kyi mtha' sdud 'di nyid zab: de phyir nyams len gdams par brtson: gzhung gi 'khrugs sdeb shes par bya: des na man ngag snying po'o:

sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: mtha' yas las ni rnam pa bzhi: mnan sreg 'phang dang bzlog pa'i las: 'di dag sreg pa'i gdams pa ste: dgra bgegs sreg pa zur du gsal: las bzhi phrin las rgyun khyer ni: cha tshang don dril 'di kho na: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gnod sbyin chen po me 'od gdong : bka' yi rgya 'di legs par srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing sbas yul pad+ma rong gi brag gad pad+ma shel phug tu me rta lor shog ser las legs par zhal bshus pa'o/ maṅga laṃ// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dzap bzlas bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings mthing nag e klong nas: khrag 'thung rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dang : yang dag he ru ka yi gtso 'khor bcas: gdul dka' 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs shig: snang srid 'khor 'das gzugs can gzugs med dang : kun bzang thugs dang 'jag ma'i srin bu yan: snang gzugs thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad kī li'i drag sngags sgra: dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ting nge 'dzin: yin min ngos bzung bral ba'i dbyings chen por: the tshom zad pas bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: re dogs bral ba chos nyid klong du bzla: yang phur sbrags ma'i bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid yang dag dpal chen he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rgyan dang ldan pa gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gdan la rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad dang ldan par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng gsal byed rdo rje he ru ka mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug yab yum kha sbyor gyi rnam pa'i spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od klong du yang dag rdo rje rigs bdag gi tshul du zhabs gnyis mthil sprad kyis bzhugs pa'i tshul du bsgoms la/

rigs bdag thugs kar sngags 'khor bar bsgom/ gsal byed he ru ka'i thugs kar rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'i lte bar 'od lnga'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po spu shad kyis bris pa lta bu zhig bsgoms la sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su 'khor bar bsam la/ zhes o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las las rab rtsal gyis sbyar ba'o// // ༈ yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi bdud rtsi lag mchod bzhugs so/ kun tu bzang po chos sku'i lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rdo rje sems dpa' longs sku'i lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dga' rab rdo rje sprul sku'i lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mañdzu shrī brda brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ shrī singha don brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ pra bha hastī tshig brgyud bla ma la/ sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ go byi de ma rgyud sde rgya mtsho la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ pad+ma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ye shes mtsho rgyal brda bzhi klong yangs la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sangs rgyas ye shes sgra bsgyur lo tsā la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa la/

/sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ drin can rnam 'dren brgyud par bcas pa la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ yang dag rdo rje gsal byed he ru ka /che mchog yab yum rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /kī la drag po rigs bzhi yab yum la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sprul pa'i khro bcu phra thabs nyi shu dang*/ /dbyings phyug sgo skyong shwa na ma mo mched/ /re ti sa bdag skyes bu ging la sogs/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'bar ba bdud bzhi srog bdag bshan pa dang*/ /sprul pa yang sprul dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i bdag /bka' gter srung ma btsan rgod tshogs bcas la/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'bul lo dngos sgrub stsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes mtheb srin gyis gnas gsum du dngos grub blang*/ don dam chos nyid yangs pa'i klong*/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i dngos grub rnams/ /deng bdag sgo gsum yongs smin cing*/ /grub gnyis mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa rnam 'dren dam pa dzñā na dh+wa dzas bskul ngor phran seṅge'i ming gis bris pa dge'o// // ༈ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ 'og min ka dag bde chen pho brang nas/ /yang dag ye shes rol pa'i lha tshogs la/ /zhi ba thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /shar phyogs me long sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la/ /rab 'jigs stobs ldan khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /lho phyogs mnyam nyid thugs kyi pho brang nas/ /dpal chen gtso bo khro rgyal hūm̐ kar la/

khro bcu phra thabs rab 'jigs 'khor gyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /nub phyogs sor rtog rang gsal pho brang nas/ /dpal gyi bka' nyan bshan pa'i ging chen la/ /za byed phur skyong nyer bzhi'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /byang phyogs bya grub kun grol pho brang nas/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa me 'od gdong can la/ /gter rgya bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang phrin las sna tshogs pho brang nas/ /mthu ldan sprul pa nyid sprul 'khor bcas la/ /yang sprul bka' srung ma lus tshogs kyis bskor/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ zhes nyer mkho tshogs kyi spyan 'dren bsdus pa gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phyag bzlog yang dag zhal rgyun bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ dpal chen che mchog yab kyi thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan steng du/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /mthing nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad 'bar/ /rtsa zhal mthing dmar shin tu nag po ni/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid g.yo 'gul sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yas gsum dkar nag ljang nag 'khrugs pa ni/ /steng gi lha rnams ma lus dbang du sdud/ /lha yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yon zhal dmar smug sngo zhing 'bar ba ni/ /'og gi sa bdag klu gnyan dbang du sdud/ /klu gnyan dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ /snang srid pho rgyud dbang du sdud par byed/ /pho rgyud byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gnyis pas gri gug 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /lha min dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /lha min byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gsum pas ral gri bsam chod bsnams pa ni/

/bar snang gnyan gyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud/ /gnyan gyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bzhi pas dbyug tho rngam brjid bsnams pa ni/ /ma mo'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /ma mo'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog lnga pas dgra satwa ha chen bsnams pa ni/ /ging chen dmag tshogs ma lus dbang du sdud/ /ging chen byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /drug pas gnam lcags thog chen bsnams pa ni/ /gza' yi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /gza' bdud byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bdun pas tsan dan beng chen bsnams pa ni/ /mgon po'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /mgon po'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog brgyad pas gsal shing rab 'jigs bsnams pa ni/ /the'u rang dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /the'u rang byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung bsnams pa ni/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud par byed/ /ma mo'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gnyis pas bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams pa ni/ /snang srid ma mo dbang du sdud par byed/ ma mo'i khrag nad sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /gsum pas 'gugs byed lcags kyu bsnams pa ni/ /bdud kyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /bdud kyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bzhi pas sdom byed lcags sgrog bsnams pa ni/ /btsan gyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /btsan gyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /lnga pas tsit+ta snying sgrom bsnams pa ni/ /sa bdag klu gnyan dbang du sdud par byed/ /klu yi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /drug pas zhags pa nag po bsnams pa ni/ /rgyal po'i dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /rgyal po'i byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /bdun pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ /gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /gnod sbyin byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /brgyad pas sog le ngar chen bsnams pa ni/

/bgegs kyi dmag tshogs dbang du sdud par byed/ /bgegs kyi byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba ni/ khams gsum srid gsum g.yo zhing 'gul bar byed/ /snang srid byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa ni/ /gdong sder rwa mchu lto 'gros ltas ngan bsgral/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa ni/ /gza' dang rgyu skar dbang du sdud par byed/ /gza' skar byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid pa ni/ /dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du sdud par byed/ /ru tra'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog /yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khyud/ /snang srid ma mo dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i sun kha dgra la zlog hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di bzhes la/ /rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/

ces pa 'di'ang gter gzhung nas kher thub cig mi 'dug pas gsang sngags dar rgyas kyi ngor/ gnubs sprul rtsa gsum gling pas gsungs pa'o// // yang dag phur pa'i gtor zlog gsog thabs la/ drag po'i lcags snod du gtor chung liṅga sha dum bcu bshams la/ spro na tshar bcu re'i mtshams mdun du drag po tshar re brjod la/ yang phur gtor zlog grangs mang gsog skabs rgyas pa mi lcogs par 'di ltar bya ste/ hūm̐: gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ khro bcu phra thabs yab yum dbang phyug bcas/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang ma mo ging bdud tshogs/ /phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /che btsan 'bar ba'i mthu stobs dus 'dir bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra mu stegs ngan sngags dang*/ /ban bon byad zor mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la log 'dren zhing bcu'i rigs/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /lo zla spar sme rlung rta'i skag chen sogs/ /dus min 'chi ba'i skag rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /dar sri phung sri na sri 'chi sri dang*/ /god sri dgra gyod sri rigs bzlog tu gsol/ /nad rims dal yams rmi ltas pra rtags ngan/ /mi 'dod than ltas thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bar mtshams nas/ /gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ e ka du nan zlog ya ma du nan zlog rā dza rbad nan zlog yak+sha rbad nan zlog ma tri bh+yo nan zlog du ru du nan ya zlog ha la tsakra ya zlog rbad bh+yo raṃ bh+yoḥya zlog bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog /bzlog bzlog / ces stong bzlog rgyas pa bsog dka' bar 'dug pas/ dad btsun dbang drag nas rin chen gsum pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang lha rdzas bcas nas bskul ngor rang lugs gter gzhung sor bzhag nas ban rgan ā yu'i ming gis gang dran bris pa nyes 'gal gang mchis rtsa gsum chos srung tshogs la bshags shing*/

'di yis bstan 'gro'i bar chad zhi zhing 'gro don rgya cher gyur cig/ // hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhi med rtsa bral don gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rang byung rig pa yang dag he ru kaḥ rig rtsal dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /bsal bzhag bral ba'i dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /mtshan 'dzin rnam rtog bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa ka dag dbyings su zlog /dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ye shes lnga ru bsgyur/ /rig pa phur bu chos zad gdod ma'i klong*/ /ye grol chos sku'i gtan srid zin gyur cig / bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis nub phyogs a ri'i bye brag dbus kyi char gang shar lag bris bgyis pa'o// // ༈ der tho zhig bslangs nas thams cad zhal phyir bsgyur te 'di ltar brjod do: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'byung po phyir 'brang khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: phyin chad ldang bar ma gyur cig: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing nang du log nas phye mar bkra shis 'bras la rol te lha rgyal lo rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes zer nas nang du log go/ // ༈ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol: trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mtha' btsan shog: ༈ na mo/ dkon mchog rin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can gter srung thams cad kyi bden stobs kyis bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang snyan grags gdul bya phrin las tshe chos zas nor longs spyod kha rje dbang thang bkrag gzi mdangs thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: dza ya dza ya maṅga laṃ sarba sid+dhi ku ru ye swā hā:

de nas sngags pa rgyal dbyangs ni/ hūm̐: pho brang lhun grub 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs skur bsgoms te: bdud dang rkyen ngan g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: 'dre gdon bgegs kyi g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: byad kha rbod gtong g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: bar chad rkyen ngan g.yul ngo chen po las: da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal: rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo: bsod nams stobs chen 'di yi mthus/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min? sogs? tshe gzungs brjod/ maṅga laṃ// // hūm̐: rdo rje tshe yi pho brang nas: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dzñā na ā yu sid+dhi hrīḥ de nas tshe 'gugs bya zhing tshe chang dang tshe ril thogs la: hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po 'chi med tshe yi lha: pad+ma rgyal po gsang 'dus dbang chen bdag: mgyogs ma tshe 'gugs lha mo 'bum gyis bskor: sgo ma'i phyag mtshan steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros: nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho'i bcud: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i khams lnga dang : snang srid dang ni snod bcud skye 'gro yi: bla tshe rnam shes bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rnams: 'od zer lcags kyus bsdus nas bdag la stims: pho nya sgo ma'i tshogs kyis dbang du sdus: rig 'dzin lus la bstims pas gzi brjid 'bar: 'khor lo lnga ldan ye shes 'od kyis gang : bdud rtsis lus kun khyab pas rā ga'i mdog: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥpad+ma dha ra ya hūm̐:

ma ma sid+dhi pha la dza dzaḥ zhes tshe chang tshe ril la longs spyod/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar dkar po thogs nas: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: shar phyogs dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar ser po thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: lho phyogs ser mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: de nas mda' dar dmar po thogs nas/ hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: nub phyogs dmar po mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar ljang gu thogs nas/ hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: byang phyogs ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar sngon po thogs nas: hūm̐: bud+dha rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: dbus phyogs sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: kha skong tshe 'gugs ni: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe yi mnga' bdag mo: sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje tshe bum 'dzin: lha tshogs dkyil 'khor tshe yi sgo phye la: tshe yi dkyil 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe yi mnga' bdag mo: sku mdog ser mo rin chen tshe bum 'dzin: lha tshogs dkyil 'khor tshe yi sgo phye la:
