tshe yi dkyil 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: rin chen tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe yi mnga' bdag mo: sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma tshe bum 'dzin: lha tshogs dkyil 'khor tshe yi sgo phye la: tshe yi dkyil 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: pad+ma tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe yi mnga' bdag mo: sku mdog ljang mo rgya gram tshe bum 'dzin: lha tshogs dkyil 'khor tshe yi sgo phye la: tshe yi dkyil 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: las kyi tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe yi mnga' bdag mo: sku mdog mthing kha 'khor lo tshe bum 'dzin: lha tshogs dkyil 'khor tshe yi sgo phye la: tshe yi dkyil 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: 'don cha'i zin bris dbang po'i lde mig bhi dza ha/ bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la 'dud/ de yang bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag ces pa gnyis med zung 'jug thabs shes kha sbyor te gnyis su med pa'i don yin/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i gter lung las/ sha 'ug stag sgor ma ning gter bcu sbas: zhes pa yang phur 'di kho na/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po bsgrubs pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: zhes pa yang 'di kho na dang*/ gu ru pad+mas yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar chad kyi rnam pa byung bas rdo rje gdan nas rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba ltar/

phur pa'i glegs bam phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul phur pa bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnam gsum du gsal ba dang*/ khyad par sgrub skor 'di ga'i lo rgyus las/ rdo rje phur pa mchog gi rgyud bid+yat+to ma lar/ phur pa'i yang snying ste rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying gsang ba 'di kho na gsungs/ hūm̐ ka ra'i yang phur gong khug ma nyi zla kha sbyor kyang 'di yin te/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud lha dkar nag khra gsum las: gnyis med ma ning gi skor rnams lha khra'i gzhung du 'dod: ces gsungs: nor phyugs dang chos kyi bar chad byed pa thams cad bdud dang bar chad 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa med pas rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa'i yi dam med do gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i chos gang sgrub kyang bar chad thams cad phur pas srung bar 'gyur ro: gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ phyag na rdo rje dang po byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i dus su theg pa chen po skyong mdzad kyi srung mar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i sgrub pa po thams cad kyi lus dang*/ grib ma ltar 'grogs nas srung zhing skyob pa de yi phyir bskul ba tsam gyis phrin las mdzad nges la/ srung ma ltar bsnyen sgrub bskul bas bar chad thul nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i dgos chad yod do gsungs/ de yang stod las byang chub sgrub pa/ spyi gzhung bar chad bsal ba smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba ste gsum las/ 'di nyid rang gzhan bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i zin bris 'bring po tsam la 'jug pa ni/ dang po srung bzlog gi bca' gzhi legs par bkod la/ gu ru rtsa gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchan/ gyi rten gtor/ chos skyong drag po sde lnga/ gang 'os zhing skyong bka' gter srung dge bsnyen/ ma'i rten gtor legs par bya/ sman raka mchod pa sna lnga/

mchod gsol kyi gtor 'bul gang 'os/ sngon 'gro cha gnyis sogs legs par grub rjes/ mdun du bzlog pa'i chas bsag pa ni/ gzhi ma traṃ gyi steng du dkyil 'khor bsad pa ltar bris la/ ri sna gsum gyi rdo la thod sgyed bya/ steng du lcags slang che legs kyi nang du dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu chos 'byung bsnol ma bri dpe'u ris ltar bya la/ de steng dpal bshos rtse gru gang la dmar nag khra bsdebs pa'i gtor chen mdun du yum gyi gtor ma rkang gang la/ kī la ya rigs bzhi yang de'i cha mtshungs khro bcu sogs de bzhin la rgyas pa lha grangs/ bsdus pa gtso 'khor bcu drug kyang*/ khra thabs dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs khrag kong khrag kyu grangs dang sbyar la/ phyi gtsang sor bcu gnyis brgya tham pa/ dbu gtsang khru gang nyi shu rtsa gcig /phyag gtsang rkang gang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis sum cu tham pa sogs 'thad/ steng du srung bzlog 'khor lo/ gtor gdugs/ mda' dar bzhi/ cod pan bzhi/ me long bzhi/ phur pa lnga'am bzhis brgyan/ phyi rim rab gos chen 'bring ras nag po'i dkris bya/ bha su ta dang sngo dmar skud pas dkris brgyab rtsang rtse sha dang liṅgas brgyan/ mdun du dmar chen gyi mchod pa bshams pa ni/ dbang po'i me tog tshil chen dud pa/ zhun chen mar me/ rak+ta'i dri chab/ tsit+ta'i dpal bshos sogs bsham/ g.yas su btsan rgod kyi zor chen la zor rdzas sna tshogs kyis bskor/ g.yon du lcags snod gru gsum gyi hom byas la nang du liṅga 'jug /g.yab pa'i rnga ma dmar nag thun rdzas tshogs tshad kyis bskor/ dgra sha khrag mchod kyi gtor chung bcu dgu/ liṅga bcu dgu/ sha dum bcu dgu bcas bsham/ thugs dam bskul gtor gtso 'khor dgu/ chad mdo gtso 'khor bdun/ brtan ma gtso 'khor lnga/ mtheb skyu grangs dang sbyar la dkar bgegs sogs bshams pa de dag dang po bcas kyi rim pa'o/ de nas 'don pa'i las rim la 'jug pa ni/

chu gtsang gis legs par bsang sbyangs bya la/ dang po rgyud rim la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mdun gyi sogs? lhan skyes kun bzang dgongs pa gsal rdzogs shog / bar 'don/ gzhung las byang skyabs sems bya la dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor bsngo/ srung 'khor bsgom/ hūm̐: grangs med bag chags brtsegs pa phung po'i sgo: zhes pa'i mgor byin 'bebs bya/ rim bzhin 'don la bstod pa'i mtha' la 'dzab bskul mdun bskyed nas blangs la thun gtor 'bul/ mchod bstod bya/ 'di'i mtshams chos skyong drag po sde lnga/ zhing skyong btsan rgod dge bsnyen gsol kha bcas btang*/ rang rang gi rgyun khyer gang yod 'don/ de nas mdun bskyed la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭ sogs nas/ hūm̐/ de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan sogs nas las byang ltar lha bskyed bya la spyan 'dren mchod pa mdun bskyed ltar bya/ bstod pa gzhung ltar la/ bsnyen pa gzhung ltar bya zhing tshogs la 'jug /tshogs bskang gzhung bskang sbrags la tshogs tha bsgral/ zhal du bstabs la tshogs la dngos grub rol/ de nas/

hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: sogs dmag bskul gtor zor gnyis btang*/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu bsad las mgor nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sogs nas? mā ra ya yi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar 'don/ mtshams su gser skyems btang*/ de nas hom bskyed bya/ dmigs bya lan gsum gyis 'gugs/ dmigs bya dngos su gsal la/ pho nya 'gyed/ lha dbye bya/ bya rog 'ug sgro gnyis/ bdud dang sprod/ spu gri'i 'khor lo bskor/ byad du bcug /phur pas tshe lung khrus lung gi gnad zhal shes gzir la rnam shes spar/ de nas rim gyis thun brdegs la/ bsgral gtub bya zhing zhal du bstab/ de nas rtsang bskul shan pa dmag 'gyed 'don/ mdos rgyan dang ni bzlog pa bya/ de nas yang bzlog dag la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sogs/ dgra bgegs bsgral zhing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: bzlog pa dug mda' reg chod las/ hūm̐: mdun du drag po gnam lcags hom gyi nang : sogs? phaṭḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: sogs 'gugs/ hūm̐: las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs sogs kyis bsgral/ mchod g.yog pas mtshams su ling dum gtor chung 'bul la gtsang sbra do gal/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: sogs/ dmag dpung bskyed cing bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: 'di'i mtshams yang bzlog ltar/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : sogs/ bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar 'don/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ sogs/ dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'di yi mtshams su liṅga gtor chung sha dum sogs/ dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul ba phyag len gzhung ltar bya/ 'di'i mtshams dpal gtor la dpal 'bar btsugs la/ mchod g.yog pas lag tu thogs la/ hūm̐: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags yang :

dmar nag gtor mas dgra la zlog: sogs kyis phyogs su 'phang*/ hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnam nas thog rgod lhung ba zlog: zhes thal mo brdab cing dmod bcol bya/ de yang ma hā'i sgom khog las/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa yi/ /snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kun/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang du bsgyur/ /tha mal rang gi 'khrul snang zlog /gsungs pa ltar/ phyi yi gtor mas/ 'khor ba myang 'das su bzlog pa dang*/ /skye 'gro sems can thams cad kun/ /lha dang lha mo'i ngang du bsgyur/ /tha mal rang rgyud 'dzin pa zlog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nang gi gtor mas sems can sangs rgyas su bzlog pa dang*/ gti mug ma rig 'khrul pa rnams/ /chos dbyings ye shes nyid du bsgyur/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtog pa zlog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsang ba'i gtor mas dug lnga ye shes su bzlog pa dang*/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur ba/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyid du zlog /sogs/ snang srid dgra ru sdang ba'i cho 'phrul te/ ye stong a ti'i nus pas bzlog par 'gyur: gsungs pa ltar/ bzlog pa zhes pa'i sgra don yang de ka rang la 'dus par mngon no/ 'di'i skabs btsan rgod kyi zor sgrub bya ba sogs gzhung ltar bya/ lhag ma btang*/ thugs dam bskul/ chos skyong gzhung gi bstod bskul bya/ chad mdo 'bul/ brtan ma skyong*/ mchod bstod bya/ bkra shis brjod/ srung bzlog gur khang bsgom/ bsngo smon rjes shes kyi rim par gnas/ de sogs rgyud kyi go rim mo/ de nas gtor rdzong nyin par/ dkyil 'khor gzhung 'jug bzlog pa yan gong ltar song nas bzlog pa'i mtshams su/ bskul sogs gang rigs blo yis dpag nas/ dang po gser skyems gling bzhi ma bskul nas dkar gtor 'bul/ de nas nang sgo dbye/ srin mo za lam 'don/ glud rabs gang rigs kyis yas bsngo 'bad/ mdos zhal bsgyur la/ chad mdo'i tha tshig bsgrag /de nas lam 'gros ngang du chas/

mdos tshugs bya na yang bzlog ltar du bya/ 'bul sar phyin tshe dang po dkar gtor 'bul/ liṅga hom bskyed/ bden stobs brjod/ zor rnams rim par 'phang*/ 'di'i skabs sangs rgyas bstan don nam/ dben ri bcom pa/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs su gyur pa'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra ma gtogs/ khas drag dang ngo srung gi ched du bskul mi nus pas dam par gces so/ btsan rgod kyi zor chen spu gri 'bar ba'i bskul pa bya la khrag mchod 'bul/ de nas rim gyis gtor chen rdzongs la bzhes 'dren bya/ gtor gzhong sbub/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro bya/ phyi mtshams bcad la khyung nag bsgoms/ nang du log /tshe 'gugs bya/ dngos grub len pa sogs las byang ltar du bya/ bkra shis bsngo smon rgya yis gdab/ sa ma ya/ zhes rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i zhal lung rgya mtsho'i bcud thigs cha shas spel ba'i bu slob kun dga' blo gros kyis rang gzhan brjed thor bris pa don smin dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// //
